# dotfiles-windows

This machine's `$HOME` is managed by a **chezmoi** dotfiles repo targeting **native
Windows + PowerShell 7**. Packages install via **scoop** (CLI) + **winget** (GUI) —
there is no ansible here. Repo: <https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows>.
(macOS/Linux/WSL are handled by the separate `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` repo.)

## Orientation
- Source dir: `chezmoi source-path` — edit there (`cd "$(chezmoi source-path)"`).
- Preview / apply: `chezmoi diff` / `chezmoi apply` (or `just diff` / `just apply`).
- Source of a target: `chezmoi source-path <path>`; render without applying: `chezmoi cat <path>`.
- Re-run init prompts: `chezmoi init` (answers persist in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`).
- `docs/**`, `editors/**`, `scripts/**` are chezmoi-ignored (not deployed).

## Shell layout (pwsh)
- `$PROFILE` (`~/Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1`) is a loader
  that dot-sources `~/.config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in sorted order, then
  `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1` (untracked user override, loaded last).
- Fragments: `00_env` (PATH/XDG/env), `10_tools` (starship, zoxide, atuin,
  fzf, direnv, tv), `20_aliases` (`ll`/`gs`/`reload`/`cas`/`cau`/`chezmoi-cd`/`run-for`),
  `25_herdr` (`hvibe`/`hcode`/`hhere`/`hroot`/`hmark` workspace helpers, gated on herdr),
  `30_apps` (`applaunch`/`appquit`/`apprestart`/`sysvol`/`sysmute`/`x`), `35_yazi` (`y`),
  `40_copilot` (imports the Copilot module), `90_psreadline` (vi-mode gated on `enableVimMode`).

## Packages
- `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the **single source of
  truth** for installs, gated by the init toggles. scoop = CLI tools, winget = GUI
  apps, npm = AI agents, PSGallery = PSFzf/AudioDeviceCmdlets. Fault-tolerant: one
  failed package is collected + reported, never aborts the apply.
- Package sources are defined once in `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` and
  reused by the installer and `profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`: managed machines
  use company PyPI/npm pull-through registries; otherwise the China-mirror toggle
  selects GFW mirrors. Managed-machine policy wins if both toggles are true.
- Install ≠ upgrade: `chezmoi apply` only installs what's missing; upgrade via
  `just upgrade-scoop` / `just upgrade-winget`.

## copilot-proxy
- Module at `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot`. Commands: `copilot-proxy`
  (`start`/`stop`/`restart`/`status`/`doctor`/`logs`/`shim`/`whoami`/`auth`/`reinstall`),
  `copilot-run`, `claude-copilot`, `claude-copilot-once`, `codex-copilot`,
  `codex-copilot-once`, `copilot-here`, `copilot-model` (incl. `--auto`),
  `copilot-embed`, `semsearch`.
- Needs `bun`. Token: `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`. Ports 4141 (proxy) /
  4142 (throttle shim). Default main model `gpt-5.6-sol[1m]`; the OpenAI role
  profile maps Fable/Opus to Sol, Sonnet to Terra, and Haiku/background to Luna.
  Automatic selection excludes policy-disabled, picker-hidden and embedding-only
  entries. Claude `--auto` is Claude-first; Codex is OpenAI-first; both share the
  named OpenAI order Sol > Terra > 5.5 > 5.4 > 5.3 Codex > Luna > mini.
- The shim retries only the same buffered request/model, emits SSE keepalives for
  silent streams, and has a stall watchdog; it never performs request-time
  cross-model failover. Timing knobs: `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS`,
  `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_MS`, `COPILOT_SHIM_STALL_MS`.
- `copilot-here` writes only the gitignored `./.claude/settings.local.json`. The
  pinned copilot-api is installed ONCE into `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`
  (never `bunx` at launch); `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY` (auto|always|never|URL) controls
  whether Node fetches the GitHub model catalog through the local proxy. Full guide:
  `docs/copilot-proxy.md`.

## Editors / terminal / tv
- VSCode & Cursor settings + keybindings are deep-merged into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`
  by `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_20_editor_overlays.ps1.tmpl` (sources under `editors/`).
- Windows Terminal `profiles.defaults`, Alacritty (`%APPDATA%\alacritty\alacritty.toml`),
  and WezTerm (`~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua`, pwsh as default shell) are managed too.
  Television channels live under `%APPDATA%\television\cable\` (`tv <name>`).

## Gotchas
- Windows-only repo — no `{{ if eq .chezmoi.os }}` branching needed.
- Editor settings use a `run_onchange` pwsh merger (not `modify_`) on Windows.
- tmux / zellij are Unix-only and intentionally absent; **WezTerm** (installed) is
  the stable native tmux-like multiplexer, or use Windows Terminal panes. **herdr**
  is an opt-in (`installHerdr`) native-Windows multiplexer in preview beta —
  installed via herdr.dev's `irm|iex` script, config at `~/.config/herdr/config.toml`,
  with its official global skill exported from the installed binary on each apply.
  Runtimes are native via scoop (node/bun/go/rust/ruby) + uv for Python — no mise on Windows.
- **Rime input method** (opt-in `installInputMethod`): Weasel/小狼毫 via winget
  `Rime.Weasel`. Machine-scope NSIS, so applying raises UAC; and a bare silent
  install registers **简体** — `Install-Weasel` passes `--custom '/T'` for 繁體.
  The engine-level YAML in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` is **byte-identical to the
  parent repo's** copy (Squirrel/ibus-rime); only `weasel.custom.yaml` is
  Windows-specific. Edits need a redeploy, which
  `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.
  See `docs/input-method.md`.
- **cmd.exe** is opt-in via `installClink`: Clink + starship/zoxide/fzf give the DOS
  prompt parity for **prompt + navigation only** (no pwsh funcs/aliases/modules).
  `starship.lua` is chezmoi-managed at `%LocalAppData%\clink`; the zoxide/fzf Clink
  bridges are fetched from upstream at apply. pwsh stays the default shell.
- **`translate`** (`installTranslate`, on for workstation) is the one tool built from
  source: no scoop/winget manifest, so the packages script runs a version-pinned
  `go install` into `~\.local\bin` (it installs `go` itself). First build takes
  minutes; re-applies no-op via a `--version` check. Upgrade with
  `just upgrade-translate`, not `upgrade-scoop`.
- This skill body is shared: `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/` and
  `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/` both render `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.

## Conclusion

**Yes—dynamic Workflow fan-out can produce several sounds, but not one per tool call.** With the current configuration, the expected pattern for a Workflow spawning `N` workers is approximately:

- `N × task.acknowledge` from `SubagentStart`
- `1 × task.complete` when the main agent reaches `Stop`
- Additional sounds only for failures, permission requests, compaction, or certain notifications

There is **no `SubagentStop` hook**, so workers do not each produce a completion sound.

## Current configuration

This machine is using the `peon` tier. The repo defines that as voice lines plus peon’s overlay, while `notify` is the separate Apprise toast tier:

- Tier definitions: `docs/agent-sounds.md:12-24`
- Prompt choices and semantics: `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl:19-27`
- Peon and notification tier conditions: `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_25_claude_settings.ps1.tmpl:195-205`

The live peon configuration currently has:

- Enabled: `true`
- Volume: `0.5`
- Pack: `league_of_legends`
- Desktop notifications: enabled
- Every sound category enabled
- `silent_window_seconds: 0`
- No excluded directories, path rules, or IDE rules

One documentation discrepancy exists: `docs/agent-sounds.md:90-95` says runtime configuration is `~/.openpeon/config.json`, but the installed player actually reads:

```text
~/.openpeon/hooks/peon-ping/config.json
```

The broader point remains correct: chezmoi deliberately does not manage peon’s runtime settings.

## Hook eligibility and actual sounds

The repo installs peon on these nine Claude Code events:

`SessionStart`, `SessionEnd`, `SubagentStart`, `Stop`, `Notification`, `PermissionRequest`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, and `PreCompact`.

Exact declaration: `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_25_claude_settings.ps1.tmpl:208-215`.

Every entry has:

```powershell
matcher = ''
```

Therefore the **repo-level hook configuration does not filter by**:

- Workflow versus ordinary subagent
- `agent_type`
- `agent_id`
- Tool name
- Parent versus child context

The installed peon player then maps eligible hooks as follows:

| Claude event | Hook invoked? | Current player sound |
|---|---:|---|
| `SessionStart` | Yes | `session.start`; global 30-second cooldown |
| `SessionEnd` | Yes | None; player has no category mapping |
| `SubagentStart` | Yes | `task.acknowledge`; no debounce |
| `Stop` | Yes | `task.complete`; 5-second debounce |
| `Notification` | Yes | Depends on subtype |
| `PermissionRequest` | Yes | `input.required` |
| `PreToolUse` | Yes | None for native Claude payloads |
| `PostToolUseFailure` | Yes | `task.error` |
| `PreCompact` | Yes | `resource.limit` |
| `SubagentStop` | **No** | None |

Important implications:

1. **Normal subagent tool calls are not noisy.**  
   `PreToolUse` launches the PowerShell hook, but the current player has no native `PreToolUse` sound mapping, so it exits without playing anything.

2. **Starting many workers is noisy.**  
   `SubagentStart` maps directly to `task.acknowledge` and has no cooldown. A four-worker Workflow can therefore produce four rapid acknowledgment lines.

3. **Workers do not each announce completion.**  
   The repo does not wire `SubagentStop`; compare the complete nine-event list at `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_25_claude_settings.ps1.tmpl:209-211`.

4. **Failures can add noise.**  
   Each `PostToolUseFailure` is eligible for `task.error`. Permission and compaction events have their own categories.

For the separate `notify` tier, only `Notification` and `Stop` are wired (`.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_25_claude_settings.ps1.tmpl:203-206`), and `Stop` becomes the “Task finished” toast in `dot_claude/hooks/notify.ps1:31-33`.

## Is Workflow/subagent context filtered?

### At the repo hook layer: no

The empty matchers mean there is no filtering or special handling for Workflow workers.

### Inside the current installed peon player: partial, but unreliable for Workflow

The downloaded player contains a filter for payloads whose:

```text
permission_mode == "delegate"
```

It records those session IDs and suppresses later events from the same session. However:

- It does **not** inspect `agent_type`, Workflow ID, `workflow-subagent` attribution, or `agent_id`.
- A recent four-worker Workflow run is present under a `subagents/workflows/wf_*` directory, but peon’s persistent state contains no `agent_sessions` entry afterward.
- Therefore, on this build, the delegate filter did not demonstrably classify those Workflow workers. The unfiltered `SubagentStart` sounds remain the behavior to expect.

This behavior is not controlled or version-pinned by the repo. The installer downloads upstream `main` (`.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl:402-416`) and then permanently skips installation once `peon.ps1` exists (`.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl:421-435`). Consequently, two machines applied at different times can have different player-side routing even with identical chezmoi source.

## Dynamic Workflow versus `/loop`

These are separate mechanisms:

- **Workflow tool / dynamic workflows:** orchestrates a fan-out of actual subagents. These generate `SubagentStart` events and therefore acknowledgment sounds.
- **`/loop`:** schedules a prompt or slash command to be enqueued repeatedly. It is not itself a Workflow subagent fan-out and does not inherently emit `SubagentStart`.

For a plain `/loop` tick, expect the ordinary turn-ending `Stop` sound. It only gains the Workflow sound pattern if the scheduled prompt itself invokes the Workflow tool or otherwise spawns subagents.

The repo recognizes dynamic workflows as local Claude orchestration and explicitly preserves workflow-specific subagent routing at `docs/copilot-proxy.md:151-162`; it contains no `/loop`-specific peon configuration.

## Confidence and coverage caveats

- The current Pester test renders only `agentSounds = 'notify'`, not `peon`: `tests/ClaudeSettings.Tests.ps1:1-10`.
- The repo documentation says the four-tier template behavior was manually verified, but not the real Windows audio path: `docs/agent-sounds.md:139-148`.
- The docs also warn that hook presence alone does not prove audio dispatch: `docs/agent-sounds.md:97-128`.

No files were modified.

- [Claude Code hooks reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks)
- [Claude Code dynamic workflows](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows)
- [Claude Code permission modes](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes)
- [Claude Code subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents)

1	#Requires -Version 7
2	# notify.ps1 — Claude Code notification hook -> Windows toast via apprise.
3	#
4	# Native-pwsh port of the parent (macOS/Linux) repo's dot_claude/hooks/notify.sh.
5	# Reads the hook JSON payload from stdin, builds a title/body, and fires
6	# `apprise --tag desktop`, which resolves to the native windows:// backend
7	# configured in ~/.config/apprise/apprise.yaml. Wired to the Notification and
8	# Stop events by claude/settings-overlay.json.
9	#
10	# Best-effort by design: it must never block or fail a Claude turn, so it
11	# swallows every error and always exits 0. If apprise isn't installed yet, it
12	# simply no-ops.
13	$ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
14	
15	# Claude launches hook commands with `pwsh -NoProfile`, so profile.d/00_env.ps1
16	# hasn't run and ~/.local/bin (the uv tool bin dir holding apprise.exe) may not
17	# be on PATH. Prepend it defensively.
18	$localBin = Join-Path $HOME '.local\bin'
19	if ((Test-Path $localBin -PathType Container) -and ($env:PATH -notlike "*$localBin*")) {
20	    $env:PATH = "$localBin;$env:PATH"
21	}
22	
23	$raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
24	try { $payload = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json } catch { $payload = $null }
25	
26	$evt   = if ($payload.hook_event_name) { $payload.hook_event_name } else { 'unknown' }
27	$title = if ($payload.title) { $payload.title } else { 'Claude Code' }
28	$msg   = "$($payload.message)"
29	$ntype = "$($payload.notification_type)"
30	
31	# The Stop event carries no title/message — synthesize a completion toast
32	# (matches the parent notify.sh behavior).
33	if ($evt -eq 'Stop') { $title = 'Claude Code'; $msg = 'Task finished' }
34	
35	$fullTitle = if ($ntype) { "$title [$ntype]" } else { $title }
36	# windows:// caps the body around 250 chars; trim so a long message still toasts.
37	if ($msg.Length -gt 250) { $msg = $msg.Substring(0, 247) + '...' }
38	
39	if (Get-Command apprise -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
40	    $cfg = Join-Path $HOME '.config\apprise\apprise.yaml'
41	    if (Test-Path $cfg) {
42	        apprise --config $cfg --tag desktop --title $fullTitle --body $msg *> $null
43	    } else {
44	        # Config not deployed yet — fall back to an inline windows:// URL.
45	        apprise --title $fullTitle --body $msg 'windows://' *> $null
46	    }
47	}
48	exit 0
49

5	# that repo uses a `modify_` + jq merge, which is unreliable on Windows
6	# (invariant #5), so we use the editor-overlay run_onchange pwsh idiom instead.
7	#
8	# Why merges (not managed files)? Claude Code rewrites settings.json at runtime,
9	# and /claude-hud:configure rewrites the HUD config. Static managed files would
10	# clobber live-only state. Each transaction recursively merges only our owned
11	# leaves and fails closed independently, so one malformed file cannot block the
12	# other or be overwritten.
13	#
14	# Gated on installCodingAgents. Re-runs when either embedded overlay changes.
15	{{ if .installCodingAgents -}}

19	# self-contained and includes both overlays in the run_onchange content hash.
20	$settingsOverlayJson = @'

22	'@
23	$hudOverlayJson = @'

27	# Parse a JSON string as an object. Arrays/scalars are not valid roots for either
28	# managed surface, because merging them would replace rather than preserve state.
29	function ConvertFrom-JsonObjectText {
30	    param(
31	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Text,
32	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Label
33	    )
34	    try { $value = $Text | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable -ErrorAction Stop }
35	    catch { throw "$Label is invalid JSON: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
36	    if ($value -isnot [System.Collections.IDictionary]) {
37	        throw "$Label root is not a JSON object"
38	    }
39	    $value
40	}
41	
42	# Follow a file symlink without requiring its target to exist yet. This keeps a
43	# create-time link intact and lets the managed transaction initialize its target.
44	function Resolve-JsonTargetPath {
45	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Path)
46	
47	    $targetPath = $Path
48	    $seen = [Collections.Generic.HashSet[string]]::new([StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
49	    while ($true) {
50	        $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $targetPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
51	        if (-not $item -or ($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -eq 0) {
52	            return $targetPath
53	        }
54	        if (-not $seen.Add($item.FullName)) { throw "symbolic-link cycle while resolving $Path" }
55	        $resolved = $item.ResolveLinkTarget($false)
56	        if (-not $resolved) { throw "could not resolve link target for $Path" }
57	        $targetPath = $resolved.FullName
58	    }
59	}
60	
61	# Read strict UTF-8 without normalizing the live bytes first. A single UTF-8 BOM
62	# is accepted for compatibility; successful writes normalize to BOM-free UTF-8.
63	function Read-JsonObject {
64	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Path)
65	
66	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) { return @{} }
67	    [byte[]] $bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($Path)
68	    if ($bytes.Length -eq 0) { return @{} }
69	
70	    $offset = 0
71	    if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xBF) {
72	        $offset = 3
73	    }
74	    try {
75	        $utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true)
76	        $text = $utf8.GetString($bytes, $offset, $bytes.Length - $offset)
77	    } catch {
78	        throw "$Path is not valid UTF-8: $($_.Exception.Message)"
79	    }
80	    if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($text)) { return @{} }
81	    ConvertFrom-JsonObjectText -Text $text -Label $Path
82	}
83	
84	# Recursive object merge: overlay leaves win; live-only/unknown leaves survive.
85	# settings.json opts into its special additive hook merge; HUD config does not.
86	function Merge-JsonObject {
87	    param(
88	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [System.Collections.IDictionary] $Base,
89	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [System.Collections.IDictionary] $Overlay
90	    )
91	    foreach ($key in $Overlay.Keys) {
92	        if ($Base.Contains($key) -and
93	            $Base[$key] -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -and
94	            $Overlay[$key] -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) {
95	            Merge-JsonObject -Base ($Base[$key]) -Overlay ($Overlay[$key])
96	        } else {
97	            $Base[$key] = $Overlay[$key]
98	        }
99	    }
100	}
101	
102	# Additive per-event hook merge. Append only entries whose first hook command is
103	# not already present, preserving foreign live entries and forcing array shape.
104	function Merge-ClaudeHooks {
105	    param(
106	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [System.Collections.IDictionary] $Base,
107	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [System.Collections.IDictionary] $Overlay
108	    )
109	    foreach ($eventName in $Overlay.Keys) {
110	        $live = @()
111	        if ($null -ne $Base[$eventName]) { $live = @($Base[$eventName]) }
112	        $liveCommands = @($live | ForEach-Object { $_.hooks[0].command })
113	        $additions = @($Overlay[$eventName] | Where-Object {
114	            $command = $_.hooks[0].command
115	            (-not $command) -or ($liveCommands -notcontains $command)
116	        })
117	        $Base[$eventName] = @($live + $additions)
118	    }
119	}

123	function Write-JsonObjectAtomically {

125	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Path,
126	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [System.Collections.IDictionary] $Value,
127	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [bool] $ExpectedExists,

129	    )

165	                throw "$Path changed while the managed overlay was being prepared"
166	            }
167	            if ($current.Length -eq $candidate.Length -and
168	                [Convert]::ToBase64String($current) -ceq [Convert]::ToBase64String($candidate)) {
169	                return $false
170	            }
171	            # ReplaceFile preserves the destination target's Windows ACLs and
172	            # attributes. A real backup path avoids null binding as an empty path.
173	            [IO.File]::Replace($temporary, $targetPath, $backup)
174	        } else {
175	            # Move without overwrite is a create-time precondition: a concurrent
176	            # creator makes this fail closed instead of losing the new file.
177	            [IO.File]::Move($temporary, $targetPath)
178	        }
179	    } finally {
180	        if ($guard) { $guard.Dispose() }
181	        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporary -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
182	        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $backup -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
183	    }
184	    $true
185	}
186	
187	function Update-ClaudeSettings {
188	    param(
189	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $ClaudeDir,
190	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $OverlayJson
191	    )
192	
193	    $overlay = ConvertFrom-JsonObjectText -Text $OverlayJson -Label 'managed Claude settings overlay'
194	
195	    # Completion-feedback hooks are built here because the embedded JSON cannot
196	    # carry Go-template conditionals. notify = apprise toast; peon = voice lines.
197	    {{- $peon   := or (eq .agentSounds "peon")   (eq .agentSounds "both") }}
198	    {{- $notify := or (eq .agentSounds "notify") (eq .agentSounds "both") }}
199	    $notifyCommand = 'exec pwsh -NoProfile -File "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/hooks/notify.ps1"'
200	    $peonPs1 = Join-Path $HOME '.openpeon\hooks\peon-ping\peon.ps1'
201	    $peonCommand = "powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command `"if (Test-Path '$peonPs1') { & '$peonPs1' }`""
202	    $soundHooks = @{}
203	    {{- if $notify }}
204	    foreach ($eventName in @('Notification', 'Stop')) {
205	        $soundHooks[$eventName] = @(@{ matcher = ''; hooks = @(@{ type = 'command'; command = $notifyCommand }) })
206	    }
207	    {{- end }}
208	    {{- if $peon }}
209	    foreach ($eventName in @('SessionStart', 'SessionEnd', 'SubagentStart', 'Stop',
210	                              'Notification', 'PermissionRequest', 'PreToolUse',
211	                              'PostToolUseFailure', 'PreCompact')) {
212	        $entry = @{ matcher = ''; hooks = @(@{ type = 'command'; command = $peonCommand; timeout = 10 }) }
213	        if ($soundHooks.ContainsKey($eventName)) { $soundHooks[$eventName] = @($soundHooks[$eventName] + $entry) }
214	        else                                      { $soundHooks[$eventName] = @($entry) }
215	    }
216	    {{- end }}
217	    if ($soundHooks.Count -gt 0) {
218	        if ($overlay['hooks'] -isnot [System.Collections.IDictionary]) { $overlay['hooks'] = @{} }
219	        foreach ($eventName in $soundHooks.Keys) { $overlay['hooks'][$eventName] = $soundHooks[$eventName] }
220	    }
221	
222	    # Prune only repository-owned hooks disabled by the current sound tier.
223	    $prunePatterns = @(
224	    {{- if not $notify }}
225	        'notify\.ps1'
226	    {{- end }}
227	    {{- if not $peon }}
228	        'peon\.ps1'
229	    {{- end }}
230	    )
231	
232	    $settingsPath = Join-Path $ClaudeDir 'settings.json'
233	    $settingsTargetPath = Resolve-JsonTargetPath -Path $settingsPath
234	    $settingsExisted = Test-Path -LiteralPath $settingsTargetPath
235	    [byte[]] $settingsBytes = [byte[]]::new(0)
236	    if ($settingsExisted) { $settingsBytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($settingsTargetPath) }
237	    $settings = Read-JsonObject -Path $settingsTargetPath
238	    if ($overlay['hooks'] -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) {
239	        if ($settings['hooks'] -isnot [System.Collections.IDictionary]) { $settings['hooks'] = @{} }
240	        Merge-ClaudeHooks -Base ($settings['hooks']) -Overlay ($overlay['hooks'])
241	        $overlay.Remove('hooks')
242	    }
243	    Merge-JsonObject -Base $settings -Overlay $overlay
244	
245	    if ($prunePatterns.Count -gt 0 -and $settings['hooks'] -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) {
246	        foreach ($eventName in @($settings['hooks'].Keys)) {
247	            $kept = @(@($settings['hooks'][$eventName]) | Where-Object {
248	                $command = $_.hooks[0].command
249	                if (-not $command) { return $true }
250	                foreach ($pattern in $prunePatterns) {
251	                    if ($command -match $pattern) { return $false }
252	                }
253	                $true
254	            })
255	            if ($kept.Count -gt 0) { $settings['hooks'][$eventName] = $kept }
256	            else                   { $settings['hooks'].Remove($eventName) }
257	        }
258	    }
259	
260	    $changed = Write-JsonObjectAtomically -Path $settingsPath -Value $settings `
261	        -ExpectedExists $settingsExisted -ExpectedBytes $settingsBytes
262	    if ($changed) { Write-Host "claude overlay -> $settingsPath" }
263	}
264	
265	function Update-ClaudeHudConfig {
266	    param(
267	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $ClaudeDir,
268	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $OverlayJson
269	    )
270	
271	    $overlay = ConvertFrom-JsonObjectText -Text $OverlayJson -Label 'managed claude-hud Full 0.7.1 overlay'
272	    $hudPath = Join-Path $ClaudeDir 'plugins\claude-hud\config.json'
273	    $hudTargetPath = Resolve-JsonTargetPath -Path $hudPath
274	    $hudExisted = Test-Path -LiteralPath $hudTargetPath
275	    [byte[]] $hudBytes = [byte[]]::new(0)
276	    if ($hudExisted) { $hudBytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($hudTargetPath) }
277	    $config = Read-JsonObject -Path $hudTargetPath
278	    Merge-JsonObject -Base $config -Overlay $overlay
279	    $changed = Write-JsonObjectAtomically -Path $hudPath -Value $config `
280	        -ExpectedExists $hudExisted -ExpectedBytes $hudBytes
281	    if ($changed) { Write-Host "claude-hud Full overlay -> $hudPath" }
282	}
283	
284	# Respect CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for both targets, matching Claude Code and claude-hud.
285	$claudeDir = if ($env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR } else { Join-Path $HOME '.claude' }
286	try { Update-ClaudeSettings -ClaudeDir $claudeDir -OverlayJson $settingsOverlayJson }
287	catch { Write-Warning "Claude settings overlay skipped; not overwriting: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
288	try { Update-ClaudeHudConfig -ClaudeDir $claudeDir -OverlayJson $hudOverlayJson }
289	catch { Write-Warning "claude-hud overlay skipped; not overwriting: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
290	{{ end -}}
291
```

```text
1	# Agent completion sounds (`agentSounds`)
2	
3	How a coding agent tells you it finished on Windows: a toast, a game-character
4	voice line, both, or nothing. Chosen at `chezmoi init` with the `agentSounds`
5	prompt.
6	
7	This is the Windows counterpart of the cross-platform repo's
8	[`docs/tools/agent-sounds.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/docs/tools/agent-sounds.md),
9	which carries the full ecosystem write-up (OpenPeon vs peon-ping vs CESP). Read
10	that for the "what is this" part; this page covers what differs here.
11	
12	## The four tiers
13	
14	| `agentSounds` | Wires | You get |
15	|---|---|---|
16	| `none` | nothing | silence |
17	| `notify` | `notify.ps1` → apprise → `windows://` toast | Windows toast |
18	| `peon` | peon-ping's 9 hook events | game voice lines + peon's overlay |
19	| `both` | both of the above | toast + voice (two banners) |
20	
21	Default is `notify` on the `workstation` role and `none` on `minimal`. It gates
22	**hook wiring only** — the `peon` CLI installs alongside the coding agents
23	regardless, so `peon preview task.complete` / `peon packs list` are always
24	available to experiment with.
25	
26	Default pack is `league_of_legends` (League of Legends champion voice lines).
27	The installer downloads it and then activates it (`peon packs use
28	league_of_legends`) so sounds fire on first run — the raw installer otherwise
29	leaves the empty `peon` pack active.
30	
31	Two banners at `both` is expected. Trim it at runtime instead of changing tier:
32	`peon notifications off` keeps the sound and drops peon's overlay.
33	
34	## What differs from the macOS/Linux repo
35	
36	The design is the same; three implementation details are not.
37	
38	**1. The event set differs.** peon-ping's Windows adapter registers
39	`PreToolUse` and does **not** register `UserPromptSubmit` — the reverse of the
40	POSIX side. Both are 9 events. Taken from upstream's `install.ps1`, not its
41	README (the README's documented command shape is wrong on the POSIX side, so it
42	isn't trusted here either).
43	
44	**2. The hook command shape.** Windows entries carry `timeout = 10` and no
45	`async` field:
46	
47	```
48	powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "if (Test-Path '<peon.ps1>') { & '<peon.ps1>' }"
49	```
50	
51	The `Test-Path` guard is deliberate — an unguarded `-File <missing>` makes
52	Claude Code surface a hook error on every event on a box where the install
53	hasn't run. Same role as the `command -v workmux` guard in the parent repo.
54	
55	**3. peon-ping lives under `~/.openpeon`, not `~/.claude`.** It is installed
56	with `-OpenPeon`, which reroots its whole tree to a tool-agnostic root so the
57	installer never touches `~/.claude/settings.json` — hook wiring is ours to
58	declare. `peon.ps1` is therefore at
59	`~/.openpeon/hooks/peon-ping/peon.ps1`.
60	
61	Note the installer's parameter block is
62	`param([string[]]$Packs, [switch]$All, [string]$Lang, [switch]$Local, [switch]$Global, [switch]$OpenPeon, [switch]$InitLocalConfig)`
63	— there is **no `-NoRc`** (that is the bash `install.sh` flag), and it does not
64	touch `$PROFILE`.
65	
66	## Where the wiring lives
67	
68	| Concern | File |
69	|---|---|
70	| The prompt | `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` |
71	| Hook entries + prune | `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_25_claude_settings.ps1.tmpl` |
72	| Binary install | `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` |
73	| Non-hook overlay (statusLine, plugins) | `claude/settings-overlay.json` |
74	
75	The hook entries had to move **out** of `claude/settings-overlay.json` and into
76	the run_onchange: that JSON is `include`d verbatim, so it cannot carry the
77	Go-template conditionals the tiers need.
78	
79	## The one place we subtract
80	
81	The merge is additive so foreign hook entries (CodeIsland, anything you add by
82	hand) survive. One exception: entries matching **our own** command fingerprints
83	(`notify\.ps1`, `peon\.ps1`) are pruned when the current tier disables them.
84	
85	Without it `agentSounds` is a one-way ratchet — switching `notify` → `none`
86	would leave `notify.ps1` wired forever, so `none` wouldn't actually silence a
87	machine that previously had sound. Upstream's own `install.ps1` strips the same
88	two fingerprints before re-adding, so this matches its behaviour.
89	
90	## peon's config is deliberately unmanaged
91	
92	`peon volume` / `notifications` / `packs use` write `~/.openpeon/config.json` at
93	runtime. chezmoi does not manage that file, so tweaking any of it produces
94	**no** drift. The installer seeds and activates `league_of_legends` once and is skipped on later applies
95	(guarded on `peon.ps1` existing), so a pack you switch to later sticks.
96	
97	## Verify
98	
99	```powershell
100	peon status
101	peon preview task.complete       # should say "Job's finished!"
102	Get-Content ~/.claude/settings.json | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -Expand hooks | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty
103	peon volume 0.4; chezmoi diff    # must be empty
104	```
105	
106	**None of those four lines proves a sound will actually fire.** That exact
107	combination once passed on a fully silent macOS machine in the parent repo
108	(→ [`peon-hooks-wired-but-no-sound`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/peon-hooks-wired-but-no-sound.md)).
109	`peon status` only inspects `~/.openpeon`; `preview` bypasses the hook entirely;
110	and the settings keys can all be present while the hook target is missing,
111	because the `Test-Path` guard turns a missing `peon.ps1` into a *successful*
112	no-op that Claude Code reports as `completed successfully`.
113	
114	That matters more here than on macOS: if the `install.ps1 -OpenPeon` step in
115	`run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` fails it calls `Register-Failure` and
116	the apply carries on — leaving hooks wired against a player that was never
117	installed. Check the artifact, then fire the hook the way Claude Code does:
118	
119	```powershell
120	Test-Path "$HOME\.openpeon\hooks\peon-ping\peon.ps1"   # must be True
121	'{"hook_event_name":"Stop","session_id":"probe","cwd":"."}' |
122	  & "$HOME\.openpeon\hooks\peon-ping\peon.ps1"
123	Get-Content "$HOME\.openpeon\.state.json" | ConvertFrom-Json |
124	  Select-Object -Expand last_played                    # -> task.complete = sounds/JobsFinished.mp3
125	```
126	
127	`last_played` is the only machine-checkable proof that audio dispatched; exit
128	code 0 is not.
129	
130	Two upstream behaviours worth knowing before blaming this repo, both confirmed
131	on macOS with peon 2.35.1:
132	
133	- **The overlay is suppressed while your terminal is focused** — the sound
134	  plays, the banner doesn't. Switch to another window before the turn ends.
135	- **`peon notifications test` is a no-op** — it runs `PEON_TEST=1`, which
136	  disables the installer-layout fallback in peon's script resolver, so it
137	  reports success without notifying. Test with a real unfocused turn instead.
138	
139	## Verification status
140	
141	The template rendering, PowerShell parse, and the merge/prune behaviour were
142	verified on macOS by rendering all four tiers and executing them under `pwsh`
143	(cross-platform) against fixtures — foreign entries survive, our entries prune,
144	and the tier matrix is exact.
145	
146	**Not yet verified on a real Windows host**: the peon-ping install itself
147	(`install.ps1 -OpenPeon -Packs league_of_legends`), the toast/voice actually firing, and
148	`$env:TEMP` behaviour. Those need a Windows box.
149
```

35	# dotfiles-windows

37	This machine's `$HOME` is managed by a **chezmoi** dotfiles repo targeting **native

41	
42	## Orientation
43	- Source dir: `chezmoi source-path` — edit there (`cd "$(chezmoi source-path)"`).
44	- Preview / apply: `chezmoi diff` / `chezmoi apply` (or `just diff` / `just apply`).
45	- Source of a target: `chezmoi source-path <path>`; render without applying: `chezmoi cat <path>`.
46	- Re-run init prompts: `chezmoi init` (answers persist in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`).
47	- `docs/**`, `editors/**`, `scripts/**` are chezmoi-ignored (not deployed).

49	## Shell layout (pwsh)
50	- `$PROFILE` (`~/Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1`) is a loader
51	  that dot-sources `~/.config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in sorted order, then
52	  `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1` (untracked user override, loaded last).
53	- Fragments: `00_env` (PATH/XDG/env), `10_tools` (starship, zoxide, atuin,

57	  `40_copilot` (imports the Copilot module), `90_psreadline` (vi-mode gated on `enableVimMode`).
58	
59	## Packages
60	- `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the **single source of
61	  truth** for installs, gated by the init toggles. scoop = CLI tools, winget = GUI
62	  apps, npm = AI agents, PSGallery = PSFzf/AudioDeviceCmdlets. Fault-tolerant: one
63	  failed package is collected + reported, never aborts the apply.
64	- Package sources are defined once in `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` and
65	  reused by the installer and `profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`: managed machines
66	  use company PyPI/npm pull-through registries; otherwise the China-mirror toggle
67	  selects GFW mirrors. Managed-machine policy wins if both toggles are true.
68	- Install ≠ upgrade: `chezmoi apply` only installs what's missing; upgrade via
69	  `just upgrade-scoop` / `just upgrade-winget`.
70	
71	## copilot-proxy
72	- Module at `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot`. Commands: `copilot-proxy`
73	  (`start`/`stop`/`restart`/`status`/`doctor`/`logs`/`shim`/`whoami`/`auth`/`reinstall`),
74	  `copilot-run`, `claude-copilot`, `claude-copilot-once`, `codex-copilot`,
75	  `codex-copilot-once`, `copilot-here`, `copilot-model` (incl. `--auto`),
76	  `copilot-embed`, `semsearch`.
77	- Needs `bun`. Token: `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`. Ports 4141 (proxy) /
78	  4142 (throttle shim). Default main model `gpt-5.6-sol[1m]`; the OpenAI role
79	  profile maps Fable/Opus to Sol, Sonnet to Terra, and Haiku/background to Luna.
80	  Automatic selection excludes policy-disabled, picker-hidden and embedding-only
81	  entries. Claude `--auto` is Claude-first; Codex is OpenAI-first; both share the
82	  named OpenAI order Sol > Terra > 5.5 > 5.4 > 5.3 Codex > Luna > mini.
83	- The shim retries only the same buffered request/model, emits SSE keepalives for
84	  silent streams, and has a stall watchdog; it never performs request-time
85	  cross-model failover. Timing knobs: `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS`,
86	  `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_MS`, `COPILOT_SHIM_STALL_MS`.
87	- `copilot-here` writes only the gitignored `./.claude/settings.local.json`. The
88	  pinned copilot-api is installed ONCE into `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`
89	  (never `bunx` at launch); `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY` (auto|always|never|URL) controls
90	  whether Node fetches the GitHub model catalog through the local proxy. Full guide:

94	- VSCode & Cursor settings + keybindings are deep-merged into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`

116	## Gotchas
117	- Windows-only repo — no `{{ if eq .chezmoi.os }}` branching needed.
118	- Editor settings use a `run_onchange` pwsh merger (not `modify_`) on Windows.
119	- tmux / zellij are Unix-only and intentionally absent; **WezTerm** (installed) is

121	  is an opt-in (`installHerdr`) native-Windows multiplexer in preview beta —

120	function Test-PathRuleMatch {
121	    param([string]$PathValue, [string]$Pattern)
122	    $pathNorm = Normalize-PathForRules $PathValue
123	    $patternNorm = Normalize-PathForRules $Pattern
124	    if (-not $pathNorm -or -not $patternNorm) { return $false }
125	    $hasWildcard = ($patternNorm.IndexOf('*') -ge 0) -or ($patternNorm.IndexOf('?') -ge 0) -or ($patternNorm.IndexOf('[') -ge 0)
126	    if ($hasWildcard) {

215	function Install-PackFromRegistryEntry {
216	    param($PackInfo, [string]$PacksDir)
217	
218	    if (-not $PackInfo -or -not $PackInfo.name) { return $false }
219	
220	    $PackName = $PackInfo.name
221	    $regUrl = "https://peonping.github.io/registry/index.json"
222	    $srcRepo = $PackInfo.source_repo
223	    $srcRef = $PackInfo.source_ref
224	    $srcPath = $PackInfo.source_path
225	    if (-not $srcRepo -or -not $srcRef -or ($null -eq $srcPath)) {
226	        Write-Host "Error: incomplete registry entry for '$PackName'." -ForegroundColor Red
227	        return $false
228	    }
229	    $packBase = if ($srcPath) { "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$srcRepo/$srcRef/$srcPath" } else { "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$srcRepo/$srcRef" }
230	    $pDir = Join-Path $PacksDir $PackName
231	    $sDir = Join-Path $pDir "sounds"
232	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $sDir -Force | Out-Null
233	    try {
234	        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$packBase/openpeon.json" -OutFile (Join-Path $pDir "openpeon.json") -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop
235	    } catch {
236	        Write-Host "Error: could not download manifest for '$PackName'." -ForegroundColor Red
237	        return $false
238	    }
239	    $mf = Get-Content (Join-Path $pDir "openpeon.json") -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
240	    $total = 0
241	    $downloaded = 0
242	    foreach ($catN in $mf.categories.PSObject.Properties.Name) {
243	        $total += $mf.categories.$catN.sounds.Count
244	    }
245	    foreach ($catN in $mf.categories.PSObject.Properties.Name) {
246	        foreach ($snd in $mf.categories.$catN.sounds) {
247	            $sf = Split-Path $snd.file -Leaf
248	            $sp = Join-Path $sDir $sf
249	            $downloaded++
250	            if (-not (Test-Path $sp)) {
251	                Write-Host "`r[$PackName] $downloaded/$total downloading..." -NoNewline
252	                Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$packBase/sounds/$sf" -OutFile $sp -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
253	            }
254	        }
255	    }
256	    Write-Host "`r[$PackName] $total/$total done.          "
257	    return $true
258	}

272	function Install-PackFromLocal {
273	    param([string]$SourceDir, [string]$PacksDir)
274	
275	    if (-not $SourceDir) {
276	        Write-Host "Usage: peon packs install-local <path>" -ForegroundColor Yellow
277	        return $null
278	    }
279	
280	    if (-not (Test-Path $SourceDir -PathType Container)) {
281	        Write-Host "Error: local pack path not found: $SourceDir" -ForegroundColor Red
282	        return $null
283	    }
284	
285	    $resolvedSource = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $SourceDir).Path
286	    $manifestPath = Join-Path $resolvedSource "openpeon.json"
287	    $legacyManifestPath = Join-Path $resolvedSource "manifest.json"
288	    $soundsDir = Join-Path $resolvedSource "sounds"
289	
290	    if (-not (Test-Path $soundsDir -PathType Container)) {
291	        Write-Host "Error: local pack must contain a sounds directory." -ForegroundColor Red
292	        return $null
293	    }
294	
295	    if (-not (Test-Path $manifestPath) -and -not (Test-Path $legacyManifestPath)) {
296	        Write-Host "Error: local pack must contain openpeon.json or manifest.json." -ForegroundColor Red
297	        return $null
298	    }
299	
300	    $packName = Split-Path $resolvedSource -Leaf
301	    $targetDir = Join-Path $PacksDir $packName
302	
303	    if (Test-Path $targetDir) {
304	        Remove-Item -Path $targetDir -Recurse -Force
305	    }
306	
307	    Copy-Item -Path $resolvedSource -Destination $targetDir -Recurse -Force
308	    return $packName
309	}

311	# Helper function to convert PSCustomObject to hashtable (PS 5.1 compat)
312	# Defined here (before CLI block) so both CLI commands and hook mode can use it.
313	function ConvertTo-Hashtable {
314	    param([Parameter(ValueFromPipeline)]$obj)
315	    if ($null -eq $obj) { return $obj }
316	    if ($obj -is [hashtable]) { return $obj }
317	    # Check value types before PSCustomObject 鈥?PS 5.1 pipeline wraps primitives
318	    # in PSObject, making them match [PSCustomObject] when received via ValueFromPipeline.
319	    if ($obj -is [System.ValueType] -or $obj -is [string]) { return $obj }
320	    if ($obj -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable]) {
321	        return ,@($obj | ForEach-Object { ConvertTo-Hashtable $_ })
322	    }
323	    if ($obj -is [PSCustomObject]) {
324	        $ht = @{}
325	        foreach ($prop in $obj.PSObject.Properties) {
326	            $ht[$prop.Name] = ConvertTo-Hashtable $prop.Value
327	        }
328	        return $ht
329	    }
330	    return $obj
331	}

333	# --- Atomic state I/O helpers ---
334	# Defined here (before CLI block) so both CLI commands and hook mode can use them.
335	function Write-StateAtomic {
336	    param([hashtable]$State, [string]$Path)
337	    $dir = Split-Path $Path -Parent
338	    if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null }
339	    $tmp = "$Path.$PID.tmp"
340	    $prevCulture = [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture
341	    try {
342	        [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture = [System.Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture
343	        $State | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Set-Content $tmp -Encoding UTF8
344	        if ($PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -ge 7) {
345	            # PS 7+ / .NET Core: Move-Item -Force performs atomic overwrite (no delete gap).
346	            Move-Item -Path $tmp -Destination $Path -Force
347	        } else {
348	            # PS 5.1: delete target then move (atomic on NTFS same-volume, sub-ms gap).
349	            if (Test-Path $Path) { [System.IO.File]::Delete($Path) }
350	            [System.IO.File]::Move($tmp, $Path)
351	        }
352	    } catch {
353	        Remove-Item $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
354	    } finally {
355	        [System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture = $prevCulture
356	    }
357	}

359	function Read-StateWithRetry {
360	    param([string]$Path)
361	    # Clean up orphaned .tmp files left by safety timer [Environment]::Exit(1),
362	    # which skips finally blocks and may leave partial writes behind.
363	    $dir = Split-Path $Path -Parent
364	    if ($dir -and (Test-Path $dir)) {
365	        $base = Split-Path $Path -Leaf
366	        Get-ChildItem -Path $dir -Filter "$base.*.tmp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
367	            ForEach-Object { Remove-Item $_.FullName -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
368	    }
369	    $delays = @(50, 100, 200)
370	    for ($i = 0; $i -le $delays.Count; $i++) {
371	        try {
372	            if (Test-Path $Path) {
373	                $raw = Get-Content $Path -Raw
374	                if ($raw -and $raw.Trim().Length -gt 0) {
375	                    $stateObj = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json
376	                    $converted = ConvertTo-Hashtable $stateObj
377	                    if ($converted -is [hashtable]) { return $converted }
378	                }
379	            }
380	            return @{}
381	        } catch {
382	            if ($i -lt $delays.Count) {
383	                Start-Sleep -Milliseconds $delays[$i]
384	            }
385	        }
386	    }
387	    return @{}
388	}

391	    param(

403	    $tplKey = $keyMap[$Category]

414	function Resolve-NotificationTemplate {
415	    param(
416	        [object]$Templates,
417	        [string]$Category,
418	        [string]$Event,
419	        [string]$Ntype,
420	        [string]$Project,
421	        [string]$Summary,
422	        [string]$ToolName,
423	        [string]$Status,
424	        [string]$DefaultMsg
425	    )
426	
427	    $tplKey = Resolve-TemplateKey -Category $Category -Event $Event -Ntype $Ntype
428	
429	    if (-not $tplKey -or -not $Templates.$tplKey) {
430	        return $DefaultMsg
431	    }
432	
433	    $template = $Templates.$tplKey
434	    if (-not $template) { return $DefaultMsg }
435	
436	    # Truncate summary to 120 chars
437	    $safeSummary = if ($Summary) {
438	        if ($Summary.Length -gt 120) { $Summary.Substring(0, 120) } else { $Summary }
439	    } else { '' }
440	
441	    $vars = @{
442	        project   = $Project
443	        summary   = $safeSummary
444	        tool_name = $ToolName
445	        status    = $Status
446	        event     = $Event
447	    }
448	
449	    # Replace known variables via .Replace() (PS 5.1 compatible)
450	    $rendered = $template
451	    foreach ($vk in $vars.Keys) {
452	        $rendered = $rendered.Replace("{$vk}", $vars[$vk])
453	    }
454	    # Strip any remaining unknown {word} placeholders
455	    $rendered = [regex]::Replace($rendered, '\{(\w+)\}', '')
456	
457	    return $rendered
458	}

460	function Resolve-TemplateSummary {
461	    param([object]$Event)
462	
463	    foreach ($key in @('last_assistant_message', 'last-assistant-message', 'prompt_response', 'transcript_summary', 'message')) {
464	        $prop = $Event.PSObject.Properties[$key]
465	        if ($prop) {
466	            $value = [string]$prop.Value
467	            if ($value) {
468	                $value = $value.Trim()
469	                if ($value) {
470	                    if ($value.Length -gt 120) { return $value.Substring(0, 120) }
471	                    return $value
472	                }
473	            }
474	        }
475	    }
476	
477	    return ''
478	}

481	function Resolve-TtsBackend {
482	    param([string]$Backend = "auto")
483	    switch ($Backend) {
484	        "native"     { return "tts-native.ps1" }
485	        "elevenlabs" { return "tts-elevenlabs.ps1" }
486	        "piper"      { return "tts-piper.ps1" }
487	        "auto" {
488	            # Probe in priority order: prefer premium when installed.
489	            foreach ($b in @("elevenlabs", "piper", "native")) {
490	                $scriptName = Resolve-TtsBackend -Backend $b
491	                $full = Join-Path $InstallDir "scripts\$scriptName"
492	                if (Test-Path $full) { return $scriptName }
493	            }
494	            return $null
495	        }
496	        default { return $null }
497	    }
498	}
499	
500	# --- TTS speak function ---
501	function Invoke-TtsSpeak {
502	    param(
503	        [string]$Text,
504	        [string]$Backend = "auto",
505	        [string]$Voice = "default",
506	        [double]$Rate = 1.0,
507	        [double]$Volume = 0.5
508	    )
509	    if (-not $Text) { return }
510	
511	    # Kill previous TTS
512	    $pidFile = Join-Path $InstallDir ".tts.pid"
513	    if (Test-Path $pidFile) {
514	        $oldPid = Get-Content $pidFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
515	        if ($oldPid) {
516	            try { Stop-Process -Id $oldPid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch { $null }
517	        }
518	        Remove-Item $pidFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
519	    }
520	
521	    $scriptName = Resolve-TtsBackend -Backend $Backend
522	    if (-not $scriptName) { return }
523	    $scriptPath = Join-Path $InstallDir "scripts\$scriptName"
524	    if (-not (Test-Path $scriptPath)) { return }
525	
526	    # Text is Base64-encoded to avoid shell metacharacter injection. Dynamic text
527	    # from template variables ({summary}, {project}) can contain double quotes,
528	    # dollar signs, backticks, and other PowerShell-interpreted characters that
529	    # would corrupt or break a directly-interpolated -Command string.
530	    $b64 = [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($Text))
531	    $proc = Start-Process -FilePath "powershell.exe" `
532	        -ArgumentList "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-Command",
533	            "[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String('$b64')) | & '$scriptPath' -voice '$Voice' -rate $Rate -vol $Volume" `
534	        -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
535	    $proc.Id | Set-Content $pidFile
536	}
537	
538	# --- CLI commands ---
539	if ($Command) {
540	    $InstallDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
541	    $ConfigPath = Join-Path $InstallDir "config.json"
542	
543	    # Ensure config exists
544	    if (-not (Test-Path $ConfigPath)) {
545	        Write-Host "Error: peon-ping not configured. Config not found at $ConfigPath" -ForegroundColor Red
546	        exit 1
547	    }
548	
549	    switch -Regex ($Command) {
550	        "^(--)?toggle$" {
551	            $raw = Get-PeonConfigRaw $ConfigPath
552	            $cfg = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json
553	            $newState = -not $cfg.enabled
554	            $raw = Get-Content $ConfigPath -Raw
555	            $updated = $raw -replace '"enabled"\s*:\s*(true|false)', "`"enabled`": $($newState.ToString().ToLower())"
556	            if ($updated -ne $raw) { Set-Content $ConfigPath -Value $updated -Encoding UTF8 }
557	            $state = if ($newState) { "ENABLED" } else { "PAUSED" }
558	            Write-Host "peon-ping: $state" -ForegroundColor Cyan
559	            return
560	        }
561	        "^(--)?(pause|mute)$" {
562	            $raw = Get-Content $ConfigPath -Raw
563	            $updated = $raw -replace '"enabled"\s*:\s*(true|false)', '"enabled": false'
564	            if ($updated -ne $raw) { Set-Content $ConfigPath -Value $updated -Encoding UTF8 }
565	            Write-Host "peon-ping: PAUSED" -ForegroundColor Yellow
566	            return
567	        }
568	        "^(--)?(resume|unmute)$" {
569	            $raw = Get-Content $ConfigPath -Raw
570	            $updated = $raw -replace '"enabled"\s*:\s*(true|false)', '"enabled": true'
571	            if ($updated -ne $raw) { Set-Content $ConfigPath -Value $updated -Encoding UTF8 }
572	            Write-Host "peon-ping: ENABLED" -ForegroundColor Green
573	            return
574	        }
575	        "^(--)?status$" {
576	            try {
577	                $cfg = Get-PeonConfigRaw $ConfigPath | ConvertFrom-Json
578	                $isVerbose = ($Arg1 -eq "--verbose" -or $Arg1 -eq "verbose")
579	
580	                # --- Essential info (always shown) ---
581	                $state = if ($cfg.enabled) { "ENABLED" } else { "PAUSED" }
582	                $versionFile = Join-Path $InstallDir "VERSION"
583	                $version = if (Test-Path $versionFile) { (Get-Content $versionFile -Raw).Trim() } else { "unknown" }
584	                Write-Host "peon-ping: $state | version $version | pack: $(Get-ActivePack $cfg) | volume: $($cfg.volume)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
585	
586	                # Pack count
587	                $packsDir = Join-Path $InstallDir "packs"
588	                $packCount = 0
589	                if (Test-Path $packsDir) {
590	                    $packCount = @(Get-ChildItem -Path $packsDir -Directory | Where-Object {
591	                        (Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName "openpeon.json")) -or
592	                        (Test-Path (Join-Path $_.FullName "manifest.json"))
593	                    }).Count
594	                }
595	                Write-Host "peon-ping: $packCount pack(s) installed" -ForegroundColor Cyan
596	
597	                if (-not $isVerbose) {
598	                    Write-Host 'peon-ping: run "peon status --verbose" for full details' -ForegroundColor DarkGray
599	                }
600	
601	                # --- Informational (verbose only) ---
602	                if ($isVerbose) {
603	                    # Desktop notifications
604	                    $dn = $cfg.desktop_notifications
605	                    if ($null -eq $dn) { $dn = $true }
606	                    $dnStatus = if ($dn) { "on" } else { "off (sounds still play)" }
607	                    Write-Host "peon-ping: desktop notifications $dnStatus" -ForegroundColor Cyan
608	
609	                    # Mobile notifications
610	                    $mn = $cfg.mobile_notify
611	                    if ($mn -and $mn.service) {
612	                        $mnEnabled = if ($null -eq $mn.enabled) { $true } else { $mn.enabled }
613	                        $mnStatus = if ($mnEnabled) { "on ($($mn.service))" } else { "off" }
614	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: mobile notifications $mnStatus" -ForegroundColor Cyan
615	                    } else {
616	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: mobile notifications not configured" -ForegroundColor Cyan
617	                    }
618	
619	                    # Notification templates
620	                    $tpls = $cfg.notification_templates
621	                    if ($tpls -and ($tpls.PSObject.Properties | Measure-Object).Count -gt 0) {
622	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: notification templates:" -ForegroundColor Cyan
623	                        foreach ($prop in $tpls.PSObject.Properties) {
624	                            Write-Host "  $($prop.Name) = `"$($prop.Value)`"" -ForegroundColor Cyan
625	                        }
626	                    }
627	
628	                    # Headphones-only mode
629	                    $headphonesOnly = $cfg.headphones_only
630	                    if ($headphonesOnly) {
631	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: headphones_only: on" -ForegroundColor Cyan
632	                    } else {
633	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: headphones_only: off" -ForegroundColor Cyan
634	                    }
635	
636	                    $statusIde = Normalize-IdeId ($env:PEON_IDE)
637	                    if (-not $statusIde) { $statusIde = Normalize-IdeId ($env:PEON_SESSION_SOURCE) }
638	                    if (-not $statusIde) { $statusIde = Normalize-IdeId ($env:PEON_SOURCE) }
639	                    if (-not $statusIde) { $statusIde = "claude" }
640	                    Write-Host "peon-ping: IDE source (status): $statusIde" -ForegroundColor Cyan
641	
642	                    # Path rules
643	                    $rules = @()
644	                    if ($cfg.path_rules) { $rules = @($cfg.path_rules) }
645	                    $excludeDirs = @()
646	                    if ($cfg.exclude_dirs) { $excludeDirs = @($cfg.exclude_dirs) }
647	                    $silencedPath = $null
648	                    foreach ($pattern in $excludeDirs) {
649	                        if (Test-PathRuleMatch $PWD.Path $pattern) {
650	                            $silencedPath = $pattern
651	                            break
652	                        }
653	                    }
654	                    if ($rules.Count -gt 0) {
655	                        $activeRule = $null
656	                        foreach ($r in $rules) {
657	                            if (Test-PathRuleMatch $PWD.Path $r.pattern) {
658	                                $activeRule = $r
659	                                break
660	                            }
661	                        }
662	                        if ($activeRule) {
663	                            Write-Host "peon-ping: active path rule: $($activeRule.pattern) -> $($activeRule.pack)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
664	                        }
665	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: path rules: $($rules.Count) configured" -ForegroundColor Cyan
666	                    }
667	                    Write-Host "peon-ping: silenced dirs (exclude_dirs): $($excludeDirs.Count) configured" -ForegroundColor Cyan
668	                    if ($silencedPath) {
669	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: SILENCED here: cwd matched exclude_dirs -> $silencedPath" -ForegroundColor Yellow
670	                    }
671	
672	                    $ideRules = @()
673	                    if ($cfg.ide_rules) { $ideRules = @($cfg.ide_rules) }
674	                    if ($ideRules.Count -gt 0) {
675	                        $activeIdeRule = $null
676	                        foreach ($rule in $ideRules) {
677	                            if ((Normalize-IdeId $rule.ide) -eq $statusIde) {
678	                                $activeIdeRule = $rule
679	                                break
680	                            }
681	                        }
682	                        if ($activeIdeRule) {
683	                            Write-Host "peon-ping: active IDE rule: $($activeIdeRule.ide) -> $($activeIdeRule.pack)" -ForegroundColor Cyan
684	                        }
685	                    }
686	                    Write-Host "peon-ping: IDE rules: $($ideRules.Count) configured" -ForegroundColor Cyan
687	
688	                    # Debug logging state
689	                    $debugEnabled = $env:PEON_DEBUG -eq "1"
690	                    $debugStatus = if ($debugEnabled) { "enabled" } else { "disabled" }
691	                    Write-Host "peon-ping: debug logging: $debugStatus" -ForegroundColor Cyan
692	                    if ($debugEnabled) {
693	                        $logDir = Join-Path $InstallDir "logs"
694	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: log dir: $logDir" -ForegroundColor Cyan
695	                    }
696	                }
697	            } catch {
698	                Write-Host "Error reading config: $_" -ForegroundColor Red
699	                exit 1
700	            }
701	            return
702	        }
703	        "^(--)?packs$" {
704	            $packsDir = Join-Path $InstallDir "packs"
705	            $cfg = Get-PeonConfigRaw $ConfigPath | ConvertFrom-Json
706	            $available = Get-InstalledPackNames -PacksDir $packsDir
707	            $packsAction = if ($Arg1) { $Arg1 } else { "list" }
708	            if ($packsAction -eq "list" -and $Arg2 -eq "--registry") {
709	                $packsAction = "community"
710	            }
711	
712	            switch ($packsAction) {
713	                "use" {
714	                    $installRequested = $false
715	                    if ($Arg2 -eq "--install") {
716	                        $installRequested = $true
717	                        $newPack = if ($ExtraArgs.Count -gt 0) { $ExtraArgs[0] } else { "" }
718	                    } else {
719	                        $newPack = $Arg2
720	                    }
721	
722	                    if (-not $newPack) {
723	                        Write-Host "Usage: peon packs use [--install] <pack-name>" -ForegroundColor Yellow
724	                        return
725	                    }
726	
727	                    if ($installRequested -or $newPack -notin $available) {
728	                        Write-Host "Pack '$newPack' not installed locally. Fetching from registry..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
729	                        $ok = Install-PackFromRegistry -PackName $newPack -PacksDir $packsDir
730	                        if (-not $ok) {
731	                            Write-Host "Pack '$newPack' not found in registry." -ForegroundColor Red
732	                            return
733	                        }
734	                        $available = Get-InstalledPackNames -PacksDir $packsDir
735	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: installed and switched to '$newPack'" -ForegroundColor Green
736	                    } else {
737	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: switched to '$newPack'" -ForegroundColor Green
738	                    }
739	                    Set-SelectedPack -ConfigPath $ConfigPath -PackName $newPack
740	                    return
741	                }
742	                "install" {
743	                    if (-not $Arg2) {
744	                        Write-Host "Usage: peon packs install <pack1,pack2> | --all" -ForegroundColor Yellow
745	                        return
746	                    }
747	
748	                    $targets = @()
749	                    if ($Arg2 -eq "--all") {
750	                        $reg = Get-PackRegistry
751	                        if (-not $reg) { return }
752	                        $targets = @($reg.packs | ForEach-Object { $_.name })
753	                    } else {
754	                        $targets = @($Arg2 -split ',' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ })
755	                    }
756	
757	                    if ($targets.Count -eq 0) {
758	                        Write-Host "Usage: peon packs install <pack1,pack2> | --all" -ForegroundColor Yellow
759	                        return
760	                    }
761	
762	                    $failed = @()
763	                    foreach ($packName in $targets) {
764	                        if (Install-PackFromRegistry -PackName $packName -PacksDir $packsDir) {
765	                            Write-Host "peon-ping: installed '$packName'" -ForegroundColor Green
766	                        } else {
767	                            $failed += $packName
768	                        }
769	                    }
770	
771	                    if ($failed.Count -gt 0) {
772	                        Write-Host "Error: failed to install: $($failed -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Red
773	                    }
774	                    return
775	                }
776	                "install-local" {
777	                    $installedPack = Install-PackFromLocal -SourceDir $Arg2 -PacksDir $packsDir
778	                    if ($installedPack) {
779	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: installed local pack '$installedPack'" -ForegroundColor Green
780	                    }
781	                    return
782	                }
783	                "next" {
784	                    $currentPack = Get-ActivePack $cfg
785	                    $newPack = Get-NextPackName -Available $available -CurrentPack $currentPack
786	                    if (-not $newPack) {
787	                        Write-Host "No packs installed." -ForegroundColor Yellow
788	                        return
789	                    }
790	                    Set-SelectedPack -ConfigPath $ConfigPath -PackName $newPack
791	                    Write-Host "peon-ping: switched to '$newPack'" -ForegroundColor Green
792	                    return
793	                }
794	                "remove" {
795	                    if (-not $Arg2) {
796	                        Write-Host "Usage: peon packs remove <pack1,pack2>" -ForegroundColor Yellow
797	                        return
798	                    }
799	
800	                    $targets = @($Arg2 -split ',' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ })
801	                    $currentPack = Get-ActivePack $cfg
802	                    $removedCurrent = $false
803	                    foreach ($packName in $targets) {
804	                        if ($packName -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$') {
805	                            Write-Host "Error: invalid pack name '$packName'." -ForegroundColor Red
806	                            continue
807	                        }
808	                        $packPath = Join-Path $packsDir $packName
809	                        if (-not (Test-Path $packPath -PathType Container)) {
810	                            Write-Host "Warning: pack '$packName' is not installed." -ForegroundColor Yellow
811	                            continue
812	                        }
813	                        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $packPath -Recurse -Force
814	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: removed '$packName'" -ForegroundColor Green
815	                        if ($packName -eq $currentPack) {
816	                            $removedCurrent = $true
817	                        }
818	                    }
819	
820	                    if ($removedCurrent) {
821	                        $available = Get-InstalledPackNames -PacksDir $packsDir
822	                        $fallbackPack = if ($available.Count -gt 0) { $available[0] } else { "peon" }
823	                        Set-SelectedPack -ConfigPath $ConfigPath -PackName $fallbackPack
824	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: active pack removed, switched to '$fallbackPack'" -ForegroundColor Yellow
825	                    }
826	                    return
827	                }
828	                "bind" {
829	                    if (-not $Arg2) {
830	                        Write-Host "Usage: peon packs bind <pack> [--pattern <glob>] [--install]" -ForegroundColor Yellow
831	                        return
832	                    }
833	                    $packName = $Arg2
834	                    $bindPattern = ""
835	                    $bindInstall = $false
836	                    # Parse extra args for --pattern and --install flags
837	                    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $ExtraArgs.Count; $i++) {
838	                        switch ($ExtraArgs[$i]) {
839	                            "--pattern" {
840	                                if ($i + 1 -lt $ExtraArgs.Count) {
841	                                    $bindPattern = $ExtraArgs[$i + 1]
842	                                    $i++  # Intentionally advance loop counter to skip the next arg (the pattern value)
843	                                }
844	                            }
845	                            "--install" { $bindInstall = $true }
846	                            default {
847	                                if ($ExtraArgs[$i] -match "^--pattern=(.+)$") {
848	                                    $bindPattern = $Matches[1]
849	                                }
850	                            }
851	                        }
852	                    }
853	
854	                    # If --install, download pack first
855	                    if ($bindInstall) {
856	                        if (Install-PackFromRegistry -PackName $packName -PacksDir $packsDir) {
857	                            $available = Get-InstalledPackNames -PacksDir $packsDir
858	                        } else {
859	                            Write-Host "Warning: could not download pack '$packName'" -ForegroundColor Yellow
860	                        }
861	                    }
862	
863	                    # Validate pack exists
864	                    if ($packName -notin $available) {
865	                        Write-Host "Error: pack `"$packName`" not found." -ForegroundColor Red
866	                        Write-Host "Available packs: $($available -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Red
867	                        exit 1
868	                    }
869	
870	                    # Default pattern is current directory
871	                    if (-not $bindPattern) {
872	                        $bindPattern = $PWD.Path
873	                    }
874	
875	                    # Load config as object for manipulation
876	                    $cfgObj = Get-Content $ConfigPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
877	                    $pathRules = @()
878	                    if ($cfgObj.path_rules) {
879	                        $pathRules = @($cfgObj.path_rules)
880	                    }
881	
882	                    # Update existing rule or append new one
883	                    $found = $false
884	                    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $pathRules.Count; $i++) {
885	                        if ($pathRules[$i].pattern -eq $bindPattern) {
886	                            $pathRules[$i] = [PSCustomObject]@{ pattern = $bindPattern; pack = $packName }
887	                            $found = $true
888	                            break
889	                        }
890	                    }
891	                    if (-not $found) {
892	                        $pathRules += [PSCustomObject]@{ pattern = $bindPattern; pack = $packName }
893	                    }
894	
895	                    if ($cfgObj.PSObject.Properties['path_rules']) {
896	                        $cfgObj.path_rules = $pathRules
897	                    } else {
898	                        $cfgObj | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'path_rules' -NotePropertyValue $pathRules
899	                    }
900	                    Set-PeonConfig $cfgObj $ConfigPath
901	                    Write-Host "peon-ping: bound $packName to $bindPattern"
902	                    if (-not ($ExtraArgs -contains "--pattern") -and -not ($ExtraArgs -match "^--pattern=")) {
903	                        $dirName = Split-Path $PWD.Path -Leaf
904	                        Write-Host "Tip: use --pattern `"*/$dirName`" to match any directory named $dirName"
905	                    }
906	                    return
907	                }
908	                "unbind" {
909	                    $unbindPattern = ""
910	                    # Arg2 could be --pattern or empty. Also check ExtraArgs.
911	                    if ($Arg2 -eq "--pattern") {
912	                        if ($ExtraArgs.Count -gt 0) {
913	                            $unbindPattern = $ExtraArgs[0]
914	                        }
915	                    } elseif ($Arg2 -match "^--pattern=(.+)$") {
916	                        $unbindPattern = $Matches[1]
917	                    } else {
918	                        # Check ExtraArgs for --pattern
919	                        for ($i = 0; $i -lt $ExtraArgs.Count; $i++) {
920	                            if ($ExtraArgs[$i] -eq "--pattern" -and ($i + 1) -lt $ExtraArgs.Count) {
921	                                $unbindPattern = $ExtraArgs[$i + 1]
922	                                break
923	                            } elseif ($ExtraArgs[$i] -match "^--pattern=(.+)$") {
924	                                $unbindPattern = $Matches[1]
925	                                break
926	                            }
927	                        }
928	                    }
929	
930	                    # Load config
931	                    $cfgObj = Get-Content $ConfigPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
932	                    $pathRules = @()
933	                    if ($cfgObj.path_rules) {
934	                        $pathRules = @($cfgObj.path_rules)
935	                    }
936	
937	                    if ($pathRules.Count -eq 0) {
938	                        Write-Host "No pack bindings configured."
939	                        return
940	                    }
941	
942	                    # Determine target pattern
943	                    $target = if ($unbindPattern) { $unbindPattern } else { $PWD.Path }
944	
945	                    # Try exact match
946	                    $newRules = @($pathRules | Where-Object { $_.pattern -ne $target })
947	                    if ($newRules.Count -lt $pathRules.Count) {
948	                        if ($cfgObj.PSObject.Properties['path_rules']) {
949	                            $cfgObj.path_rules = $newRules
950	                        } else {
951	                            $cfgObj | Add-Member -NotePropertyName 'path_rules' -NotePropertyValue $newRules
952	                        }
953	                        Set-PeonConfig $cfgObj $ConfigPath
954	                        Write-Host "peon-ping: unbound $target"
955	                        return
956	                    }
957	
958	                    # No exact match 鈥?check if any rules match cwd via -like
959	                    if (-not $unbindPattern) {
960	                        $matching = @($pathRules | Where-Object { $PWD.Path -like $_.pattern })
961	                        if ($matching.Count -gt 0) {
962	                            Write-Host "No binding for `"$target`", but found rules matching this directory:" -ForegroundColor Red
963	                            foreach ($r in $matching) {
964	                                Write-Host "  $($r.pattern) -> $($r.pack)" -ForegroundColor Red
965	                            }
966	                            Write-Host "Use --pattern to remove a specific rule." -ForegroundColor Red
967	                            exit 1
968	                        }
969	                    }
970	
971	                    Write-Host "No binding found for `"$target`"."
972	                    return
973	                }
974	                "bindings" {
975	                    $cfgObj = Get-Content $ConfigPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
976	                    $pathRules = @()
977	                    if ($cfgObj.path_rules) {
978	                        $pathRules = @($cfgObj.path_rules)
979	                    }
980	
981	                    if ($pathRules.Count -eq 0) {
982	                        Write-Host "No pack bindings configured."
983	                        return
984	                    }
985	
986	                    foreach ($rule in $pathRules) {
987	                        $marker = if (Test-PathRuleMatch $PWD.Path $rule.pattern) { " *" } else { "" }
988	                        Write-Host "  $($rule.pattern) -> $($rule.pack)$marker"
989	                    }
990	                    return
991	                }
992	                "ide-bind" {
993	                    if (-not $Arg2 -or $ExtraArgs.Count -eq 0) {
994	                        Write-Host "Usage: peon packs ide-bind <ide> <pack> [--install]" -ForegroundColor Yellow
995	                        return
996	                    }
997	                    $ideName = Normalize-IdeId $Arg2
998	                    $packName = $ExtraArgs[0]
999	                    $installPack = ($ExtraArgs -contains "--install")
1000	                    if (-not $ideName) {
1001	                        Write-Host "Error: IDE id must not be empty." -ForegroundColor Red
1002	                        return
1003	                    }
1004	                    if ($installPack -and $packName -notin $available) {
1005	                        $ok = Install-PackFromRegistry -PackName $packName -PacksDir $packsDir
1006	                        if (-not $ok) { return }
1007	                        $available = Get-ChildItem -Path $packsDir -Directory | Where-Object {
1008	                            (Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $_.FullName "sounds") -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count -gt 0
1009	                        } | ForEach-Object { $_.Name } | Sort-Object
1010	                    }
1011	                    if ($packName -notin $available) {
1012	                        Write-Host "Error: pack `"$packName`" not found." -ForegroundColor Red
1013	                        Write-Host "Available packs: $($available -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Red
1014	                        return
1015	                    }
1016	                    $cfgObj = Get-Content $ConfigPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
1017	                    $ideRules = @()
1018	                    if ($cfgObj.ide_rules) { $ideRules = @($cfgObj.ide_rules) }
1019	                    $found = $false
1020	                    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $ideRules.Count; $i++) {
1021	                        if ((Normalize-IdeId $ideRules[$i].ide) -eq $ideName) {
1022	                            $ideRules[$i] = [PSCustomObject]@{ ide = $ideName; pack = $packName }
1023	                            $found = $true
1024	                            break
1025	                        }
1026	                    }
1027	                    if (-not $found) {
1028	                        $ideRules += [PSCustomObject]@{ ide = $ideName; pack = $packName }
1029	                    }
1030	                    if ($cfgObj.PSObject.Properties['ide_rules']) {
