+## 套件 registry
+
+套用時的 installer 與互動式 shell（`profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`）共用同一份政策：
+
+- **受管機器**的 pip/uv 走公司 PyPI pull-through registry，npm 走公司 npm
+  pull-through registry。PyPI 路徑已用 `tomlkit==0.13.3` 驗證，artifact 由公司
+  Azure Artifacts backend 提供。NuGet 的公司 source 與停用 nuget.org 已由 IT
+  machine-wide 配置，因此 dotfiles 不覆寫 NuGet 設定。
+- **China mirrors** 只在非受管機器生效，把 pip / npm / cargo / go / node 導向
+  清華 / npmmirror / goproxy.cn / rsproxy。
+- 未找到公司的 Go 或 Cargo registry，因此受管機器保留這兩者既有預設值。
+
+若兩個 toggle 同時為 true，受管機器政策優先，避免 GFW mirror 繞過公司套件政策。

new file mode 100644

+++ b/tests/PackageSources.Tests.ps1
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+#Requires -Version 7
+
+BeforeAll {
+    $RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
+    $TemplatePath = Join-Path $RepoRoot '.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1'
+
+    function Render-PackageSources {
+        param([bool] $ManagedMachine, [bool] $UseChineseMirror)
+        $data = @{
+            managedMachine   = $ManagedMachine
+            useChineseMirror = $UseChineseMirror
+        } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
+        $rendered = & chezmoi execute-template --source $RepoRoot --override-data $data --file $TemplatePath
+        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'failed to render package-source policy' }
+        $rendered -join "`n"
+    }
+}
+
+Describe 'shared package-source policy' {
+    It 'uses company PyPI and npm registries on managed machines' {
+        $rendered = Render-PackageSources -ManagedMachine $true -UseChineseMirror $false
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'packagefeedproxy\.microsoft\.io/pypi/simple/'
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'packagefeedproxy\.microsoft\.io/npm/'
+        $rendered | Should -Not -Match 'tuna|npmmirror|goproxy|rsproxy'
+    }
+
+    It 'keeps managed-machine policy ahead of China mirrors' {
+        $rendered = Render-PackageSources -ManagedMachine $true -UseChineseMirror $true
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'packagefeedproxy\.microsoft\.io/pypi/simple/'
+        $rendered | Should -Not -Match 'tuna|npmmirror|goproxy|rsproxy'
+    }
+
+    It 'uses China mirrors only on an unmanaged opted-in machine' {
+        $rendered = Render-PackageSources -ManagedMachine $false -UseChineseMirror $true
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'pypi\.tuna\.tsinghua\.edu\.cn'
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'registry\.npmmirror\.com'
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'goproxy\.cn'
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'rsproxy\.cn'
+        $rendered | Should -Not -Match 'packagefeedproxy\.microsoft\.io'
+    }
+
+    It 'sets no registry overrides by default on an unmanaged machine' {
+        $rendered = Render-PackageSources -ManagedMachine $false -UseChineseMirror $false
+        $rendered | Should -Not -Match '\$env:(PIP_INDEX_URL|UV_DEFAULT_INDEX|npm_config_registry|GOPROXY)\s*='
+    }
+
+    It 'is embedded by both install-time and interactive-shell entry points' {
+        Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $RepoRoot '.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl') |
+            Should -Match 'template "package-sources\.ps1"'
+        Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $RepoRoot 'dot_config/powershell/profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1.tmpl') |
+            Should -Match 'template "package-sources\.ps1"'
+    }
+}

1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) and other coding
4	agents when working with code in this repository. `CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to this file.
5	
6	## What this is
7	
8	Standalone, **Windows-only** dotfiles managed by [chezmoi](https://chezmoi.io),
9	targeting **PowerShell 7 (pwsh)**. It is a companion to the cross-platform
10	macOS/Linux repo `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` — the PowerShell layer is written
11	natively, **not** ported from that repo's POSIX shell config. No ansible;
12	packages install via **scoop** (CLI) + **winget** (GUI). Published at
13	`github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows`.
14	
15	**Dev box vs target:** the deploy target is Windows, but this checkout is usually
16	edited on macOS/Linux. You therefore **cannot execute the `.ps1` run-scripts
17	here** (they call winget / `%APPDATA%`). Validate with the isolated-apply +
18	render/parse pattern below; the `windows-latest` CI is the real gate.
19	
20	## Commands
21	
22	Real machine:
23	
24	- `chezmoi apply` / `chezmoi diff` (or `just apply` / `just diff`)
25	- `just upgrade-scoop` / `just upgrade-winget`
26	
27	Validate locally (needs a local pwsh, e.g. installed to `~/.local/bin/pwsh`):
28	
29	- Lint: `pwsh -NoProfile -c "Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse -Settings ./PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1"` (fails only on Error; the excludes are deliberate — see the settings file header)
30	- Tests: `pwsh -NoProfile -c "Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests"` (single file: `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/Copilot.Tests.ps1`)
31	- Docs: `just docs-build` (= `uv run --with mkdocs-material --with mkdocs-static-i18n mkdocs build --strict`)
32	
33	Isolated apply + template render (the core idiom for testing without a Windows
34	box — all chezmoi state is redirected to a temp dir, so it never touches your
35	real setup):
36	
37	```bash
38	TMPD=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$TMPD/home"
39	chezmoi init --source="$PWD" --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --persistent-state="$TMPD/s.db" \
40	  --destination="$TMPD/home" --no-tty \
41	  --promptChoice='Role: workstation (full desktop) or minimal (shell only)=minimal' \
42	  --promptString='Your full name (git)=T' --promptString='Your git email=t@e.com' ...  # EVERY prompt, exact text
43	chezmoi apply --source="$PWD" --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --persistent-state="$TMPD/s.db" \
44	  --destination="$TMPD/home" --exclude=scripts   # scripts can't run off-Windows
45	chezmoi execute-template --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --source="$PWD" < some.ps1.tmpl > r.ps1  # then parse r.ps1 with pwsh
46	```
47	
48	## Architecture (big picture)
49	
50	- **Init** — `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` `[data]` prompts once (`role` → coarse defaults, then `installX` toggles) and sets `[interpreters.ps1] = pwsh` so chezmoi runs `.ps1` scripts under pwsh. Prompts are hand-authored here (the parent repo generates them; this repo does not).
51	- **Shell** — `Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1` is a thin `$PROFILE` loader that dot-sources `dot_config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in numeric order (env → tool activation → aliases → apps/audio/clipboard → copilot import → yazi → tv cache → psreadline). Add a shell feature = a new numbered fragment. User overrides go in the untracked `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1`.

60	
61	## Conventions & hard invariants
62	
63	1. **A new/renamed init prompt must update the CI flags in the same commit.** `chezmoi init --promptBool/--promptChoice "<text>=value"` matches the prompt's exact TEXT (3rd arg to `promptXOnce` in `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`), used non-interactively by `.github/workflows/windows.yml`. Forget it → CI's init hangs/EOFs (`error calling promptChoiceOnce: EOF`; this broke three consecutive pushes when `agentSounds` was added). Corollary: **never put `=` in a prompt's text** — the `name=value` parser splits on the first `=` (this broke the `role` prompt once). Enforced by `tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` (missing flag, stale flag, wrong flag kind, `=` in text), which CI runs *before* `chezmoi init` so the failure names the missing flag instead of EOF-ing — run `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` locally after touching either file.
64	2. **Run-scripts must never abort the apply.** The installer + editor/terminal/backup/skill scripts use `$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'` (+ `PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference=$false`), collect failures via `Register-Failure`, print a summary, and exit 0. One bad scoop/winget manifest (e.g. btop's stale `.conf`) must not stop the rest.
65	3. **Preserve raw escapes when authoring config with control chars.** Alacritty CSI-u (`[…u`), VSCode `sendSequence`, tv `\t` — hand-typing tends to drop them. Generate via a throwaway Python script and re-parse (`tomllib` / `json`) to confirm the escape landed.
66	4. **tv channel commands are `pwsh -NoProfile -Command "…"` inside TOML literal (`'''…'''`) strings** — runs regardless of tv's shell, sidesteps nested-quote escaping; placeholders `{split: :0}` (space) / `{split:\t:0}` (tab). tv reads config from `%APPDATA%\television\` on Windows.
67	5. **Editors use a run_onchange pwsh merger, not `modify_`** (`modify_` interpreter selection is unreliable on Windows). Overlay sources live in `editors/` (chezmoi-ignored, embedded via `{{ include }}`).
68	6. **The agent skill body lives once** in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`; both `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` and `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` render it via `{{ "{{" }} template … {{ "}}" }}` → real files at `~/.agents/skills/` and `~/.claude/skills/`. Edit the shared template, not the two one-line renderers (no symlink/junction — those need elevation/Developer Mode on Windows).
69	7. **PSScriptAnalyzer exclusions are intentional** (`PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1`): hyphenated command names, `Write-Host`, `Invoke-Expression` for tool init, no-BOM UTF-8. Don't "fix" these; do fix real Errors.
70	
71	### Cross-file mirrors (same commit)
72	
73	- New installer tool → `docs/tools.md` **and** `docs/tools.zh-TW.md`.
74	- New init prompt → `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` + `windows.yml` flags + `docs/setup.md`/`setup.zh-TW.md` tables + the "What's enabled" block in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.
75	- New `docs/**/*.md` → its `.zh-TW.md` twin + `nav` + `nav_translations` in `mkdocs.yml`; `just docs-build` must stay green.
76	- Any edit under `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` → copy the file verbatim into the parent repo's `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` (`chezmoi source-path` there, usually `~/.local/share/chezmoi`). They must stay byte-identical; verify with `diff -r`. Frontend-only changes (`weasel.custom.yaml`) do **not** cross over.
77	- `dot_config/powershell/copilot-throttle-shim.js` is copied verbatim from the parent repo's `dot_config/shell/copilot-throttle-shim.js`. Update both in the same maintenance session, then update the reviewed Unix source commit + SHA-256 contract in `tests/Copilot.Tests.ps1`; the Windows test must remain runnable without a sibling checkout.
78	- `core.autocrlf = input` has **two writers** — `bootstrap.ps1` (runs before chezmoi exists, so scoop's first bucket clone is protected) and `.chezmoitemplates/git/gitconfig` (the managed baseline). Change one → change the other.
79	
80	### `scripts/*.sh` are wrappers, not implementations
81	
82	`scripts/{add-todo,todo-kanban,promote-todo,sweep-inbox}.sh` are byte-identical
83	three-line shims. The real code is vendored at
84	`.agents/skills/project-knowledge-harness/scripts/<same-name>.sh`, and each
85	wrapper derives its target from `$0`, so adding a new helper only needs a copy
86	of an existing wrapper under the new name.
87	
88	They exist because the skill documents its helpers with cwd-relative paths
89	(`scripts/add-todo.sh`) and that prose was copied verbatim into the guidance
90	block below — where `scripts/` means *this* directory. Fixing the prose instead
91	would not survive, because `project-knowledge-harness` regenerates everything
92	between its sentinel markers. **This note is deliberately above the opening
93	sentinel so regeneration cannot erase it.**
94	
95	Not symlinks — invariant 6 (symlinks/junctions need elevation or Developer
96	Mode on Windows).
97	
98	<!-- project-knowledge-harness:agent-guidance -->
99	<!-- Snippet for the project's agent contract file (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md /
100	     similar). The bundled scripts/init.sh appends this between sentinel
101	     markers; safe to re-run. -->
102	
103	### Long-term backlog → `TODO.md` + `backlog/`
104	
105	When the user surfaces an idea explicitly **not** being implemented this
106	session (signals: "maybe later", "nice to have", "if I'm interested",
107	"工程量太大需要再評估", "先記下來"), add an entry to [`TODO.md`](TODO.md) using
108	the priority + effort tag schema. Do **not** create new `ROADMAP.md` /
109	`IDEAS.md` / `BACKLOG.md` files — `TODO.md` is the single index.
110	
111	The bundled `scripts/todo-kanban.sh` validates the format. Run it
112	(`scripts/todo-kanban.sh --validate-only TODO.md`) after editing so syntax
113	drift is caught immediately.
114	
115	#### Three ways to add a TODO entry (preferred order)
116	
117	1. **Structured CLI — `scripts/add-todo.sh`** (default):
118	
119	   ```
120	   scripts/add-todo.sh --priority P3 --effort M \
121	     --title "Title" --description "Description"
122	   ```
123	
124	   Inserts a canonically-formatted line into the right `## P*` lane and
125	   re-runs the validator. Add `--backlog` to also scaffold
126	   `backlog/<slug>.md` from the bundled template.
127	
128	2. **Quick capture — `backlog/inbox.md`** (when priority/effort unclear):
129	
130	   ```
131	   echo "- maybe add docs versioning with mike" >> backlog/inbox.md
132	   ```
133	
134	   When the user asks "sweep the inbox", run
135	   `scripts/sweep-inbox.sh`. It prompts for the missing fields per loose
136	   line and calls `add-todo.sh`. Use `--batch` for non-interactive runs
137	   that only formalize lines with parseable `key=value` pairs.
138	
139	3. **Direct edit of `TODO.md`** — fine if the format is fresh; run
140	   `scripts/todo-kanban.sh --validate-only` afterwards.
141	
142	Add a `backlog/<slug>.md` companion doc when the item meets any of:
143	
144	- carries a `P?` tag (record what was tried so it doesn't need re-investigation)
145	- captures a paused troubleshooting session that you intend to fix later
146	  (preserve the error trace + root cause analysis before context evaporates)
147	- weighs multiple options (record trade-offs, not only the winner)
148	- is `[L]` or `[XL]` (architectural; needs design before code)
149	
150	`[S]` items rarely need a backlog doc — a file path in the `TODO.md` line is
151	usually enough. See [`backlog/README.md`](backlog/README.md) for the full
152	template and "when to add a doc" rules.
153	
154	When implementing a `TODO.md` item, in the same commit:
155	
156	1. Run `scripts/promote-todo.sh --title "<substring>" --summary "<what shipped>"`
157	   to move the entry into `## Done` with the dated syntax and re-validate.
158	2. Mark the corresponding `backlog/<slug>.md` (if any) `Status: shipped`
159	   and keep it as a historical record (don't delete — future-you may
160	   revisit adjacent decisions).
161	
162	`backlog/` is excluded from chezmoi (see .chezmoiignore); it
163	is repo metadata for maintainers, not user-facing config to deploy.
164	
165	### Past pitfalls → `pitfalls/`
166	
167	When you spend more than ~15 minutes debugging something that wasn't
168	googleable and the fix is non-obvious, write a `pitfalls/<slug>.md`
169	capturing:
170	
171	1. **Verbatim symptom** — copy-paste error messages exactly, do not
172	   paraphrase (preserves grep-ability for future-you / future agent)
173	2. **Root cause** — why this happens (with source / docs / upstream issue link)
174	3. **Workaround** — copy-pasteable commands or config diff
175	4. **Prevention** — how to avoid stepping on this again
176	
177	Title the doc by the **symptom**, not the root cause (you'll search by what
178	you're seeing, not by what you eventually learned). See
179	[`pitfalls/README.md`](pitfalls/README.md) for the full template and
180	when-to-add rules.
181	
182	**Pitfall vs Hard invariant**: a pitfall *graduates* to a Hard invariant in
183	this file when it (a) recurs across machines/agents/sessions despite being
184	documented, (b) silently corrupts state, or (c) the workaround is non-obvious
185	enough that "remember to do X" isn't safe. When graduating, leave the
186	`pitfalls/<slug>.md` as historical record and link to it from the new
187	invariant.
188	
189	`pitfalls/` is excluded from chezmoi (see .chezmoiignore) and
190	**not** auto-redacted; review for secrets before committing.
191	<!-- project-knowledge-harness:agent-guidance --> (end)

# Pester tests for the shared pueue daemon bootstrap and installer regressions.

BeforeAll {
    $RepoRoot = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..'
    $Bootstrap = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'scripts' 'pueue-bootstrap.ps1'
    $PackageTemplate = Join-Path $RepoRoot '.chezmoiscripts' 'run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl'
    $ProfileTemplate = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'dot_config' 'powershell' 'profile.d' '12_pueue.ps1.tmpl'
    $SpecstoryScript = Join-Path $RepoRoot 'scripts' 'build-specstory.ps1'
}

Describe 'Pueue daemon bootstrap' {
    BeforeEach {
        . $Bootstrap
        $script:ClientCalls = 0
        $script:ReadyAfter = 2
        $script:DaemonCalls = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

        function global:Invoke-FakePueue {
            $script:ClientCalls++
            $global:LASTEXITCODE = if ($script:ClientCalls -ge $script:ReadyAfter) { 0 } else { 1 }
        }
        function global:Invoke-FakePueued {
            $script:DaemonCalls.Add(($args -join ' '))
            $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
        }
        $script:CreatedGetServiceStub = -not [bool](Get-Command Get-Service -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
        if ($script:CreatedGetServiceStub) {
            function global:Get-Service {
                [CmdletBinding()]
                param([string]$Name)
                $null = $Name
            }
        }

        Mock Resolve-PueueCommand {
            if ($Name -eq 'pueue') { return 'Invoke-FakePueue' }
            return 'Invoke-FakePueued'
        }
        Mock Test-PueueAdministrator { return $false }
        Mock Start-Sleep {}
    }

    AfterEach {
        Remove-Item Function:\Invoke-FakePueue, Function:\Invoke-FakePueued -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($script:CreatedGetServiceStub) {
            Remove-Item Function:\Get-Service -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        }
    }

+# pueue-bootstrap.ps1 — make the pueue client usable without a manual daemon
+# terminal. Included into both the package installer and the PowerShell profile.
+
+function Resolve-PueueCommand {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
+        [ValidateSet('pueue', 'pueued')]
+        [string]$Name
+    )
+
+    $command = Get-Command $Name -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
+        Select-Object -First 1
+    if ($command) { return $command.Source }
+
+    # A first-time Scoop install can create the shim after this pwsh process
+    # captured PATH. Resolve the stable `current` junction as a fallback.
+    $scoop = Get-Command scoop -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
+        Select-Object -First 1
+    if (-not $scoop) { return $null }
+
+    $prefixOutput = @(& $scoop.Source prefix pueue 2>$null)
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $prefixOutput) { return $null }
+    $prefix = ([string]$prefixOutput[-1]).Trim()
+    $candidate = Join-Path $prefix "$Name.exe"
+    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate) { return $candidate }
+    return $null
+}
+
+function Test-PueueAdministrator {
+    if (-not $IsWindows) { return $false }
+    try {
+        $identity = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
+        $principal = [Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal]$identity
+        return $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
+    } catch {
+        return $false
+    }
+}
+
+function Test-PueuedReady {
+    param([AllowNull()][string]$ClientPath)
+
+    if (-not $ClientPath) { $ClientPath = Resolve-PueueCommand -Name pueue }
+    if (-not $ClientPath) { return $false }
+    try {
+        & $ClientPath status *> $null
+        return ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0)
+    } catch {
+        return $false
+    }
+}
+
+function Wait-PueuedReady {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ClientPath,
+        [int]$TimeoutMilliseconds = 3000
+    )
+
+    $attempts = [Math]::Max(1, [Math]::Ceiling($TimeoutMilliseconds / 100))
+    foreach ($attempt in 1..$attempts) {
+        if (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $ClientPath) { return $true }
+        if ($attempt -lt $attempts) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }
+    }
+    return $false
+}
+
+function Start-PueuedIfNeeded {
+    [CmdletBinding()]
+    param(
+        # The package installer opts into Pueue 4's built-in Windows service.
+        # A normal shell never changes service state; it only uses daemon mode.
+        [switch]$InstallService,
+        [switch]$Quiet,
+        [int]$ReadyTimeoutMilliseconds = 3000
+    )
+
+    $clientPath = Resolve-PueueCommand -Name pueue
+    $daemonPath = Resolve-PueueCommand -Name pueued
+    if (-not $clientPath -or -not $daemonPath) {
+        if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning 'pueue/pueued not found after installation' }
+        return $false
+    }
+
+    if (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $clientPath) {
+        if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued already running' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
+        return $true
+    }
+
+    if ($InstallService -and (Test-PueueAdministrator)) {
+        try {
+            $service = Get-Service -Name pueued -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+            if (-not $service) {
+                if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued: installing built-in Windows service' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
+                if ($Quiet) { & $daemonPath service install *> $null }
+                else { & $daemonPath service install 2>&1 | Out-Host }
+                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and -not $Quiet) {
+                    Write-Warning 'pueued service install failed; falling back to daemon mode'
+                }
+                $service = Get-Service -Name pueued -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+            }
+
+            if ($service) {
+                if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued: starting Windows service' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
+                if ($Quiet) { & $daemonPath service start *> $null }
+                else { & $daemonPath service start 2>&1 | Out-Host }
+                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and -not $Quiet) {
+                    Write-Warning 'pueued service start failed; falling back to daemon mode'
+                }
+                if (Wait-PueuedReady -ClientPath $clientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds $ReadyTimeoutMilliseconds) {
+                    return $true
+                }
+            }
+        } catch {
+            if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning "pueued service setup failed; falling back to daemon mode: $_" }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued: starting detached daemon' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
+    try {
+        if ($Quiet) { & $daemonPath --daemonize *> $null }
+        else { & $daemonPath --daemonize 2>&1 | Out-Host }
+        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
+            if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning "pueued --daemonize failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
+            return $false
+        }
+    } catch {
+        if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning "pueued --daemonize failed: $_" }
+        return $false
+    }
+
+    $ready = Wait-PueuedReady -ClientPath $clientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds $ReadyTimeoutMilliseconds
+    if (-not $ready -and -not $Quiet) { Write-Warning 'pueued started but did not become ready' }
+    return $ready
+}

1	# pueue-bootstrap.ps1 — make the pueue client usable without a manual daemon
2	# terminal. Included into both the package installer and the PowerShell profile.
3	
4	function Resolve-PueueCommand {
5	    param(
6	        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
7	        [ValidateSet('pueue', 'pueued')]
8	        [string]$Name
9	    )
10	
11	    $command = Get-Command $Name -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
12	        Select-Object -First 1
13	    if ($command) { return $command.Source }
14	
15	    # A first-time Scoop install can create the shim after this pwsh process
16	    # captured PATH. Resolve the stable `current` junction as a fallback.
17	    $scoop = Get-Command scoop -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
18	        Select-Object -First 1
19	    if (-not $scoop) { return $null }
20	
21	    $prefixOutput = @(& $scoop.Source prefix pueue 2>$null)
22	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $prefixOutput) { return $null }
23	    $prefix = ([string]$prefixOutput[-1]).Trim()
24	    $candidate = Join-Path $prefix "$Name.exe"
25	    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate) { return $candidate }
26	    return $null
27	}
28	
29	function Test-PueueAdministrator {
30	    if (-not $IsWindows) { return $false }
31	    try {
32	        $identity = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
33	        $principal = [Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal]$identity
34	        return $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
35	    } catch {
36	        return $false
37	    }
38	}
39	
40	function Test-PueuedReady {
41	    param(
42	        [AllowNull()][string]$ClientPath,
43	        [int]$TimeoutMilliseconds = 500
44	    )
45	
46	    if (-not $ClientPath) { $ClientPath = Resolve-PueueCommand -Name pueue }
47	    if (-not $ClientPath) { return $false }
48	    $process = $null
49	    try {
50	        $process = Start-Process -FilePath $ClientPath -ArgumentList 'status' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
51	        if (-not $process.WaitForExit([Math]::Max(1, $TimeoutMilliseconds))) {
52	            try { $process.Kill($true) } catch { $null = $_ }
53	            return $false
54	        }
55	        return ($process.ExitCode -eq 0)
56	    } catch {
57	        return $false
58	    } finally {
59	        if ($process) { $process.Dispose() }
60	    }
61	}
62	
63	function Wait-PueuedReady {
64	    param(
65	        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ClientPath,
66	        [int]$TimeoutMilliseconds = 3000
67	    )
68	
69	    $timeout = [Math]::Max(1, $TimeoutMilliseconds)
70	    $clock = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
71	    while ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -lt $timeout) {
72	        $remaining = $timeout - [int]$clock.ElapsedMilliseconds
73	        if (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $ClientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds ([Math]::Min(500, $remaining))) {
74	            return $true
75	        }
76	        $remaining = $timeout - [int]$clock.ElapsedMilliseconds
77	        if ($remaining -le 0) { break }
78	        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds ([Math]::Min(100, $remaining))
79	    }
80	    return (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $ClientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds 1)
81	}
82	
83	function Start-PueuedIfNeeded {
84	    [CmdletBinding()]
85	    param(
86	        # The package installer opts into Pueue 4's built-in Windows service.
87	        # A normal shell never changes service state; it only uses daemon mode.
88	        [switch]$InstallService,
89	        [switch]$Quiet,
90	        [int]$ReadyTimeoutMilliseconds = 3000
91	    )
92	
93	    $clientPath = Resolve-PueueCommand -Name pueue
94	    $daemonPath = Resolve-PueueCommand -Name pueued
95	    if (-not $clientPath -or -not $daemonPath) {
96	        if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning 'pueue/pueued not found after installation' }
97	        return $false
98	    }
99	
100	    if (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $clientPath) {
101	        if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued already running' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
102	        return $true
103	    }
104	
105	    if ($InstallService -and (Test-PueueAdministrator)) {
106	        try {
107	            $service = Get-Service -Name pueued -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
108	            if (-not $service) {
109	                if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued: installing built-in Windows service' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
110	                if ($Quiet) { & $daemonPath service install *> $null }
111	                else { & $daemonPath service install 2>&1 | Out-Host }
112	                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and -not $Quiet) {
113	                    Write-Warning 'pueued service install failed; falling back to daemon mode'
114	                }
115	                $service = Get-Service -Name pueued -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
116	            }
117	
118	            if ($service) {
119	                if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued: starting Windows service' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
120	                if ($Quiet) { & $daemonPath service start *> $null }
121	                else { & $daemonPath service start 2>&1 | Out-Host }
122	                $serviceStartExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
123	                if ($serviceStartExitCode -ne 0) {
124	                    if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning 'pueued service start failed; falling back to daemon mode' }
125	                } elseif (Wait-PueuedReady -ClientPath $clientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds $ReadyTimeoutMilliseconds) {
126	                    return $true
127	                } else {
128	                    if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning 'pueued service started but did not become ready' }
129	                    return $false
130	                }
131	            }
132	        } catch {
133	            if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning "pueued service setup failed; falling back to daemon mode: $_" }
134	        }
135	    }
136	
137	    if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued: starting detached daemon' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
138	    try {
139	        # Pueue's daemonized child inherits stdio. PowerShell native redirection
140	        # therefore waits forever for pipe EOF even after the launcher exits.
141	        Start-Process -FilePath $daemonPath -ArgumentList '--daemonize' -WindowStyle Hidden
142	    } catch {
143	        if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning "pueued --daemonize failed: $_" }
144	        return $false
145	    }
146	
147	    $ready = Wait-PueuedReady -ClientPath $clientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds $ReadyTimeoutMilliseconds
148	    if (-not $ready -and -not $Quiet) { Write-Warning 'pueued started but did not become ready' }
149	    return $ready
150	}

357	        }
358	    }

390	function script:Get-CopilotSha256Base64 {
391	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Path)
392	    $stream = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($Path)
393	    try {
394	        $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
395	        try { [Convert]::ToBase64String($sha.ComputeHash($stream)) } finally { $sha.Dispose() }
396	    } finally { $stream.Dispose() }
397	}

399	function script:Install-CopilotPkgDependencies {
400	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $PackageDir, [int] $BudgetSeconds = 120)
401	    $npm = Get-Command npm.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
402	    if (-not $npm) {
403	        Write-Error 'copilot-proxy: npm.cmd is required to install CDN package dependencies through the configured registry'
404	        return $false
405	    }
406	    try {
407	        $npmArgs = @('install', '--omit=dev', '--ignore-scripts', '--no-save', '--package-lock=false', '--no-audit', '--no-fund')
408	        $p = Start-Process -FilePath $npm.Source -ArgumentList $npmArgs -WorkingDirectory $PackageDir -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ErrorAction Stop
409	        if (-not $p.WaitForExit($BudgetSeconds * 1000)) {
410	            Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
411	            return $false
412	        }
413	        return (Test-CopilotPkgDependencies)
414	    } catch {
415	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not install CDN package dependencies ($_)"
416	        return $false
417	    }

420	function script:Install-CopilotPkgFromCdn {
421	    $manifest = Get-CopilotPkgCdnManifest
422	    if (-not $manifest) { return $false }
423	    if (-not (Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget)) { return $false }
424	
425	    $packageDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) 'node_modules/@jeffreycao/copilot-api'
426	    $downloadDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) ".cdn-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
427	    try {
428	        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $downloadDir | Out-Null
429	        foreach ($relativePath in $manifest.Files.Keys) {
430	            $downloadPath = Join-Path $downloadDir ($relativePath -replace '/', [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)
431	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $downloadPath) | Out-Null
432	            Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($manifest.BaseUrl + $relativePath) -OutFile $downloadPath -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30 -ErrorAction Stop
433	            $actualHash = Get-CopilotSha256Base64 -Path $downloadPath
434	            if ($actualHash -cne $manifest.Files[$relativePath]) {
435	                throw "hash mismatch for $relativePath"
436	            }
437	        }
438	
439	        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $packageDir) | Out-Null
440	        Move-Item -LiteralPath $downloadDir -Destination $packageDir -ErrorAction Stop
441	        $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
442	        if (-not $metadata -or $metadata.Name -cne '@jeffreycao/copilot-api' -or $metadata.Version -cne '2.1.0') {
443	            throw 'downloaded package metadata does not identify @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0'
444	        }
445	        if (-not (Install-CopilotPkgDependencies -PackageDir $packageDir)) {
446	            throw 'dependency installation through the configured registry failed'
447	        }
448	        return (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled)
449	    } catch {
450	        Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: pinned CDN fallback failed ($_)"
451	        $null = Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget
452	        return $false
453	    } finally {
454	        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $downloadDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
455	    }
456	}

458	# Ensure the pinned spec is installed. No-op (and no network) once it is.
459	function script:Install-CopilotPkg {
460	    if (-not (Get-CopilotPkgSpecInfo)) {
461	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_API_PKG must be a registry package spec (name or @scope/name with an optional version/tag/range); aliases and local/git/URL specs are unsupported: $(Get-CopilotPkg)"
462	        return $false
463	    }
464	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) { return $true }
465	
466	    # Migrate the old one-line stamp without a network call only when an exact
467	    # selector, the legacy stamp, live package metadata and launch path all agree.
468	    $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
469	    if ((Get-CopilotPkgExactVersion) -and
470	        (Get-CopilotPkgLegacyStamp) -ceq (Get-CopilotPkg) -and
471	        (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled -Metadata $metadata)) {
472	        Write-CopilotPkgStamp -Metadata $metadata
473	        return $true
474	    }
475	
476	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
477	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return $false
478	    }
479	    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg; $prefix = Get-CopilotPkgPrefix
480	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $prefix | Out-Null
481	    # A private package.json keeps `bun add` from walking up and polluting $HOME.
482	    $pkgJson = Join-Path $prefix 'package.json'
483	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pkgJson)) {
484	        '{"name":"copilot-api-runner","private":true,"version":"0.0.0"}' | Set-Content -Path $pkgJson -Encoding utf8
485	    }
486	
487	    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installing $spec (one-time — later starts skip this) ..."
488	    # Attempt 1 honours the ambient env: on a host where the npm registry is only
489	    # reachable THROUGH the proxy, stripping it would break the install. Attempt 2
490	    # strips it, which is what rescues the socks stall. COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1
491	    # skips straight to attempt 2 (saves the 45s stall on a known-bad host).
492	    $skipFirst = ($env:COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY -eq '1')
493	    if ($skipFirst -or -not (Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry -Dir $prefix -BudgetSeconds 45)) {
494	        if (-not $skipFirst) {
495	            Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: install failed or stalled with the proxy env — retrying without it ..."
496	            # Drop bun's cache lock dir before retrying; the killed attempt may have
497	            # left it behind, and a stale lock hangs the retry for the same reason.
498	            $bunHome = if ($env:BUN_INSTALL) { $env:BUN_INSTALL } else { Join-Path $HOME '.bun' }
499	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $bunHome 'install/cache/.tmp') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
500	        }
501	        if (-not (Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry -Dir $prefix -NoProxy -BudgetSeconds 90)) {
502	            Write-Warning 'copilot-proxy: configured npm registry did not provide the pin — trying the hash-pinned jsDelivr package copy; dependencies still use the configured registry ...'
503	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkgFromCdn)) {
504	                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not install $spec from the configured registry or pinned CDN fallback — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'."; return $false
505	            }
506	        }
507	    }
508	
509	    $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
510	    if (-not (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled -Metadata $metadata)) {
511	        $actual = if ($metadata) { "$($metadata.Name)@$($metadata.Version)" } else { 'no readable package metadata' }
512	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: install finished but $actual does not satisfy $spec with a runnable launch path under $prefix."
513	        return $false
514	    }
515	    Write-CopilotPkgStamp -Metadata $metadata
516	    $true
517	}

519	# Run a copilot-api subcommand (auth / check-usage / debug) in the foreground.
520	# Honours $launch.Cwd so the `bun run` fallback resolves node_modules/.bin.
521	function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand {
522	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argument)
523	    if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) {
524	        $global:LASTEXITCODE = 1
525	        throw 'copilot-proxy: package installation or verification failed'
526	    }
527	    $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
528	    if (-not $launch) {
529	        $global:LASTEXITCODE = 1
530	        throw "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api — try 'copilot-proxy reinstall'"
531	    }
532	    if ($launch.Cwd) { Push-Location $launch.Cwd }
533	    try {
534	        & $launch.Exe @($launch.Pre + $Argument)
535	        $commandExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
536	        $global:LASTEXITCODE = $commandExitCode
537	        if ($commandExitCode -ne 0) {
538	            throw "copilot-proxy: copilot-api $($Argument -join ' ') failed with exit code $commandExitCode"
539	        }
540	    } finally { if ($launch.Cwd) { Pop-Location } }
541	}

563	# --- egress: which proxy should Node use for the GitHub /models fetch? --------
564	#
565	# copilot-api fetches /models at startup and refreshes its cache periodically;
566	# restart forces an immediate refresh. GitHub geo-filters the Claude catalog on
567	# some egress paths. Node does NOT honour the Windows System Proxy on its own — it
568	# only sees HTTP(S)_PROXY — so a host whose browser reaches the unfiltered catalog
569	# could still have the proxy cache a Claude-less list, which then looks exactly
570	# like an entitlement problem. Resolve the URL here and hand it to the child.
571	#
572	# COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY: auto|always|never|<url>. Returns a URL or $null.
573	function script:Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy {
574	    $mode = if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }
575	    switch -Regex ($mode) {
576	        '^(never|off|0|false|no)$' { return $null }
577	        '^(http|https|socks5h?)://' { return $mode }
578	        '^(always|auto|on|1|true|yes)$' { break }
579	        default {
580	            Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: unknown COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY='$mode' (use auto|always|never|http://...)"
581	            return $null
582	        }
583	    }
584	
585	    # The Windows System Proxy (WinINET). This is what Clash Verge / mihomo /
586	    # v2rayN write when their "System Proxy" toggle is on, so reading it covers
587	    # the same ground the unix side gets from its Clash detector.
588	    try {
589	        $key = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' -ErrorAction Stop
590	        if ($key.ProxyEnable -eq 1 -and $key.ProxyServer) {
591	            # ProxyServer is either "host:port" or "http=host:port;https=host:port".
592	            $server = $key.ProxyServer
593	            if ($server -match '(?:^|;)\s*https?=([^;]+)') { $server = $Matches[1] }
594	            elseif ($server -match ';') { $server = ($server -split ';')[0] }
595	            if ($server) { return "http://$($server -replace '^https?://', '')" }
596	        }
597	    } catch { $null = $_ }
598	
599	    # Fallback: an explicit env proxy in this shell.
600	    foreach ($v in $env:HTTPS_PROXY, $env:https_proxy, $env:HTTP_PROXY, $env:http_proxy) {
601	        if ($v) { return $v }
602	    }
603	    $null
604	}

606	# Model ids GitHub serves for this account RIGHT NOW, for the direct-vs-proxied
607	# A/B in doctor. -Via: 'direct' forces no proxy, a URL forces that proxy, absent
608	# uses .NET defaults. Returns sorted-unique ids, or $null on any failure.
609	#
610	# Secrets: the ghu_/bearer tokens only ever travel in request headers — never in
611	# a command line, never echoed.
612	function script:Get-CopilotUpstreamModel {
613	    param([string] $Via)
614	
615	    $tokFile = Get-CopilotToken
616	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tokFile)) { return $null }
617	    $ghu = Get-Content -First 1 $tokFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
618	    if (-not $ghu) { return $null }
619	
620	    $transport = @{}
621	    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }
622	    elseif ($Via) { $transport['Proxy'] = $Via }
623	
624	    try {
625	        $ex = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token' -TimeoutSec 10 `
626	            -Headers @{ 'Authorization' = "token $ghu"; 'user-agent' = 'GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7' } `
627	            @transport -ErrorAction Stop
628	    } catch { return $null }
629	
630	    $api = if ($ex.endpoints.api) { $ex.endpoints.api } else { 'https://api.githubcopilot.com' }
631	    if (-not $ex.token) { return $null }
632	
633	    try {
634	        $up = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$api/models" -TimeoutSec 12 `
635	            -Headers @{
636	                'Authorization'            = "Bearer $($ex.token)"
637	                'user-agent'               = 'GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7'
638	                'copilot-integration-id'   = 'vscode-chat'
639	            } @transport -ErrorAction Stop
640	    } catch { return $null }
641	
642	    @($up.data.id | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
643	}

645	# Optional ChatGPT Apps reachability. This is deliberately separate from the
646	# Copilot inference probes: codex_apps is a remote MCP served by chatgpt.com,
647	# not a localhost bridge to Codex.app and not part of GitHub Copilot.
648	function script:Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind {
649	    param($ErrorRecord)
650	
651	    $message = if ($ErrorRecord -is [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]) {
652	        $ErrorRecord.Exception.ToString()
653	    } else { [string]$ErrorRecord }
654	
655	    if ($message -match '(?i)timed?\s*out|timeout|operation.*canceled|deadline') { return 'timeout' }
656	    if ($message -match '(?i)certificate|authenticationexception|ssl|tls|secure channel') { return 'tls' }
657	    'network'
658	}

660	function script:Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe {
661	    param(
662	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Uri,
663	        [string] $Via = 'direct'
664	    )
665	
666	    $transport = @{}
667	    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }

673	            -SkipHttpErrorCheck -Headers @{ 'user-agent' = 'codex-copilot-doctor/1.0' } `

676	        [pscustomobject]@{
677	            Reached = $true

679	            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
680	            Kind    = $null
681	            Error   = $null

685	        [pscustomobject]@{
686	            Reached = $false
687	            Code    = 0

689	            Kind    = Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind $_
690	            Error   = ($_.Exception.Message -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()

_**Agent - sidechain (gpt-5.6-sol 2026-08-26 09:07:50Z)**_

Two strong testing idioms are available: direct dot-sourcing plus Pester mocks/fake global commands (`Pueue.Tests.ps1`), and rendering a template to `$TestDrive` then launching a clean child `pwsh` with controlled environment (`ClaudeSettings.Tests.ps1`). For the monolithic package script, the latter is safer because top-level execution begins immediately and native-command exit codes must be isolated from the test runner.

1	# Shared Herdr agent-skill synchronizer.
2	#
3	# The installed binary is the version authority. `herdr --skill` emits the
4	# official skill compiled for that release, avoiding drift from a Git branch.
5	
6	function Resolve-HerdrExecutable {
7	    $command = Get-Command herdr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
8	    if ($command) { return $command.Source }
9	
10	    if ($env:LOCALAPPDATA) {
11	        $fallback = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Herdr\bin\herdr.exe'
12	        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fallback -PathType Leaf) { return $fallback }
13	    }
14	    return $null
15	}
16	
17	function Get-HerdrSkillContent {
18	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$HerdrPath)
19	
20	    $start = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
21	    $start.FileName = $HerdrPath
22	    $start.ArgumentList.Add('--skill')
23	    $start.UseShellExecute = $false
24	    $start.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
25	    $start.RedirectStandardError = $true
26	    $start.CreateNoWindow = $true
27	
28	    $process = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($start)
29	    $stdoutTask = $process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
30	    $stderrTask = $process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
31	    $process.WaitForExit()
32	    $stdout = $stdoutTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
33	    $stderr = $stderrTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
34	
35	    if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) {
36	        $detail = $stderr.Trim()
37	        if (-not $detail) { $detail = "exit $($process.ExitCode)" }
38	        throw "herdr --skill failed: $detail"
39	    }
40	    return $stdout
41	}
42	
43	function Write-HerdrSkillContent {
44	    param(
45	        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Content,
46	        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string[]]$Destinations
47	    )
48	
49	    if ($Content -notmatch '\A---\r?\n' -or $Content -notmatch '(?m)^name:\s*herdr\s*$') {
50	        Write-Warning 'herdr --skill returned invalid skill content; keeping existing copies'
51	        return $false
52	    }
53	
54	    $encoding = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
55	    foreach ($destination in $Destinations) {
56	        $directory = Split-Path -Parent $destination
57	        $temporary = Join-Path $directory ('.SKILL.md.tmp.' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
58	        try {
59	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $directory | Out-Null
60	            if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $destination -PathType Leaf) -and
61	                ([IO.File]::ReadAllText($destination) -ceq $Content)) {
62	                continue
63	            }
64	            [IO.File]::WriteAllText($temporary, $Content, $encoding)
65	            [IO.File]::Move($temporary, $destination, $true)
66	        } catch {
67	            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporary -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
68	            Write-Warning "Could not synchronize Herdr skill at ${destination}: $_"
69	            return $false
70	        }
71	    }
72	    return $true
73	}
74	
75	function Sync-HerdrSkill {
76	    param(
77	        [string[]]$Destinations = @(
78	            (Join-Path $HOME '.agents\skills\herdr\SKILL.md'),
79	            (Join-Path $HOME '.claude\skills\herdr\SKILL.md')
80	        ),
81	        [string]$HerdrPath = (Resolve-HerdrExecutable)
82	    )
83	
84	    if (-not $HerdrPath) {
85	        Write-Warning 'Herdr is not installed; keeping any existing global skill copies'
86	        return $false
87	    }
88	
89	    try {
90	        $content = Get-HerdrSkillContent -HerdrPath $HerdrPath
91	        return Write-HerdrSkillContent -Content $content -Destinations $Destinations
92	    } catch {
93	        Write-Warning "Could not read the official skill from the installed Herdr binary: $_"
94	        return $false
95	    }
96	}
97

1	#Requires -Version 7
2	# bootstrap-wsl-dotfiles.ps1 — run the cross-platform dotfiles bootstrap
3	# (github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles) inside an EXISTING WSL distro, headless.
4	#
5	# Convenience wrapper behind `just wsl-dotfiles`. Unlike `enable-wsl-ubuntu`, it
6	# does NOT register a distro or create a user — it only runs the chezmoi
7	# bootstrap in a distro that already exists. Use it to:
8	#   - finish the install after `enable-wsl-ubuntu`'s in-distro step failed on the
9	#     network (idempotent — chezmoi init is safe to re-run), or
10	#   - install the dotfiles into a WSL distro you set up yourself.
11	#
12	# The frozen answers come from the persisted chezmoi config (`chezmoi data`), and
13	# the bootstrap is piped via `bash -s` on stdin — so `$(...)`, `$HOME` and quotes
14	# are expanded by the Linux shell, never mangled by PowerShell / wsl (see the
15	# pitfall doc). Behind a proxy / GFW: connect a VPN first (WSL routes through the
16	# Windows network). NB: the bootstrap here is kept in sync with the headless
17	# block of scripts/enable-wsl-ubuntu.ps1.
18	param(
19	    [string]$Distro = 'Ubuntu-24.04',
20	    [string]$WslUser   # default: the distro's own default user
21	)
22	
23	$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
24	if (Test-Path variable:PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference) { $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false }
25	$OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)   # BOM-free stdin to wsl/bash
26	$env:WSL_UTF8 = '1'
27	
28	function Info($m) { Write-Host "==> $m" -ForegroundColor Cyan }
29	
30	# Frozen answers from the persisted chezmoi config.
31	$Name = ''; $Email = ''; $Mirror = 'false'
32	try {
33	    $d = & chezmoi data --format json 2>$null | ConvertFrom-Json
34	    $Name   = $d.name
35	    $Email  = $d.email
36	    $Mirror = "$($d.useChineseMirror)".ToLower()
37	    if (-not $WslUser) { $WslUser = $d.wslUsername }
38	} catch { Write-Verbose "chezmoi data unavailable; using defaults: $_" }
39	if (-not $Mirror) { $Mirror = 'false' }
40	
41	# -u <user> only if we have one (else use the distro's default user).
42	$wslArgs = @('-d', $Distro)
43	if ($WslUser) {
44	    $u = ((("$WslUser" -replace '.*\\', '') -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9_-]', '')).ToLower()
45	    if ($u) { $wslArgs += @('-u', $u) }
46	}
47	
48	$boot = @"
49	command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq curl; }
50	i=1
51	while [ "`$i" -le 3 ]; do
52	  script="`$(curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-connrefused --retry-all-errors https://get.chezmoi.io)"
53	  if [ -n "`$script" ] && printf '%s' "`$script" | sh -s -- -b "`$HOME/.local/bin" \
54	       init --apply "https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles.git" --promptDefaults \
55	       --promptString "What is your full name=$Name" \
56	       --promptString "What is your email address=$Email" \
57	       --promptChoice "Which profile=ubuntu_server" \
58	       --promptBool "Are you in China (behind GFW) and need to use mirrors=$Mirror"; then
59	    exit 0
60	  fi
61	  echo "chezmoi bootstrap attempt `$i failed (likely a proxy/GFW reset); retrying in 5s..." >&2
62	  i=`$((i + 1)); sleep 5
63	done
64	exit 1
65	"@ -replace "`r`n", "`n"
66	
67	try {
68	    Info "Bootstrapping cross-platform dotfiles in $Distro (headless)"
69	    $boot | & wsl.exe @wslArgs -- bash -s
70	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
71	        Write-Warning "dotfiles bootstrap in $Distro failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE) — usually a proxy/GFW reset fetching chezmoi/the repo from GitHub (curl 56). Connect a VPN (WSL uses the Windows network) and re-run: just wsl-dotfiles"
72	        return
73	    }
74	    Info "Done — open it with: wsl -d $Distro"
75	} catch {
76	    Write-Warning "WSL dotfiles bootstrap failed (non-fatal): $_"
77	}

<summary>Tool use: **Read**</summary>
 `C:\Users\hanruzhou\.local\share\chezmoi\docs\tools.md`

```text
190	- **AudioDeviceCmdlets** — absolute volume + mute for the `sysvol`/`sysmute` helpers.
191	
192	## Opt-in dev stacks
193	
194	Off by default; enable the matching init prompt:
195	
196	| Toggle | Installs |
197	|---|---|
198	| Local LLM tools | Ollama (`Ollama.Ollama`) + LiteLLM (`uv tool install 'litellm[proxy]'`) |
199	| Tunnel tools | ngrok, cloudflared (scoop) |
200	| IaC tools | Terraform, OpenTofu (scoop) + Azure CLI & the `azure-devops` extension (`az devops`/`az repos`, winget) |
201	| OpenSSH server | Microsoft OpenSSH Server (sshd): Windows capability + auto-start service + inbound TCP 22 firewall rule, with pwsh as the default shell. Needs admin — set up on an elevated `chezmoi apply`, or run `just enable-sshd` from an elevated pwsh. |
202	| herdr multiplexer | herdr, a native Windows terminal multiplexer (**preview beta**). No scoop/winget manifest — installs via herdr.dev's `irm \| iex` script; config managed at `~/.config/herdr/config.toml` (pwsh as the default shell). Every apply also exports the official skill from the installed binary's `herdr --skill` output into both `~/.agents/skills/herdr/` and `~/.claude/skills/herdr/`, keeping preview-version instructions aligned. Also installs the [herdr-plus](https://github.com/cloudmanic/herdr-plus) plugin that backs `prefix+y` (Quick Actions) and `prefix+O` (Projects) — **needs `go`** (its Windows build is `go build`), so it is skipped with a message when go is absent (`scoop install go`, or enable *Extra runtimes*). See [rationale](rationale.md#terminal-multiplexer-wezterm-stable-default-herdr-native-beta). |
203	| Clink (cmd.exe) | [Clink](https://chrisant996.github.io/clink/) (scoop `main`) — Bash-style line editing for `cmd.exe`, so **starship** + **zoxide** + **fzf** work in the DOS prompt. Reuses the shared `starship.toml`; registers a per-user cmd AutoRun, deploys our `starship.lua`, and fetches the community `clink-zoxide` / `clink-fzf` bridges into `%LocalAppData%\clink`. pwsh stays the default — this is an opt-in secondary shell with prompt + nav parity only. See [rationale](rationale.md#powershell-7-default-cmdexe-optional-via-clink) & [Shell](shell.md#cmdexe-via-clink). |
204	| try (ephemeral workspaces) | [`try`](https://github.com/tobi/try) via `gem install try-cli` (ruby installed if absent). Dated `~/src/tries/YYYY-MM-DD-name` trial dirs + a fuzzy selector; `tri <git-url>` clones into one. The pwsh command is **`tri`** (`try` is a reserved keyword — bareword `try` won't parse; `& try` works). See [Shell](shell.md#try). |
205	| translate (on for workstation) | [`translate`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/translate) — terminal translator (CLI + TUI) over copilot-proxy / Ollama / Google plus an offline CC-CEDICT + ECDICT dictionary. No scoop/winget manifest and no prebuilt Windows release, so it is built from source with `go install` (go is installed by the block itself, so *Extra runtimes* need not be on) into `~\.local\bin`; the **first build takes several minutes**. Ships pwsh tab-completion and the `translate` tv channel. See [translate](translate.md). |
206	| Rime input method | [Weasel / 小狼毫](https://github.com/rime/weasel) (`Rime.Weasel`), Rime for Windows, registered as **Traditional Chinese**. Machine-scope NSIS installer, so applying raises a **UAC prompt**. The `*.custom.yaml` under `%APPDATA%\Rime` is chezmoi-managed and the engine-level part is **shared byte-for-byte with the macOS/Linux repo** (Squirrel / ibus-rime). See [Input method](input-method.md). |
207	
208	## Package registries
209	
210	One shared policy is applied both at install time and in interactive shells
211	(`profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`):
212	
213	- **Managed machines** route pip/uv through the company PyPI pull-through
214	  registry and npm through the company npm pull-through registry. The PyPI path
215	  was verified with `tomlkit==0.13.3`; its artifacts are served by the corporate
216	  Azure Artifacts backend. IT already provisions the enabled company NuGet source
217	  and disables nuget.org, so the dotfiles do not rewrite NuGet configuration.
218	- **China mirrors** apply only on non-managed machines and route pip / npm / cargo /
219	  go / node through Tsinghua / npmmirror / goproxy.cn / rsproxy.
220	- No company Go or Cargo registry was discovered, so managed machines leave those
221	  ecosystems at their existing defaults.
222	
223	The managed-machine policy wins if both toggles are true. This prevents a GFW
224	mirror from bypassing corporate package policy.
225	
226	## Television (tv) channels
227	
228	Custom pickers under `%APPDATA%\television\cable\` (run `tv` to browse, or `tv <name>`):
229	
230	| Channel | What |
231	|---|---|
232	| `aliases` | PowerShell aliases & functions (cached at shell startup) |
233	| `git-ops` | common git commands → Enter copies to clipboard |
234	| `ports` | listening TCP ports → Ctrl+K kills the owning process |
235	| `kill-process` | processes by memory → Enter/Ctrl+K kill, Ctrl+D force-kill |
236	| `scoop-apps` | installed scoop apps → Enter info, Ctrl+U update, Ctrl+X uninstall |
237	| `apps` | launch an app from Start Menu shortcuts |

195	## 套件 registry
196	
197	套用時的 installer 與互動式 shell（`profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`）共用同一份政策：

200	  pull-through registry。PyPI 路徑已用 `tomlkit==0.13.3` 驗證，artifact 由公司
201	  Azure Artifacts backend 提供。NuGet 的公司 source 與停用 nuget.org 已由 IT
202	  machine-wide 配置，因此 dotfiles 不覆寫 NuGet 設定。
203	- **China mirrors** 只在非受管機器生效，把 pip / npm / cargo / go / node 導向
204	  清華 / npmmirror / goproxy.cn / rsproxy。
205	- 未找到公司的 Go 或 Cargo registry，因此受管機器保留這兩者既有預設值。
206	
207	若兩個 toggle 同時為 true，受管機器政策優先，避免 GFW mirror 繞過公司套件政策。

222	| `translate` | 翻譯歷史 → Enter 複製譯文、Ctrl+Y 複製原文、Ctrl+S 朗讀（選用的 `translate`） |

71	local/git/URL specs are rejected before filesystem cleanup. Warm starts do no

 `C:\Users\hanruzhou\.local\share\chezmoi\pitfalls\packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path.md`

```text
1	# npm returns 404 against `packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io` — and the registry is actually fine
2	
3	**Symptoms** (grep this section): probing the internal Microsoft npm mirror
4	looks like a dead service —
5	
6	```
7	npm error 404
8	npm error 404 Note that you can also install from a
9	npm error 404 tarball, folder, http url, or git url.
10	```
11	
12	`npm ping --registry https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/` → **404**.
13	`https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/` and `/undici` → **404** in a browser or
14	`Invoke-WebRequest`. `npm view <pkg> --registry https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/registry/`
15	→ **404**. Yet DNS resolves and TCP 443 connects fine, and *some* tarball URLs
16	return 200. The natural conclusion — "this is only a tarball proxy for specific
17	packages, not a real npm registry" — is **wrong**.
18	**First seen**: 2026-07-29 (reached independently on two company laptops)
19	**Affects**: Microsoft corp machines where `registry=https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/`
20	is set at the machine level (`Q:\.tools\.npm-global\etc\npmrc`) and
21	`registry.npmjs.org` is blocked.
22	**Status**: not a bug — three probing mistakes.
23	
24	## Root cause
25	
26	`packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/` **is** a full pull-through npm registry.
27	Three separate things make it look broken:
28	
29	### 1. `npm ping` is not implemented — 404 does not mean unhealthy
30	
31	`npm ping` hits `/-/ping`, which this mirror does not serve. It returns 404 on a
32	perfectly working registry. **Never use `npm ping` as the health probe here.**
33	Use a metadata read instead:
34	
35	```bash
36	npm view undici version --registry https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/
37	# 8.8.0
38	```
39	
40	### 2. `/npm/registry/` is one segment too deep
41	
42	The registry root is `/npm/`, **not** `/npm/registry/`:
43	
44	| URL | Result |
45	|---|---|
46	| `https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/` | works |
47	| `https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/registry/` | 404 |
48	| `https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/` | 404 |
49	
50	The `/npm/registry/...` shape is what **Azure Artifacts** feeds use
51	(`pkgs.dev.azure.com/<org>/_packaging/<feed>/npm/registry/`), so it is an easy
52	habit to carry over. The give-away that `/npm/` is correct: the tarball path
53	that *does* work, `/npm/@scope/name/-/name-1.2.3.tgz`, is the standard npm
54	layout relative to base `/npm/`.
55	
56	### 3. The internal feed can be *ahead* of the public mirror
57	
58	Asking the internal Azure Artifacts feed for `undici@latest` yields a version
59	the public mirror does not have yet. Requesting that newer tarball from
60	`packagefeedproxy` then 404s, which reads as "tarball not provided" when it
61	actually means "that version isn't mirrored". At time of writing the internal
62	feed had `undici` 8.9.0 while the mirror's latest was **8.8.0**.
63	
64	## How to verify it is healthy
65	
66	```bash
67	R='https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/'
68	npm view undici version   --registry "$R"   # 8.8.0   -> metadata works
69	npm view left-pad version --registry "$R"   # 1.3.0   -> arbitrary public pkg, so no allowlist
70	npm view '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14' version --registry "$R"
71	```
72	
73	`left-pad` is the important one: an obscure package nobody on the machine has
74	ever installed proves this is a general pull-through proxy, not a curated
75	allowlist.
76	
77	Metadata rewrites `dist.tarball` to Microsoft's 1ES **public** mirror:
78	
79	```
80	https://ms-feed-25.pkgs.visualstudio.com/1es-public/_packaging/npm-public/npm/registry/undici/-/undici-8.8.0.tgz
81	```
82	
83	Note `npm-public` — packages served here are public npm packages, so a scoped
84	name resolving through it is **not** evidence that a package is internal or
85	that an internal-feed credential is required.
86	
87	## Prevention
88	
89	- Health-probe with `npm view <pkg> version --registry <url>`, never `npm ping`.
90	- Do not copy the `/npm/registry/` suffix from Azure Artifacts URLs.
91	- Before concluding a version is missing, check the mirror's own `latest`
92	  rather than the internal feed's.
93	- `npm config list` shows which file supplies `registry` (`builtin` / `global` /
94	  `user` / `env`) and masks credentials — prefer it to reading `~/.npmrc`, which
95	  contains a live token.
96	
97	## Related
98	
99	- [`copilot-api-connectionrefused-stale-bun-only-module`](copilot-api-connectionrefused-stale-bun-only-module.md)
100	  — the failure this investigation was chasing. It was not a registry problem
101	  at all; a stale deployed module was falling back to Bun, which ignores the
102	  configured registry.
103
```
</details></tool-use>

_**Agent - sidechain (gpt-5.6-sol 2026-08-26 09:09:15Z)**_

The fallback boundary should be narrower than the raw invocation list: only npm registry resolution and uv/PyPI dependency resolution currently use corporate feeds. `uv python install`, Scoop’s Node/Go/Rust/Ruby acquisition, Go module builds, Rustup/Cargo, RubyGems, Git/CDN installers, and WSL bootstrap do not have a corporate source configured here, so wrapping them in “corporate → public” logic would conflate unrelated failures and could bypass policy without evidence.

1	#Requires -Version 7
2	# run_onchange_after_03_xdg_env.ps1 — persist the XDG base-dir env vars to the
3	# User environment so ~/.config is authoritative for XDG-aware tools (Neovim,
4	# lazygit, starship, yazi, atuin, zoxide) even when launched OUTSIDE a pwsh
5	# session that sourced our profile.
6	#
7	# Why this matters on Windows:
8	#   * 00_env.ps1 sets these in-session, so tools launched from pwsh already use
9	#     ~/.config. But nvim launched from Explorer / a non-pwsh terminal would
10	#     fall back to %LOCALAPPDATA%\nvim for config AND a separate data/plugin
11	#     dir — a confusing "my plugins vanished" split.
12	#   * Setting XDG_CONFIG_HOME is also the Neovim-documented way to make it read
13	#     ~/.config/nvim on Windows, and lazygit honours it for config.yml too.
14	#
15	# Idempotent + fault-tolerant: only writes a var when it differs; never aborts.
16	$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
17	
18	$want = @{
19	    XDG_CONFIG_HOME = Join-Path $HOME '.config'
20	    XDG_DATA_HOME   = Join-Path $HOME '.local\share'
21	    XDG_STATE_HOME  = Join-Path $HOME '.local\state'
22	    XDG_CACHE_HOME  = Join-Path $HOME '.cache'
23	}
24	
25	foreach ($name in $want.Keys) {
26	    try {
27	        $current = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name, 'User')
28	        if ($current -ne $want[$name]) {
29	            [System.Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $want[$name], 'User')
30	            Write-Host "==> set User env $name = $($want[$name])" -ForegroundColor Cyan
31	        }
32	    } catch {
33	        Write-Warning "could not set $name (non-fatal): $_"
34	    }
35	}
36
```

    fix(packages): support managed registries and offline fallbacks
    
    Use one shared package-source policy for apply-time installers and interactive PowerShell. Managed machines now select the company PyPI and npm pull-through registries, with managed policy taking precedence over optional China mirrors.
    
    Replace the Codex modifier's apply-time PyPI dependency with Bun's built-in TOML parser, recover historical BOM mojibake safely, and add a hash-pinned jsDelivr fallback for copilot-api 2.1.0 while dependencies continue through the configured npm registry.
    
    Force Copilot module reloads, document the package-source behavior bilingually, and add regression coverage. Full Pester: 204 passed, 1 skipped; strict docs build passes.

+# Package-source policy shared by apply-time installers and interactive pwsh.
+# Precedence is intentional: a managed/corporate machine must stay on the
+# company-approved pull-through registries even if useChineseMirror was also
+# selected. NuGet is provisioned machine-wide by IT; Go/Cargo keep their normal
+# defaults because no company endpoints were discovered for them.
+{{ if .managedMachine -}}

+$env:UV_DEFAULT_INDEX    = 'https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/pypi/simple/'
+$env:npm_config_registry = 'https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/'
+{{ else if .useChineseMirror -}}

+#Requires -Version 7
+
+BeforeAll {
+    $RepoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
+    $TemplatePath = Join-Path $RepoRoot '.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1'
+
+    function Render-PackageSources {
+        param([bool] $ManagedMachine, [bool] $UseChineseMirror)
+        $data = @{
+            managedMachine   = $ManagedMachine
+            useChineseMirror = $UseChineseMirror
+        } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
+        $rendered = & chezmoi execute-template --source $RepoRoot --override-data $data --file $TemplatePath
+        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'failed to render package-source policy' }
+        $rendered -join "`n"
+    }
+}
+
+Describe 'shared package-source policy' {
+    It 'uses company PyPI and npm registries on managed machines' {
+        $rendered = Render-PackageSources -ManagedMachine $true -UseChineseMirror $false
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'packagefeedproxy\.microsoft\.io/pypi/simple/'
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'packagefeedproxy\.microsoft\.io/npm/'
+        $rendered | Should -Not -Match 'tuna|npmmirror|goproxy|rsproxy'
+    }
+
+    It 'keeps managed-machine policy ahead of China mirrors' {
+        $rendered = Render-PackageSources -ManagedMachine $true -UseChineseMirror $true
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'packagefeedproxy\.microsoft\.io/pypi/simple/'
+        $rendered | Should -Not -Match 'tuna|npmmirror|goproxy|rsproxy'
+    }
+
+    It 'uses China mirrors only on an unmanaged opted-in machine' {
+        $rendered = Render-PackageSources -ManagedMachine $false -UseChineseMirror $true
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'pypi\.tuna\.tsinghua\.edu\.cn'
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'registry\.npmmirror\.com'
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'goproxy\.cn'
+        $rendered | Should -Match 'rsproxy\.cn'
+        $rendered | Should -Not -Match 'packagefeedproxy\.microsoft\.io'
+    }
+
+    It 'sets no registry overrides by default on an unmanaged machine' {
+        $rendered = Render-PackageSources -ManagedMachine $false -UseChineseMirror $false
+        $rendered | Should -Not -Match '\$env:(PIP_INDEX_URL|UV_DEFAULT_INDEX|npm_config_registry|GOPROXY)\s*='
+    }
+
+    It 'is embedded by both install-time and interactive-shell entry points' {
+        Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $RepoRoot '.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl') |
+            Should -Match 'template "package-sources\.ps1"'
+        Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $RepoRoot 'dot_config/powershell/profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1.tmpl') |
+            Should -Match 'template "package-sources\.ps1"'
+    }
+}

16506	35	# dotfiles-windows
16507	36	
16508	37	This machine's `$HOME` is managed by a **chezmoi** dotfiles repo targeting **native
16509	38	Windows + PowerShell 7**. Packages install via **scoop** (CLI) + **winget** (GUI) —

16512	41	
16513	42	## Orientation
16514	43	- Source dir: `chezmoi source-path` — edit there (`cd "$(chezmoi source-path)"`).
16515	44	- Preview / apply: `chezmoi diff` / `chezmoi apply` (or `just diff` / `just apply`).
16516	45	- Source of a target: `chezmoi source-path <path>`; render without applying: `chezmoi cat <path>`.
16517	46	- Re-run init prompts: `chezmoi init` (answers persist in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`).
16518	47	- `docs/**`, `editors/**`, `scripts/**` are chezmoi-ignored (not deployed).
16519	48	
16520	49	## Shell layout (pwsh)
16521	50	- `$PROFILE` (`~/Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1`) is a loader
16522	51	  that dot-sources `~/.config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in sorted order, then
16523	52	  `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1` (untracked user override, loaded last).
16524	53	- Fragments: `00_env` (PATH/XDG/env), `10_tools` (starship, zoxide, atuin,
16525	54	  fzf, direnv, tv), `20_aliases` (`ll`/`gs`/`reload`/`cas`/`cau`/`chezmoi-cd`/`run-for`),

16528	57	  `40_copilot` (imports the Copilot module), `90_psreadline` (vi-mode gated on `enableVimMode`).
16529	58

16531	60	- `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the **single source of
16532	61	  truth** for installs, gated by the init toggles. scoop = CLI tools, winget = GUI
16533	62	  apps, npm = AI agents, PSGallery = PSFzf/AudioDeviceCmdlets. Fault-tolerant: one
16534	63	  failed package is collected + reported, never aborts the apply.
16535	64	- Package sources are defined once in `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` and

- Cargo source replacement

Consequences:

- A corporate uv attempt can still see additional indexes from uv configuration.
- A pip command can retain an extra index from environment/configuration.
- npm scoped packages such as `@openai/*` or `@github/*` can be redirected by scoped npm configuration independently of the default registry.
- The bare public/default Gem path can use multiple configured sources.
- Go’s China value explicitly contains a two-source sequence:

Even with exclusive command-line sources, caches are a separate provenance question: a resolver can reuse artifacts cached from an earlier source. “No mixed indexes” is achievable by source sanitization; “single-source artifacts” may additionally require isolated/no-cache execution.

A safe opt-in design should target only commands currently backed by corporate feeds:

### Suggested behavior

- Add a default-false fallback prompt effective only on managed machines.
- Keep the corporate environment as the persistent/default policy.
- For each eligible command:
  1. run against only the corporate source;
  2. capture exit code and combined diagnostics;
  3. retry against only the public source when the failure is narrowly eligible;
  4. restore all environment/configuration state afterward.
- Never configure corporate and public indexes simultaneously.
- Emit modifier diagnostics only to stderr/host.
- Split the batched npm update into package-level attempts.

- Eligible: actual install/update `ETARGET`, `notarget`, or package/version `E404`.

uv:

- Eligible only when output clearly identifies a distribution/version absent from the selected registry.
- Generic “no solution” should not automatically qualify because it can represent dependency incompatibility rather than mirror lag.
- Authentication, policy, TLS, timeout, and general solver errors should not trigger public fallback.

```text
1	# npm returns 404 against `packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io` — and the registry is actually fine
2	
3	**Symptoms** (grep this section): probing the internal Microsoft npm mirror
4	looks like a dead service —
5	
6	```
7	npm error 404
8	npm error 404 Note that you can also install from a
9	npm error 404 tarball, folder, http url, or git url.
10	```
11	
12	`npm ping --registry https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/` → **404**.
13	`https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/` and `/undici` → **404** in a browser or
14	`Invoke-WebRequest`. `npm view <pkg> --registry https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/registry/`
15	→ **404**. Yet DNS resolves and TCP 443 connects fine, and *some* tarball URLs
16	return 200. The natural conclusion — "this is only a tarball proxy for specific
17	packages, not a real npm registry" — is **wrong**.
18	**First seen**: 2026-07-29 (reached independently on two company laptops)
19	**Affects**: Microsoft corp machines where `registry=https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/`
20	is set at the machine level (`Q:\.tools\.npm-global\etc\npmrc`) and
21	`registry.npmjs.org` is blocked.
22	**Status**: not a bug — three probing mistakes.
23	
24	## Root cause
25	
26	`packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/` **is** a full pull-through npm registry.
27	Three separate things make it look broken:
28	
29	### 1. `npm ping` is not implemented — 404 does not mean unhealthy
30	
31	`npm ping` hits `/-/ping`, which this mirror does not serve. It returns 404 on a
32	perfectly working registry. **Never use `npm ping` as the health probe here.**
33	Use a metadata read instead:
34	
35	```bash
36	npm view undici version --registry https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/
37	# 8.8.0
38	```
39	
40	### 2. `/npm/registry/` is one segment too deep
41	
42	The registry root is `/npm/`, **not** `/npm/registry/`:
43	
44	| URL | Result |
45	|---|---|
46	| `https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/` | works |
47	| `https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/registry/` | 404 |
48	| `https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/` | 404 |
49	
50	The `/npm/registry/...` shape is what **Azure Artifacts** feeds use
51	(`pkgs.dev.azure.com/<org>/_packaging/<feed>/npm/registry/`), so it is an easy
52	habit to carry over. The give-away that `/npm/` is correct: the tarball path
53	that *does* work, `/npm/@scope/name/-/name-1.2.3.tgz`, is the standard npm
54	layout relative to base `/npm/`.
55	
56	### 3. The internal feed can be *ahead* of the public mirror
57	
58	Asking the internal Azure Artifacts feed for `undici@latest` yields a version
59	the public mirror does not have yet. Requesting that newer tarball from
60	`packagefeedproxy` then 404s, which reads as "tarball not provided" when it
61	actually means "that version isn't mirrored". At time of writing the internal
62	feed had `undici` 8.9.0 while the mirror's latest was **8.8.0**.
63	
64	## How to verify it is healthy
65	
66	```bash
67	R='https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/npm/'
68	npm view undici version   --registry "$R"   # 8.8.0   -> metadata works
69	npm view left-pad version --registry "$R"   # 1.3.0   -> arbitrary public pkg, so no allowlist
70	npm view '@jeffreycao/copilot-api@1.13.14' version --registry "$R"
71	```
72	
73	`left-pad` is the important one: an obscure package nobody on the machine has
74	ever installed proves this is a general pull-through proxy, not a curated
75	allowlist.
76	
77	Metadata rewrites `dist.tarball` to Microsoft's 1ES **public** mirror:
78	
79	```
80	https://ms-feed-25.pkgs.visualstudio.com/1es-public/_packaging/npm-public/npm/registry/undici/-/undici-8.8.0.tgz
81	```
82	
83	Note `npm-public` — packages served here are public npm packages, so a scoped
84	name resolving through it is **not** evidence that a package is internal or
85	that an internal-feed credential is required.
86	
87	## Prevention
88	
89	- Health-probe with `npm view <pkg> version --registry <url>`, never `npm ping`.
90	- Do not copy the `/npm/registry/` suffix from Azure Artifacts URLs.
91	- Before concluding a version is missing, check the mirror's own `latest`
92	  rather than the internal feed's.
93	- `npm config list` shows which file supplies `registry` (`builtin` / `global` /
94	  `user` / `env`) and masks credentials — prefer it to reading `~/.npmrc`, which
95	  contains a live token.
96	
97	## Related
98	
99	- [`copilot-api-connectionrefused-stale-bun-only-module`](copilot-api-connectionrefused-stale-bun-only-module.md)
100	  — the failure this investigation was chasing. It was not a registry problem
