 # herdr — native Windows terminal multiplexer + AI-agent orchestrator (preview beta).
 #
 # Windows port of the parent dotfiles repo's .chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml.
 # It mirrors the tmux/unix keymap as closely as the Windows build allows; every
 # binding that could NOT be carried over is listed in
 # backlog/herdr-windows-port-verification.md with the reason.
 #
 # THIS FILE IS THE MANAGED BODY of a chezmoi modify_ overlay
 # (dot_config/herdr/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl). The overlay enforces the tables
 # below on every `chezmoi apply` and preserves the keys herdr writes back at
 # runtime (onboarding / [session] / [remote] / [experimental] / [update] state).
 # Tracking this as a PLAIN managed file — which is what this repo did before —
 # clobbers that writeback and can re-trigger onboarding.
 #
 # Schema: https://herdr.dev/docs/configuration/
 # Full default: `herdr --default-config`
 # Validate after editing: `herdr server reload-config` (expect empty diagnostics)
 #
 # Helper-script paths are baked ABSOLUTE at render time on purpose: `pwsh -File`
 # does NOT expand a leading `~` (verified), and herdr passes the command string
 # through without shell tilde expansion on Windows.
 #
 # Prefix is ctrl+b (herdr default, same as tmux).
 
 [update]
-# Windows builds are preview-only; the installer rejects "stable" here.
+# This machine intentionally follows the preview channel.
 # Re-asserted by the overlay as a single key so herdr's own [update] bookkeeping
 # (last-check timestamps etc.) survives an apply.
 channel = "preview"
 
 [theme]
 name = "catppuccin"           # mocha (dark)
 auto_switch = true            # follow OS light/dark
 light_name = "catppuccin-latte"
 dark_name = "catppuccin"
 
 [ui]
 mouse_capture = true
 pane_borders = true
 pane_gaps = true
 confirm_close = true
 show_agent_labels_on_pane_borders = true
 
 # "auto" draws herdr's own cursor on Windows to avoid ConPTY flicker;
 # set "native" to hand the cursor to the outer terminal. Windows-only key.
 host_cursor = "auto"
 
 # Agent sidebar ordering. herdr's default is "spaces" (grouped by space);
 # "priority" turns the panel into an attention queue (blocked/waiting agents
 # float to the top). With many concurrent agent panes the queue is what you
 # actually scan. Valid values: "spaces" | "priority".
 agent_panel_sort = "priority"
 
 # Expanded Agent sidebar row layout. herdr's own default is
 #   [["state_icon", "workspace", "tab"], ["agent"]]
 # and we append the `$review` metadata token so the review-pending ⭐
 # (prefix+m / hmark) is actually VISIBLE in the sidebar.
 #
 # Required since herdr 0.7.4: `--custom-status` / the flat `custom_status` field
 # were replaced by a namespaced token map, and unlike custom_status a token is
 # rendered ONLY where a row layout names it — set a token with no layout entry
 # and the flag silently exists in the API but shows up nowhere.
 #
 # Keep `$review` in sync with $Token in dot_config/herdr/review-mark.ps1.
 # NOTE this pins the layout: upstream changes to the default rows will NOT reach
 # us, so re-check this block against `herdr --default-config` on herdr upgrades.
 [ui.sidebar.agents]
 rows = [
   ["state_icon", "workspace", "tab", "$review"],
   ["agent"],
 ]
 
 [terminal]
 # Match the rest of this repo (WezTerm / Windows Terminal default to pwsh).
 default_shell = "pwsh"
 # CWD policy for new panes/tabs/workspaces (no explicit --cwd):
 #   "follow"  = inherit the SOURCE pane/workspace (default)
 #   "home"    = $HOME · "current" = herdr's own process dir · or a fixed path
 # NOTE (herdr >=0.7.x): with "follow", a NEW TAB inherits the FOCUSED pane's live
 # cwd — same as a split (herdr issue #912). NO new_cwd value opens a new tab at
 # the WORKSPACE ("space") dir — for that use the prefix+C command below.
 new_cwd = "follow"
 
 # --- Built-in action rebinds (tmux muscle memory) ---
 # Only existing actions can be rebound; herdr defaults are kept for everything
 # not listed here. An action accepts an ARRAY of bindings, so one action can
 # carry both the intuitive key and the tmux-default key.
 [keys]
 split_vertical = ["prefix+|", "prefix+%"]         # side-by-side (left/right) = tmux prefix+| and prefix+% (-h)
 split_horizontal = ["prefix+minus", "prefix+\""]  # stacked (top/bottom)      = tmux prefix+- and prefix+" (-v)
 reload_config = "prefix+shift+r"   # tmux: prefix+R
 rename_tab = "prefix+,"            # tmux: prefix+, (rename window) — frees prefix+shift+t for the sesh popup
 new_worktree = "prefix+shift+b"    # moved off prefix+shift+g so prefix+G can be lazygit
 
 # --- Indexed quick-switch (native herdr actions) ---
 # switch_tab (prefix+1..9) is a herdr built-in; these add the workspace + agent
 # analogs so a number key jumps directly. "N..M" is native herdr config syntax.
 # On the unix side prefix+SHIFT+digit was found unusable (under the kitty
 # keyboard protocol shift+1 still carries the printable "!"), hence ctrl/alt.
 # Whether Windows/ConPTY behaves the same is UNVERIFIED — see the backlog note.
 switch_workspace = "prefix+ctrl+1..9"    # prefix+ctrl+N → workspace N
 focus_agent = "prefix+alt+1..9"          # prefix+alt+N  → jump to agent N's pane
 
 # --- Workspace navigate-mode: vim j/k (entered via prefix+w) ---
 navigate_workspace_down = ["j", "down"]
 navigate_workspace_up = ["k", "up"]

1	# pueue-bootstrap.ps1 — make the pueue client usable without a manual daemon
2	# terminal. Included into both the package installer and the PowerShell profile.
3	
4	function Resolve-PueueCommand {
5	    param(
6	        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
7	        [ValidateSet('pueue', 'pueued')]
8	        [string]$Name
9	    )
10	
11	    $command = Get-Command $Name -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
12	        Select-Object -First 1
13	    if ($command) { return $command.Source }
14	
15	    # A first-time Scoop install can create the shim after this pwsh process
16	    # captured PATH. Resolve the stable `current` junction as a fallback.
17	    $scoop = Get-Command scoop -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
18	        Select-Object -First 1
19	    if (-not $scoop) { return $null }
20	
21	    $prefixOutput = @(& $scoop.Source prefix pueue 2>$null)
22	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $prefixOutput) { return $null }
23	    $prefix = ([string]$prefixOutput[-1]).Trim()
24	    $candidate = Join-Path $prefix "$Name.exe"
25	    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate) { return $candidate }
26	    return $null
27	}
28	
29	function Test-PueueAdministrator {
30	    if (-not $IsWindows) { return $false }
31	    try {
32	        $identity = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
33	        $principal = [Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal]$identity
34	        return $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
35	    } catch {
36	        return $false
37	    }
38	}
39	
40	function Test-PueuedReady {
41	    param(
42	        [AllowNull()][string]$ClientPath,
43	        [int]$TimeoutMilliseconds = 500
44	    )
45	
46	    if (-not $ClientPath) { $ClientPath = Resolve-PueueCommand -Name pueue }
47	    if (-not $ClientPath) { return $false }
48	    $process = $null
49	    try {
50	        $process = Start-Process -FilePath $ClientPath -ArgumentList 'status' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
51	        if (-not $process.WaitForExit([Math]::Max(1, $TimeoutMilliseconds))) {
52	            try { $process.Kill($true) } catch { $null = $_ }
53	            return $false
54	        }
55	        return ($process.ExitCode -eq 0)
56	    } catch {
57	        return $false
58	    } finally {
59	        if ($process) { $process.Dispose() }
60	    }
61	}
62	
63	function Wait-PueuedReady {
64	    param(
65	        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ClientPath,
66	        [int]$TimeoutMilliseconds = 3000
67	    )
68	
69	    $timeout = [Math]::Max(1, $TimeoutMilliseconds)
70	    $clock = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
71	    while ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -lt $timeout) {
72	        $remaining = $timeout - [int]$clock.ElapsedMilliseconds
73	        if (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $ClientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds ([Math]::Min(500, $remaining))) {
74	            return $true
75	        }
76	        $remaining = $timeout - [int]$clock.ElapsedMilliseconds
77	        if ($remaining -le 0) { break }
78	        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds ([Math]::Min(100, $remaining))
79	    }
80	    return (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $ClientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds 1)
81	}
82	
83	function Start-PueuedIfNeeded {
84	    [CmdletBinding()]
85	    param(
86	        # The package installer opts into Pueue 4's built-in Windows service.
87	        # A normal shell never changes service state; it only uses daemon mode.
88	        [switch]$InstallService,
89	        [switch]$Quiet,
90	        [int]$ReadyTimeoutMilliseconds = 3000
91	    )
92	
93	    $clientPath = Resolve-PueueCommand -Name pueue
94	    $daemonPath = Resolve-PueueCommand -Name pueued
95	    if (-not $clientPath -or -not $daemonPath) {
96	        if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning 'pueue/pueued not found after installation' }
97	        return $false
98	    }
99	
100	    if (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $clientPath) {
101	        if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued already running' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
102	        return $true
103	    }
104	
105	    if ($InstallService -and (Test-PueueAdministrator)) {
106	        try {
107	            $service = Get-Service -Name pueued -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
108	            if (-not $service) {
109	                if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued: installing built-in Windows service' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
110	                if ($Quiet) { & $daemonPath service install *> $null }
111	                else { & $daemonPath service install 2>&1 | Out-Host }
112	                if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and -not $Quiet) {
113	                    Write-Warning 'pueued service install failed; falling back to daemon mode'
114	                }
115	                $service = Get-Service -Name pueued -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
116	            }
117	
118	            if ($service) {
119	                if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued: starting Windows service' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
120	                if ($Quiet) { & $daemonPath service start *> $null }
121	                else { & $daemonPath service start 2>&1 | Out-Host }
122	                $serviceStartExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
123	                if ($serviceStartExitCode -ne 0) {
124	                    if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning 'pueued service start failed; falling back to daemon mode' }
125	                } elseif (Wait-PueuedReady -ClientPath $clientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds $ReadyTimeoutMilliseconds) {
126	                    return $true
127	                } else {
128	                    if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning 'pueued service started but did not become ready' }
129	                    return $false
130	                }
131	            }
132	        } catch {
133	            if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning "pueued service setup failed; falling back to daemon mode: $_" }
134	        }
135	    }
136	
137	    if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Host '==> pueued: starting detached daemon' -ForegroundColor Cyan }
138	    try {
139	        # Pueue's daemonized child inherits stdio. PowerShell native redirection
140	        # therefore waits forever for pipe EOF even after the launcher exits.
141	        Start-Process -FilePath $daemonPath -ArgumentList '--daemonize' -WindowStyle Hidden
142	    } catch {
143	        if (-not $Quiet) { Write-Warning "pueued --daemonize failed: $_" }
144	        return $false
145	    }
146	
147	    $ready = Wait-PueuedReady -ClientPath $clientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds $ReadyTimeoutMilliseconds
148	    if (-not $ready -and -not $Quiet) { Write-Warning 'pueued started but did not become ready' }
149	    return $ready
150	}

74	function script:Get-CopilotPidFile { Join-Path (Get-CopilotTmp) "copilot-api-$(Get-CopilotPort).pid" }
75	function script:Get-CopilotToken   { Join-Path $HOME '.local/share/copilot-api/github_token' }
76	
77	function script:Get-XdgState { if ($env:XDG_STATE_HOME) { $env:XDG_STATE_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.local/state' } }
78	function script:Get-XdgConfig { if ($env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME) { $env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.config' } }
79	function script:Get-XdgData { if ($env:XDG_DATA_HOME) { $env:XDG_DATA_HOME } else { Join-Path $HOME '.local/share' } }

81	# --- pinned package install (run the binary, never `bunx` at launch) -----------
82	#
83	# Why an install prefix instead of `bunx <pkg> start`: bunx re-resolves the
84	# package on EVERY launch, and bun hangs indefinitely resolving through a socks
85	# proxy (a browser/curl through the same proxy is fine, which is what makes it so
86	# confusing). The wedged installer then keeps bun's global install-cache lock, so
87	# every retry hangs identically and stacks another zombie. Installing once and
88	# running the resulting binary removes the per-start resolve entirely — a warm
89	# start does zero network before it binds the port.
90	
91	# Parse only registry package specs: name or @scope/name, optionally followed by
92	# a version/tag/range. npm aliases and local/git/URL selectors are rejected before
93	# their text can reach any filesystem path or destructive cleanup.
94	function script:Get-CopilotPkgSpecInfo {
95	    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg
96	    $match = [regex]::Match(
97	        $spec,
98	        '^(?<name>@[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*|[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)(?:@(?<selector>.+))?$'
99	    )
100	    if (-not $match.Success) { return $null }
101	    $selector = [string]$match.Groups['selector'].Value
102	    if ($selector -and (
103	        $selector -match '^(?:npm:|file:|link:|https?:|git(?:\+[^:]*)?:|github:|gitlab:|bitbucket:)' -or
104	        $selector -match '[\\/]'
105	    )) { return $null }
106	    [pscustomobject]@{
107	        Name     = [string]$match.Groups['name'].Value
108	        Selector = $selector
109	    }
110	}
111	
112	function script:Get-CopilotPkgName {
113	    $info = Get-CopilotPkgSpecInfo
114	    if ($info) { $info.Name } else { $null }
115	}
116	
117	function script:Get-CopilotPkgPrefix { Join-Path (Get-XdgData) 'copilot-api/pkg' }
118	# Records verified installed metadata, so bumping COPILOT_API_PKG (or the pinned
119	# default) re-installs instead of silently running an old or partial tree.
120	function script:Get-CopilotPkgStamp { Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) '.installed-spec' }
121	
122	# Exact registry selectors can be verified against installed package metadata.
123	function script:Get-CopilotPkgExactVersion {
124	    $info = Get-CopilotPkgSpecInfo
125	    if ($info -and $info.Selector -match '^v?(\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?(?:\+[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?)$') {
126	        return $Matches[1]
127	    }
128	    $null
129	}

131	function script:Get-CopilotPkgMetadata {
132	    $name = Get-CopilotPkgName
133	    if (-not $name) { return $null }
134	    $path = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) "node_modules/$name/package.json"
135	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
136	    try {
137	        $json = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
138	        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$json.name) -or
139	            [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$json.version)) { return $null }
140	        [pscustomobject]@{
141	            Name    = [string]$json.name
142	            Version = [string]$json.version
143	            Path    = $path
144	        }
145	    } catch { $null }
146	}

148	function script:Get-CopilotPkgStampMetadata {
149	    $path = Get-CopilotPkgStamp
150	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
151	    try {
152	        $json = Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
153	        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$json.requestedSpec) -or
154	            [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$json.name) -or
155	            [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$json.version)) { return $null }
156	        [pscustomobject]@{
157	            RequestedSpec = [string]$json.requestedSpec
158	            Name          = [string]$json.name
159	            Version       = [string]$json.version
160	        }
161	    } catch { $null }
162	}
163	
164	function script:Get-CopilotPkgLegacyStamp {
165	    $path = Get-CopilotPkgStamp
166	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { return $null }
167	    try {
168	        $raw = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $path -Raw -ErrorAction Stop).Trim()
169	        if ($raw -and -not $raw.StartsWith('{')) { return $raw }
170	    } catch { $null }
171	    $null
172	}

174	function script:Write-CopilotPkgStamp {
175	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] $Metadata)
176	    [ordered]@{
177	        requestedSpec = Get-CopilotPkg
178	        name          = [string]$Metadata.Name
179	        version       = [string]$Metadata.Version
180	    } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Set-Content -Path (Get-CopilotPkgStamp) -Encoding utf8
181	}
182	
183	# The binlink bun wrote, if any. Bun on Windows writes node_modules/.bin/<name>.exe
184	# (plus a .bunx sidecar); the other extensions cover an npm/yarn-populated prefix.
185	# Returns $null when no directly-runnable shim exists — Get-CopilotPkgLaunch then
186	# falls back to `bun run`, which resolves from the local node_modules offline.
187	function script:Get-CopilotPkgBin {
188	    $binDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) 'node_modules/.bin'
189	    foreach ($ext in '.exe', '.cmd', '.bat', '', '.ps1') {
190	        $p = Join-Path $binDir "copilot-api$ext"
191	        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { return $p }
192	    }
193	    $null
194	}
195	
196	# How to invoke the installed proxy: @{ Exe; Pre; Cwd }. Cwd is non-null only for
197	# the `bun run` fallback, which must resolve node_modules/.bin from the prefix.
198	#
199	# The prefix is deliberately NOT passed as an argument (`bun run --cwd <path>`):
200	# Start-Process joins -ArgumentList with spaces and does no quoting, so a prefix
201	# under a $HOME containing a space ("C:\Users\Da-Wei Lee\...") would arrive split
202	# across two argv entries. -WorkingDirectory takes the path as a real parameter.
203	function script:Get-CopilotPkgLaunch {
204	    $bin = Get-CopilotPkgBin
205	    # .ps1 can't be Start-Process'd directly, and a bare extensionless shim is a
206	    # shell script — route both through `bun run`, which finds node_modules/.bin.
207	    if ($bin -and [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($bin) -in '.exe', '.cmd', '.bat') {
208	        return @{ Exe = $bin; Pre = @(); Cwd = $null }
209	    }
210	    if ($bin -and (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
211	        return @{ Exe = 'bun'; Pre = @('run', 'copilot-api'); Cwd = (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) }
212	    }
213	    # The hash-pinned CDN fallback carries the published dist files but no npm
214	    # binlink. Run its declared entry point directly with Bun.
215	    $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
216	    $main = if ($metadata) { Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $metadata.Path) 'dist/main.js' } else { $null }
217	    if ($main -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $main -PathType Leaf) -and (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
218	        return @{ Exe = 'bun'; Pre = @($main); Cwd = (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) }
219	    }
220	    $null
221	}
222	
223	function script:Test-CopilotPkgDependencies {
224	    param($Metadata = (Get-CopilotPkgMetadata))
225	    if (-not $Metadata) { return $false }
226	    try {
227	        $package = Get-Content -LiteralPath $Metadata.Path -Raw -ErrorAction Stop | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
228	        $names = if ($package.dependencies) { @($package.dependencies.PSObject.Properties.Name) } else { @() }
229	        $packageDir = Split-Path -Parent $Metadata.Path
230	        $prefix = Get-CopilotPkgPrefix
231	        foreach ($dependency in $names) {
232	            $local = Join-Path $packageDir "node_modules/$dependency/package.json"
233	            $hoisted = Join-Path $prefix "node_modules/$dependency/package.json"
234	            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $local -PathType Leaf) -and
235	                -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hoisted -PathType Leaf)) { return $false }
236	        }
237	        return $true
238	    } catch { return $false }
239	}

241	# Did the requested package actually land in the prefix and remain runnable?
242	# Metadata is authoritative: a stale directory or binlink alone never satisfies
243	# this postcondition. Exact selectors must also match the installed version.
244	function script:Test-CopilotPkgInstalled {
245	    param($Metadata = (Get-CopilotPkgMetadata))
246	    if (-not $Metadata) { return $false }
247	    if ($Metadata.Name -cne (Get-CopilotPkgName)) { return $false }
248	    $exactVersion = Get-CopilotPkgExactVersion
249	    if ($exactVersion -and $Metadata.Version -cne $exactVersion) { return $false }
250	    (Test-CopilotPkgDependencies -Metadata $Metadata) -and $null -ne (Get-CopilotPkgLaunch)
251	}
252	
253	# Is the CURRENT selector installed, stamped with verified metadata and runnable?
254	function script:Test-CopilotPkgReady {
255	    $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
256	    if (-not (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled -Metadata $metadata)) { return $false }
257	    $stamp = Get-CopilotPkgStampMetadata
258	    if (-not $stamp) { return $false }
259	    ($stamp.RequestedSpec -ceq (Get-CopilotPkg)) -and
260	        ($stamp.Name -ceq $metadata.Name) -and
261	        ($stamp.Version -ceq $metadata.Version)
262	}

264	# Remove only the requested package and its dedicated launch shims. Resolve and
265	# verify containment before deletion, then require cleanup to be complete: retained
266	# matching files could otherwise certify a failed installer attempt.
267	function script:Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget {
268	    $name = Get-CopilotPkgName
269	    if (-not $name) {
270	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: unsupported COPILOT_API_PKG registry spec '$(Get-CopilotPkg)'"
271	        return $false
272	    }
273	
274	    $nodeModules = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) 'node_modules'))
275	    $packageDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $nodeModules $name))
276	    $trimChars = [char[]]@([System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar, [System.IO.Path]::AltDirectorySeparatorChar)
277	    $nodeModulesRoot = $nodeModules.TrimEnd($trimChars) + [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
278	    $comparison = if ($IsWindows) { [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase } else { [System.StringComparison]::Ordinal }
279	    if (-not $packageDir.StartsWith($nodeModulesRoot, $comparison)) {
280	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: refusing package cleanup outside $nodeModulesRoot"
281	        return $false
282	    }
283	
284	    $binDir = Join-Path $nodeModules '.bin'
285	    try {
286	        if ([System.IO.Directory]::Exists($packageDir)) {
287	            [System.IO.Directory]::Delete($packageDir, $true)
288	        }
289	        if ([System.IO.Directory]::Exists($binDir)) {
290	            foreach ($binPath in [System.IO.Directory]::GetFiles($binDir, 'copilot-api*')) {
291	                [System.IO.File]::Delete($binPath)
292	            }
293	        }
294	    } catch {
295	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not clear the previous package target ($_)"
296	        return $false
297	    }
298	
299	    $remainingBin = if ([System.IO.Directory]::Exists($binDir)) {
300	        @([System.IO.Directory]::GetFiles($binDir, 'copilot-api*'))
301	    } else { @() }
302	    if ([System.IO.Directory]::Exists($packageDir) -or $remainingBin.Count -gt 0) {
303	        Write-Error 'copilot-proxy: previous package target is still present after cleanup; refusing to run the installer'
304	        return $false
305	    }
306	    $true
307	}
308	
309	# One package-install attempt in -Dir, bounded by -BudgetSeconds. npm is preferred
310	# because it supports Azure Artifacts' credential-provider token in ~/.npmrc;
311	# Bun does not. -NoProxy strips the proxy env for the child. Returns $true only
312	# when matching metadata and a runnable launch path exist afterwards.
313	#
314	# Success is judged from the FILESYSTEM, not $p.ExitCode: a Start-Process -PassThru
315	# object reports ExitCode 0 even for a child that exited non-zero (verified — the
316	# .Handle-caching workaround does not help either), so trusting it would let a
317	# failed install write the .installed-spec stamp and silently pin a broken prefix.
318	#
319	# The kill on expiry is the load-bearing part: a stalled `bun add` left running
320	# keeps bun's global install-cache lock, and THAT is what made every subsequent
321	# start hang too. Never let one escape.
322	function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry {
323	    param([string] $Dir, [switch] $NoProxy, [int] $BudgetSeconds)
324	
325	    if (-not (Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget)) { return $false }
326	    $proxyVars = 'ALL_PROXY', 'all_proxy', 'HTTP_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'https_proxy'
327	    $npm = Get-Command npm.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
328	    $installer = if ($npm) {
329	        @{ File = $npm.Source; Args = @('install', '--no-save', '--no-audit', '--no-fund', (Get-CopilotPkg)) }
330	    } else {
331	        Write-Warning 'copilot-proxy: npm.cmd not found; falling back to Bun (authenticated Azure Artifacts feeds require npm).'
332	        @{ File = 'bun'; Args = @('add', (Get-CopilotPkg), '--no-summary') }
333	    }
334	    $saved = @{}
335	    if ($NoProxy) {
336	        foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
337	    }
338	    try {
339	        $p = Start-Process -FilePath $installer.File -ArgumentList $installer.Args `
340	            -WorkingDirectory $Dir -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ErrorAction Stop
341	        if ($p.WaitForExit($BudgetSeconds * 1000)) { return (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled) }
342	        Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
343	        # The subshell's child is the one actually holding the install lock.
344	        $name = [regex]::Escape((Get-CopilotPkgName))
345	        Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
346	            Where-Object { $_.Name -in 'bun.exe', 'node.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match '\b(add|install)\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match $name } |
347	            ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
348	        return $false
349	    } catch {
350	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not launch package installer ($_)"; return $false
351	    } finally {
352	        if ($NoProxy) {
353	            foreach ($v in $proxyVars) {
354	                if ($null -eq $saved[$v]) { Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
355	                else { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] }
356	            }
357	        }
358	    }
359	}

390	function script:Get-CopilotSha256Base64 {
391	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Path)
392	    $stream = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($Path)
393	    try {
394	        $sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
395	        try { [Convert]::ToBase64String($sha.ComputeHash($stream)) } finally { $sha.Dispose() }
396	    } finally { $stream.Dispose() }
397	}

399	function script:Install-CopilotPkgDependencies {
400	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $PackageDir, [int] $BudgetSeconds = 120)
401	    $npm = Get-Command npm.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
402	    if (-not $npm) {
403	        Write-Error 'copilot-proxy: npm.cmd is required to install CDN package dependencies through the configured registry'
404	        return $false
405	    }
406	    try {
407	        $npmArgs = @('install', '--omit=dev', '--ignore-scripts', '--no-save', '--package-lock=false', '--no-audit', '--no-fund')
408	        $p = Start-Process -FilePath $npm.Source -ArgumentList $npmArgs -WorkingDirectory $PackageDir -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ErrorAction Stop
409	        if (-not $p.WaitForExit($BudgetSeconds * 1000)) {
410	            Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
411	            return $false
412	        }
413	        return (Test-CopilotPkgDependencies)
414	    } catch {
415	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not install CDN package dependencies ($_)"
416	        return $false
417	    }
418	}

420	function script:Install-CopilotPkgFromCdn {
421	    $manifest = Get-CopilotPkgCdnManifest
422	    if (-not $manifest) { return $false }
423	    if (-not (Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget)) { return $false }
424	
425	    $packageDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) 'node_modules/@jeffreycao/copilot-api'
426	    $downloadDir = Join-Path (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) ".cdn-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
427	    try {
428	        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $downloadDir | Out-Null
429	        foreach ($relativePath in $manifest.Files.Keys) {
430	            $downloadPath = Join-Path $downloadDir ($relativePath -replace '/', [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)
431	            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $downloadPath) | Out-Null
432	            Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($manifest.BaseUrl + $relativePath) -OutFile $downloadPath -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30 -ErrorAction Stop
433	            $actualHash = Get-CopilotSha256Base64 -Path $downloadPath
434	            if ($actualHash -cne $manifest.Files[$relativePath]) {
435	                throw "hash mismatch for $relativePath"
436	            }
437	        }
438	
439	        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $packageDir) | Out-Null
440	        Move-Item -LiteralPath $downloadDir -Destination $packageDir -ErrorAction Stop
441	        $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
442	        if (-not $metadata -or $metadata.Name -cne '@jeffreycao/copilot-api' -or $metadata.Version -cne '2.1.0') {
443	            throw 'downloaded package metadata does not identify @jeffreycao/copilot-api@2.1.0'
444	        }
445	        if (-not (Install-CopilotPkgDependencies -PackageDir $packageDir)) {
446	            throw 'dependency installation through the configured registry failed'
447	        }
448	        return (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled)
449	    } catch {
450	        Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: pinned CDN fallback failed ($_)"
451	        $null = Clear-CopilotPkgInstallTarget
452	        return $false
453	    } finally {
454	        Remove-Item -LiteralPath $downloadDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
455	    }
456	}

458	# Ensure the pinned spec is installed. No-op (and no network) once it is.
459	function script:Install-CopilotPkg {
460	    if (-not (Get-CopilotPkgSpecInfo)) {
461	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_API_PKG must be a registry package spec (name or @scope/name with an optional version/tag/range); aliases and local/git/URL specs are unsupported: $(Get-CopilotPkg)"
462	        return $false
463	    }
464	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) { return $true }
465	
466	    # Migrate the old one-line stamp without a network call only when an exact
467	    # selector, the legacy stamp, live package metadata and launch path all agree.
468	    $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
469	    if ((Get-CopilotPkgExactVersion) -and
470	        (Get-CopilotPkgLegacyStamp) -ceq (Get-CopilotPkg) -and
471	        (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled -Metadata $metadata)) {
472	        Write-CopilotPkgStamp -Metadata $metadata
473	        return $true
474	    }
475	
476	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
477	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return $false
478	    }
479	    $spec = Get-CopilotPkg; $prefix = Get-CopilotPkgPrefix
480	    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $prefix | Out-Null
481	    # A private package.json keeps `bun add` from walking up and polluting $HOME.
482	    $pkgJson = Join-Path $prefix 'package.json'
483	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pkgJson)) {
484	        '{"name":"copilot-api-runner","private":true,"version":"0.0.0"}' | Set-Content -Path $pkgJson -Encoding utf8
485	    }
486	
487	    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installing $spec (one-time — later starts skip this) ..."
488	    # Attempt 1 honours the ambient env: on a host where the npm registry is only
489	    # reachable THROUGH the proxy, stripping it would break the install. Attempt 2
490	    # strips it, which is what rescues the socks stall. COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY=1
491	    # skips straight to attempt 2 (saves the 45s stall on a known-bad host).
492	    $skipFirst = ($env:COPILOT_INSTALL_NOPROXY -eq '1')
493	    if ($skipFirst -or -not (Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry -Dir $prefix -BudgetSeconds 45)) {
494	        if (-not $skipFirst) {
495	            Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: install failed or stalled with the proxy env — retrying without it ..."
496	            # Drop bun's cache lock dir before retrying; the killed attempt may have
497	            # left it behind, and a stale lock hangs the retry for the same reason.
498	            $bunHome = if ($env:BUN_INSTALL) { $env:BUN_INSTALL } else { Join-Path $HOME '.bun' }
499	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Join-Path $bunHome 'install/cache/.tmp') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
500	        }
501	        if (-not (Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry -Dir $prefix -NoProxy -BudgetSeconds 90)) {
502	            Write-Warning 'copilot-proxy: configured npm registry did not provide the pin — trying the hash-pinned jsDelivr package copy; dependencies still use the configured registry ...'
503	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkgFromCdn)) {
504	                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: could not install $spec from the configured registry or pinned CDN fallback — run 'copilot-proxy doctor'."; return $false
505	            }
506	        }
507	    }
508	
509	    $metadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
510	    if (-not (Test-CopilotPkgInstalled -Metadata $metadata)) {
511	        $actual = if ($metadata) { "$($metadata.Name)@$($metadata.Version)" } else { 'no readable package metadata' }
512	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: install finished but $actual does not satisfy $spec with a runnable launch path under $prefix."
513	        return $false
514	    }
515	    Write-CopilotPkgStamp -Metadata $metadata
516	    $true
517	}
518	
519	# Run a copilot-api subcommand (auth / check-usage / debug) in the foreground.
520	# Honours $launch.Cwd so the `bun run` fallback resolves node_modules/.bin.
521	function script:Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand {
522	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argument)
523	    if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) {
524	        $global:LASTEXITCODE = 1
525	        throw 'copilot-proxy: package installation or verification failed'
526	    }
527	    $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
528	    if (-not $launch) {
529	        $global:LASTEXITCODE = 1
530	        throw "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api — try 'copilot-proxy reinstall'"
531	    }
532	    if ($launch.Cwd) { Push-Location $launch.Cwd }
533	    try {
534	        & $launch.Exe @($launch.Pre + $Argument)
535	        $commandExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
536	        $global:LASTEXITCODE = $commandExitCode
537	        if ($commandExitCode -ne 0) {
538	            throw "copilot-proxy: copilot-api $($Argument -join ' ') failed with exit code $commandExitCode"
539	        }
540	    } finally { if ($launch.Cwd) { Pop-Location } }
541	}

543	# Live `bun add … copilot-api` processes. Install is a one-shot, so a match at
544	# rest is a clean stale-installer signal: a stalled one keeps bun's global
545	# install-cache lock, which wedges every later install too. Invoke-CopilotPkgInstallTry
546	# bounds and kills its own attempts, so this should stay empty — it remains as a
547	# safety net for a stall we didn't spawn (e.g. a hand-run `bunx @jeffreycao/copilot-api`).
548	function script:Get-CopilotStaleInstaller {
549	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
550	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match '\badd\b' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'copilot-api' }
551	}

563	# --- egress: which proxy should Node use for the GitHub /models fetch? --------
564	#
565	# copilot-api fetches /models at startup and refreshes its cache periodically;
566	# restart forces an immediate refresh. GitHub geo-filters the Claude catalog on
567	# some egress paths. Node does NOT honour the Windows System Proxy on its own — it
568	# only sees HTTP(S)_PROXY — so a host whose browser reaches the unfiltered catalog
569	# could still have the proxy cache a Claude-less list, which then looks exactly
570	# like an entitlement problem. Resolve the URL here and hand it to the child.
571	#
572	# COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY: auto|always|never|<url>. Returns a URL or $null.
573	function script:Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy {
574	    $mode = if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }
575	    switch -Regex ($mode) {
576	        '^(never|off|0|false|no)$' { return $null }
577	        '^(http|https|socks5h?)://' { return $mode }
578	        '^(always|auto|on|1|true|yes)$' { break }
579	        default {
580	            Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: unknown COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY='$mode' (use auto|always|never|http://...)"
581	            return $null
582	        }
583	    }
584	
585	    # The Windows System Proxy (WinINET). This is what Clash Verge / mihomo /
586	    # v2rayN write when their "System Proxy" toggle is on, so reading it covers
587	    # the same ground the unix side gets from its Clash detector.
588	    try {
589	        $key = Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' -ErrorAction Stop
590	        if ($key.ProxyEnable -eq 1 -and $key.ProxyServer) {
591	            # ProxyServer is either "host:port" or "http=host:port;https=host:port".
592	            $server = $key.ProxyServer
593	            if ($server -match '(?:^|;)\s*https?=([^;]+)') { $server = $Matches[1] }
594	            elseif ($server -match ';') { $server = ($server -split ';')[0] }
595	            if ($server) { return "http://$($server -replace '^https?://', '')" }
596	        }
597	    } catch { $null = $_ }
598	
599	    # Fallback: an explicit env proxy in this shell.
600	    foreach ($v in $env:HTTPS_PROXY, $env:https_proxy, $env:HTTP_PROXY, $env:http_proxy) {
601	        if ($v) { return $v }
602	    }
603	    $null
604	}

606	# Model ids GitHub serves for this account RIGHT NOW, for the direct-vs-proxied
607	# A/B in doctor. -Via: 'direct' forces no proxy, a URL forces that proxy, absent
608	# uses .NET defaults. Returns sorted-unique ids, or $null on any failure.
609	#
610	# Secrets: the ghu_/bearer tokens only ever travel in request headers — never in
611	# a command line, never echoed.
612	function script:Get-CopilotUpstreamModel {
613	    param([string] $Via)
614	
615	    $tokFile = Get-CopilotToken
616	    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tokFile)) { return $null }
617	    $ghu = Get-Content -First 1 $tokFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
618	    if (-not $ghu) { return $null }
619	
620	    $transport = @{}
621	    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }
622	    elseif ($Via) { $transport['Proxy'] = $Via }
623	
624	    try {
625	        $ex = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.github.com/copilot_internal/v2/token' -TimeoutSec 10 `
626	            -Headers @{ 'Authorization' = "token $ghu"; 'user-agent' = 'GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7' } `
627	            @transport -ErrorAction Stop
628	    } catch { return $null }
629	
630	    $api = if ($ex.endpoints.api) { $ex.endpoints.api } else { 'https://api.githubcopilot.com' }
631	    if (-not $ex.token) { return $null }
632	
633	    try {
634	        $up = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$api/models" -TimeoutSec 12 `
635	            -Headers @{
636	                'Authorization'            = "Bearer $($ex.token)"
637	                'user-agent'               = 'GitHubCopilotChat/0.26.7'
638	                'copilot-integration-id'   = 'vscode-chat'
639	            } @transport -ErrorAction Stop
640	    } catch { return $null }
641	
642	    @($up.data.id | Where-Object { $_ } | Sort-Object -Unique)
643	}

645	# Optional ChatGPT Apps reachability. This is deliberately separate from the
646	# Copilot inference probes: codex_apps is a remote MCP served by chatgpt.com,
647	# not a localhost bridge to Codex.app and not part of GitHub Copilot.
648	function script:Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind {
649	    param($ErrorRecord)
650	
651	    $message = if ($ErrorRecord -is [System.Management.Automation.ErrorRecord]) {
652	        $ErrorRecord.Exception.ToString()
653	    } else { [string]$ErrorRecord }
654	
655	    if ($message -match '(?i)timed?\s*out|timeout|operation.*canceled|deadline') { return 'timeout' }
656	    if ($message -match '(?i)certificate|authenticationexception|ssl|tls|secure channel') { return 'tls' }
657	    'network'
658	}

660	function script:Invoke-CopilotOptionalHttpProbe {
661	    param(
662	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Uri,
663	        [string] $Via = 'direct'
664	    )
665	
666	    $transport = @{}
667	    if ($Via -eq 'direct') { $transport['NoProxy'] = $true }
668	    elseif ($Via) { $transport['Proxy'] = $Via }
669	
670	    $sw = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
671	    try {
672	        $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $Uri -Method Get -TimeoutSec 12 `
673	            -SkipHttpErrorCheck -Headers @{ 'user-agent' = 'codex-copilot-doctor/1.0' } `
674	            @transport -ErrorAction Stop
675	        $sw.Stop()
676	        [pscustomobject]@{
677	            Reached = $true
678	            Code    = [int]$response.StatusCode
679	            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
680	            Kind    = $null
681	            Error   = $null
682	        }
683	    } catch {
684	        $sw.Stop()
685	        [pscustomobject]@{
686	            Reached = $false
687	            Code    = 0
688	            Seconds = [math]::Round($sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds, 2)
689	            Kind    = Get-CopilotProbeFailureKind $_
690	            Error   = ($_.Exception.Message -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
691	        }
692	    }
693	}

719	# Resolve the model: $COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL > state file > default.
720	#
721	#   - HYPHENATED ids (claude-opus-4-8), not dotted (claude-opus-4.8): Claude Code
722	#     only recognizes hyphenated family names — dotted ids fall back to a legacy
723	#     "[Opus 4] retired" label AND a 200k context assumption.
724	#   - "[1m]" suffix: Claude Code uses it to size HUD/compaction for a 1M context
725	#     window. ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel derives it from live /v1/models metadata
726	#     for every provider. Claude Code-only: raw API clients use the plain id.
727	function script:Get-CopilotDefaultModel {
728	    if ($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL) { return $env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL }
729	    $sf = Get-CopilotModelState
730	    if (Test-Path $sf) { return (Get-Content -First 1 $sf) }
731	    'gpt-5.6-sol[1m]'
732	}

734	# Every model id the proxy accepts: .id plus the .claude_model_id alias. Callers
735	# with several catalog views pass one snapshot so all decisions share one response.
736	function script:Get-CopilotServedModels {
737	    param($Catalog)
738	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
739	    if (-not $Catalog) { return @() }
740	    $ids = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()
741	    foreach ($m in $Catalog.data) {
742	        if ($m.id) { $ids.Add([string]$m.id) }
743	        if ($m.claude_model_id) { $ids.Add([string]$m.claude_model_id) }
744	    }
745	    $ids | Sort-Object -Unique
746	}

779	# Pick exactly one live inference target. The configured main wins when its raw id
780	# is advertised; only the automatic catalog fallback is eligibility-filtered.
781	function script:Resolve-CopilotDoctorTarget {
782	    param([string] $ConfiguredMain, [string[]] $RawModel, [string[]] $SelectableModel)
783	    $RawModel = @($RawModel | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -notmatch 'embedding' } | Sort-Object -Unique)
784	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('SelectableModel')) { $SelectableModel = $RawModel }
785	    $SelectableModel = @($SelectableModel | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -notmatch 'embedding' } | Sort-Object -Unique)
786	    $rawConfigured = Remove-CopilotContextHint $ConfiguredMain
787	    if (-not $rawConfigured) {
788	        return [pscustomobject]@{
789	            Model  = $null
790	            Label  = 'MissingConfiguredMain'
791	            Reason = 'the active project proxy pin has no ANTHROPIC_MODEL'
792	        }
793	    }
794	    if ($RawModel -contains $rawConfigured) {
795	        return [pscustomobject]@{
796	            Model  = $rawConfigured
797	            Label  = 'ConfiguredMain'
798	            Reason = 'configured main is advertised by the live catalog'
799	        }
800	    }
801	
802	    $fallback = Select-CopilotBestModel -Model $SelectableModel
803	    [pscustomobject]@{
804	        Model  = $fallback
805	        Label  = 'CatalogFallback'
806	        Reason = "configured main '$rawConfigured' is not advertised by the live catalog"
807	    }
808	}

810	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotCompactText {
811	    param($Value, [int] $MaxLength = 320)
812	    $text = if ($Value -is [string]) { $Value } else {
813	        try { $Value | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 -Compress -ErrorAction Stop } catch { [string]$Value }
814	    }
815	    $text = ($text -replace '\s+', ' ').Trim()
816	    if ($text.Length -gt $MaxLength) { return $text.Substring(0, $MaxLength - 3) + '...' }
817	    $text
818	}

820	# Error bodies appear as direct code/message pairs, error.code/error.message, or
821	# another JSON error encoded inside error.message. Normalize all three shapes.
822	function script:Get-CopilotApiError {
823	    param($Body, [int] $Depth = 0)
824	    $raw = ConvertTo-CopilotCompactText $Body
825	    if ($Depth -gt 4) {
826	        return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw }
827	    }
828	
829	    $object = $Body
830	    if ($Body -is [string]) {
831	        try { $object = $Body | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop }
832	        catch { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
833	    }
834	    if (-not $object) { return [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $null; Message = $null; Raw = $raw } }
835	
836	    $container = $object
837	    if ($object.PSObject.Properties['error']) {
838	        $container = $object.error
839	        if ($container -is [string]) {
840	            $nestedError = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $container -Depth ($Depth + 1)
841	            if ($nestedError.Code -or $nestedError.Message) { return $nestedError }
842	        }
843	    }
844	
845	    $code = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['code']) { [string]$container.code } else { $null }
846	    $message = if ($container.PSObject.Properties['message']) { [string]$container.message } else { $null }
847	    if ($message -and $message.TrimStart().StartsWith('{')) {
848	        $nestedMessage = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $message -Depth ($Depth + 1)
849	        if ($nestedMessage.Code -or $nestedMessage.Message) {
850	            return [pscustomobject]@{
851	                Code    = if ($nestedMessage.Code) { $nestedMessage.Code } else { $code }
852	                Message = if ($nestedMessage.Message) { $nestedMessage.Message } else { $message }
853	                Raw     = $raw
854	            }
855	        }
856	    }
857	    [pscustomobject]@{ Code = $code; Message = $message; Raw = $raw }
858	}
859	
860	function script:Classify-CopilotInferenceError {
861	    param([int] $StatusCode, $Body)
862	    $errorInfo = Get-CopilotApiError -Body $Body
863	    $code = ([string]$errorInfo.Code).ToLowerInvariant()
864	    $detailParts = @($errorInfo.Code, $errorInfo.Message) | Where-Object { $_ }
865	    $detail = $detailParts -join ': '
866	    if (-not $detail) { $detail = $errorInfo.Raw }
867	
868	    if ($StatusCode -eq 402 -and $code -eq 'billing_not_configured') {
869	        return [pscustomobject]@{
870	            Kind        = 'BillingNotConfigured'
871	            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
872	            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
873	            Summary     = "account-wide GitHub Copilot billing is not configured: $detail"
874	            Retryable   = $false
875	            AccountWide = $true
876	            Action      = 'https://github.com/settings/copilot/features'
877	            Guidance    = 'Select an organization or enterprise in GitHub''s "Usage billed to" setting. Changing the model, using --auto, or enabling the shim cannot fix this account-wide failure.'
878	        }
879	    }
880	
881	    if ($code -match '^(model_not_supported|model_unsupported|unsupported_model)$') {
882	        return [pscustomobject]@{
883	            Kind        = 'ModelUnsupported'
884	            Code        = $errorInfo.Code
885	            Message     = $errorInfo.Message
886	            Summary     = $detail
887	            Retryable   = $false
888	            AccountWide = $false
889	            Action      = 'Run copilot-model --auto, or copilot-model -l and select a model advertised by the live catalog.'
890	            Guidance    = $null
891	        }
892	    }
893	
894	    [pscustomobject]@{
895	        Kind        = 'HttpError'
896	        Code        = $errorInfo.Code
897	        Message     = $errorInfo.Message
898	        Summary     = $detail
899	        Retryable   = ($StatusCode -eq 429 -or $StatusCode -ge 500)
900	        AccountWide = $false
901	        Action      = $null
902	        Guidance    = $null
903	    }
904	}

906	# Convert a raw proxy id to the spelling Claude Code should receive. A live
907	# max_context_window_tokens >= 1M earns [1m]. Offline, preserve an explicitly
908	# stored suffix but do not invent one.
909	function script:ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel {
910	    param([Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Model, $Catalog)
911	    $hadHint = $Model -match '\[1m\]$'
912	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
913	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
914	    if ($Catalog) {
915	        $entry = $Catalog.data | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $raw } | Select-Object -First 1
916	        $context = $entry.capabilities.limits.max_context_window_tokens
917	        if ($context -and [long]$context -ge 1000000) { return "$raw[1m]" }
918	        return $raw
919	    }
920	    if ($hadHint) { return "$raw[1m]" }
921	    $raw
922	}

927	    $null
928	}

930	# Build the complete Claude Code role profile for a selected main model. Native
931	# Claude profiles use the strongest served model in each family. OpenAI profiles
932	# map quality/balanced/fast work to the selected main, Terra and Luna.
933	function script:Get-CopilotModelProfile {
934	    param([string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
935	    if (-not $PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) { $Catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog }
936	    # The selected main may be an explicit override; only automatically derived
937	    # alternative roles are constrained by the selectable catalog policy.
938	    $models = Get-CopilotSelectableModelIds $Catalog
939	    $raw = Remove-CopilotContextHint $Model
940	    $main = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
941	
942	    $fableRaw = $raw; $opusRaw = $raw; $sonnetRaw = $raw; $haikuRaw = $raw
943	    if ($raw -like 'claude-*') {
944	        $fableRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-fable-5')
945	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-fable-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
946	        if (-not $fableRaw) { $fableRaw = $raw }
947	
948	        $opusRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
949	            'claude-opus-5', 'claude-opus-4-8', 'claude-opus-4-7', 'claude-opus-4-6', 'claude-opus-4-5'
950	        )
951	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-opus-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
952	        if (-not $opusRaw) { $opusRaw = $raw }
953	
954	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @(
955	            'claude-sonnet-5', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-sonnet-4-5'
956	        )
957	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-sonnet-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
958	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
959	
960	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('claude-haiku-4-5')
961	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = @($models | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-haiku-*' } | Sort-Object)[-1] }
962	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
963	    }
964	    elseif ($raw -like 'gpt-*' -or $raw -match 'codex') {
965	        $sonnetRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-terra')
966	        if (-not $sonnetRaw) { $sonnetRaw = $raw }
967	        $haikuRaw = Select-CopilotFirstServed -Model $models -Candidate @('gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-mini')
968	        if (-not $haikuRaw) { $haikuRaw = $raw }
969	    }
970	
971	    [ordered]@{
972	        main   = $main
973	        fable  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $fableRaw -Catalog $Catalog
974	        opus   = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $opusRaw -Catalog $Catalog
975	        sonnet = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $sonnetRaw -Catalog $Catalog
976	        haiku  = ConvertTo-CopilotClaudeModel -Model $haikuRaw -Catalog $Catalog
977	    }
978	}

989	# "<model>|<source>" — the model Claude Code would send from this directory.
990	function script:Get-CopilotEffectiveModel {
991	    param([string] $Settings = '.claude/settings.local.json')
992	    $settings = $Settings
993	    if (Test-Path $settings) {
994	        try {
995	            $j = Get-Content -Raw $settings | ConvertFrom-Json
996	            if ($j.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) {
997	                $m = $j.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL
998	                if ($m) { return "$m|project pin: $settings" }
999	                return "|project pin missing ANTHROPIC_MODEL: $settings"
1000	            }
1001	        } catch { $null = $_ }
1002	    }
1003	    if ($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL) { return "$($env:COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL)|`$COPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL" }
1004	    $sf = Get-CopilotModelState
1005	    if (Test-Path $sf) { return "$(Get-Content -First 1 $sf)|state file: $sf" }
1006	    "$(Get-CopilotDefaultModel)|built-in default"
1007	}

1009	# The EXACT env block `copilot-here on` / `copilot-run` would apply right now.
1010	#
1011	# SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for three callers: copilot-run (process env),
1012	# `copilot-here on` (what it merges into settings.local.json) and
1013	# Get-CopilotHereDrift (what it compares against). These used to be hand-maintained
1014	# copies and they diverged — the drift check compared 4 of the 8 keys `on` writes,
1015	# so a pin missing ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL /
1016	# CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC reported "no drift" while `on` would
1017	# still have changed it. Add a key here and all three follow.
1018	#
1019	# -Pinned uses the shim base when the shim is enabled but not yet up (what a
1020	# written-to-disk pin should say); copilot-run wants the live base instead.
1021	function script:Get-CopilotEnvBlock {
1022	    param([switch] $Pinned, [string] $Model = (Get-CopilotDefaultModel), $Catalog)
1023	    $modelProfile = if ($PSBoundParameters.ContainsKey('Catalog')) {
1024	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model -Catalog $Catalog
1025	    } else {
1026	        Get-CopilotModelProfile -Model $Model
1027	    }
1028	    $block = [ordered]@{
1029	        ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL             = if ($Pinned) { Get-CopilotPinnedBase } else { Get-CopilotClientBase }
1030	        ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN           = 'dummy'
1031	        ANTHROPIC_MODEL                = $modelProfile.main
1032	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL  = $modelProfile.fable
1033	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL   = $modelProfile.opus
1034	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL = $modelProfile.sonnet
1035	        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL  = $modelProfile.haiku
1036	        ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL     = $modelProfile.haiku
1037	        CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC = '1'
1038	    }
1039	    if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_QUIET -eq '1') {
1040	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER = '0'
1041	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION = 'false'
1042	        $block.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY = '0'
1043	        $block.DISABLE_NON_ESSENTIAL_MODEL_CALLS = '1'
1044	    }
1045	    $block
1046	}

1048	# --- shim start/stop ---
1049	function script:Start-CopilotShim {
1050	    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }
1051	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1052	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim needs 'bun' (scoop install bun)"; return $false
1053	    }
1054	    $script = Get-CopilotShimScript
1055	    if (-not (Test-Path $script)) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim script not found at $script"; return $false }
1056	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_PORT = Get-CopilotShimPort
1057	    $env:COPILOT_SHIM_UPSTREAM = Get-CopilotBase
1058	    $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'bun' -ArgumentList @($script) -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden `
1059	        -RedirectStandardOutput (Get-CopilotShimLog) -RedirectStandardError "$(Get-CopilotShimLog).err"
1060	    $p.Id | Set-Content -Path (Get-CopilotShimPid)
1061	    for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { return $true }; Start-Sleep 1 }
1062	    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: shim did not come up — check $(Get-CopilotShimLog)"; $false
1063	}
1064	function script:Stop-CopilotShim {
1065	    $pidf = Get-CopilotShimPid
1066	    if (Test-Path $pidf) {
1067	        $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1068	        if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1069	        Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1070	    }
1071	    Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'bun.exe'" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
1072	        Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*copilot-throttle-shim.js*' } |
1073	        ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1074	}

1076	# ============================================================ copilot-proxy ===
1077	function copilot-proxy {
1078	    [CmdletBinding()]
1079	    param([Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments)] [string[]] $Argv)
1080	
1081	    if (-not (Get-Command bun -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
1082	        Write-Error "copilot-proxy: bun not found (scoop install bun)"; return
1083	    }
1084	
1085	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
1086	    $logf = Get-CopilotLogFile; $pidf = Get-CopilotPidFile
1087	    $action = if ($Argv -and $Argv.Count -ge 1) { $Argv[0] } else { 'status' }
1088	
1089	    switch ($action) {
1090	        'start' {
1091	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: already running on port $port"; return }
1092	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) {
1093	                Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated yet — run 'copilot-proxy auth' first."; return
1094	            }
1095	            # Rotate the previous session's log (keep last 3).
1096	            if (Test-Path $logf) {
1097	                Remove-Item "$logf.3" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1098	                if (Test-Path "$logf.2") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.2" "$logf.3" }
1099	                if (Test-Path "$logf.1") { Move-Item -Force "$logf.1" "$logf.2" }
1100	                Move-Item -Force $logf "$logf.1"
1101	            }
1102	            # Install the pinned package BEFORE launching anything. Resolving it at
1103	            # launch (the old `bunx <pkg> start`) is what used to hang forever behind
1104	            # a socks proxy, with nothing but "Resolving dependencies" in the log.
1105	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
1106	            $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
1107	            if (-not $launch) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no runnable copilot-api after install"; return }
1108	
1109	            # Node ignores the Windows System Proxy — it only honours HTTP(S)_PROXY,
1110	            # and the fork additionally needs --proxy-env before its fetch uses them.
1111	            $httpProxy = Resolve-CopilotHttpProxy
1112	            if ($httpProxy) {
1113	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: Node will fetch /models via $httpProxy (--proxy-env; COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=$(if ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY) { $env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY } else { 'auto' }))"
1114	            } elseif ($env:COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY -in 'always', 'on', '1', 'true', 'yes') {
1115	                Write-Warning "copilot-proxy: COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=always but no proxy detected — starting DIRECT (the Claude catalog may be geo-filtered)."
1116	                Write-Host "  hint: enable the Clash/Verge System Proxy, or set COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7897"
1117	            }
1118	
1119	            $argList = @($launch.Pre + @('start', '--port', $port))
1120	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
1121	                $rate = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE) { $env:COPILOT_PROXY_RATE } else { '15' }
1122	                # Original package: HTTPS_PROXY alone is enough (it has no --proxy-env).
1123	                $argList += @('--rate-limit', $rate, '--wait')
1124	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port (rate-limit ${rate}s) ..."
1125	            } else {
1126	                if ($httpProxy) { $argList += '--proxy-env' }
1127	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: starting ($pkg) on port $port ..."
1128	            }
1129	
1130	            # Scope the proxy env to the child: set, spawn, restore.
1131	            $proxyVars = 'HTTP_PROXY', 'HTTPS_PROXY', 'http_proxy', 'https_proxy'
1132	            $saved = @{}
1133	            if ($httpProxy) {
1134	                foreach ($v in $proxyVars) { $saved[$v] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($v); Set-Item "env:$v" $httpProxy }
1135	            }
1136	            try {
1137	                $spArgs = @{
1138	                    FilePath                = $launch.Exe
1139	                    ArgumentList            = $argList
1140	                    PassThru                = $true
1141	                    WindowStyle             = 'Hidden'
1142	                    RedirectStandardOutput  = $logf
1143	                    RedirectStandardError   = "$logf.err"
1144	                }
1145	                if ($launch.Cwd) { $spArgs.WorkingDirectory = $launch.Cwd }
1146	                $p = Start-Process @spArgs
1147	            } finally {
1148	                if ($httpProxy) {
1149	                    foreach ($v in $proxyVars) {
1150	                        if ($null -eq $saved[$v]) { Remove-Item "env:$v" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1151	                        else { Set-Item "env:$v" $saved[$v] }
1152	                    }
1153	                }
1154	            }
1155	            $p.Id | Set-Content -Path $pidf
1156	            $startTimeout = if ($env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT) { [int]$env:COPILOT_PROXY_START_TIMEOUT } else { 45 }
1157	            for ($i = 0; $i -lt $startTimeout; $i++) {
1158	                if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
1159	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
1160	                        if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: throttle shim up -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
1161	                    }
1162	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: up -> $(Get-CopilotClientBase)  (logs: copilot-proxy logs)"
1163	                    return
1164	                }
1165	                # Crashed on its own (bad flag, port taken, auth) — don't sit out the
1166	                # remaining seconds pretending we're still waiting.
1167	                if ($p.HasExited) {
1168	                    Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1169	                    Write-Error "copilot-proxy: server exited during startup — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."; return
1170	                }
1171	                Start-Sleep 1
1172	            }
1173	            # Timed out. REAP what we spawned: the old code returned and left it
1174	            # running, so each retry stacked another orphan and none ever bound the port.
1175	            Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1176	            Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1177	            Write-Error "copilot-proxy: did not come up in time — check 'copilot-proxy logs'."
1178	        }
1179	        'stop' {
1180	            Stop-CopilotShim
1181	            if (Test-Path $pidf) {
1182	                $pid_ = Get-Content -First 1 $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1183	                if ($pid_) { Stop-Process -Id $pid_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1184	                Remove-Item $pidf -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1185	            }
1186	            Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
1187	                Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like "*copilot-api*--port $port*" } |
1188	                ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
1189	            Start-Sleep 1
1190	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: still answering on $port (another instance?)"; return }
1191	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: stopped (port $port free)"
1192	        }
1193	        'restart' { copilot-proxy stop; copilot-proxy start }
1194	        'status' {
1195	            if (Test-CopilotAlive) {
1196	                $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
1197	                $rawIds = Get-CopilotCatalogIds $catalog
1198	                $claude = @($rawIds | Where-Object { $_ -like 'claude-*' })
1199	                $claudeText = if ($claude.Count -gt 0) { $claude -join ' ' } else { 'none' }
1200	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: RUNNING on $(Get-CopilotBase)"
1201	                Write-Host "  models: $($rawIds.Count) served; Claude: $claudeText"
1202	                if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
1203	                    if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { Write-Host "  shim:   ON, up on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)  -> clients use this" }
1204	                    else { Write-Host "  shim:   ON but DOWN (clients fall back to $(Get-CopilotBase))" }
1205	                } else { Write-Host "  shim:   off  (enable: copilot-proxy shim on)" }
1206	            } else {
1207	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running on port $port  (start: copilot-proxy start)"
1208	            }
1209	        }
1210	        { $_ -in 'doctor', 'test' } { Invoke-CopilotDoctor -Live:($Argv -contains '--live') }
1211	        'logs' {
1212	            if ($Argv.Count -ge 2 -and $Argv[1] -eq 'shim') {
1213	                $lf = Get-CopilotShimLog; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 3) { [int]$Argv[2] } else { 40 }
1214	            } else {
1215	                $lf = $logf; $n = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { [int]$Argv[1] } else { 40 }
1216	                if ($Argv.Count -ge 3 -and $Argv[2] -in '1', '2', '3') { $lf = "$logf.$($Argv[2])" }
1217	            }
1218	            if (Test-Path $lf) { Get-Content -Tail $n $lf }
1219	            elseif (Test-Path "$lf.err") { Get-Content -Tail $n "$lf.err" }
1220	            else { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: no log file at $lf" }
1221	        }
1222	        'auth' {
1223	            # One-time device login -> stores a ghu_ token copilot-api can exchange.
1224	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: launching copilot-api device login ..."
1225	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth }
1226	            else { Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand auth login --provider copilot }
1227	        }
1228	        'reinstall' {
1229	            # Force a clean re-install of the pinned spec (normally only needed if the
1230	            # prefix got corrupted — a version bump re-installs on its own via the stamp).
1231	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: removing $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) ..."
1232	            Remove-Item -Recurse -Force (Get-CopilotPkgPrefix) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1233	            if (-not (Install-CopilotPkg)) { return }
1234	            $installed = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
1235	            Write-Host "copilot-proxy: installed $($installed.Name)@$($installed.Version) (requested $(Get-CopilotPkg)) -> $(Get-CopilotPkgPrefix)"
1236	        }
1237	        { $_ -in 'whoami', 'usage' } {
1238	            if (-not (Test-Path (Get-CopilotToken))) { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: not authenticated — run 'copilot-proxy auth'."; return }
1239	            if ((Get-CopilotPkgFlavor) -eq 'original') {
1240	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand check-usage
1241	            }
1242	            elseif (Test-CopilotAlive) {
1243	                try {
1244	                    $u = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$(Get-CopilotBase)/usage" -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction Stop
1245	                    [pscustomobject]@{
1246	                        plan        = if ($u.copilot_plan) { $u.copilot_plan } elseif ($u.access_type_sku) { $u.access_type_sku } else { 'unknown' }
1247	                        quota_reset = $u.quota_reset_date
1248	                        quotas      = $u.quota_snapshots
1249	                    } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
1250	                } catch { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: /usage query failed: $_" }
1251	            } else {
1252	                Write-Host "copilot-proxy: not running — showing auth/debug info instead of quota."
1253	                Invoke-CopilotPkgCommand debug
1254	            }
1255	        }
1256	        'shim' {
1257	            $sf = Get-CopilotShimState
1258	            $sub = if ($Argv.Count -ge 2) { $Argv[1] } else { 'status' }
1259	            switch ($sub) {
1260	                'on' {
1261	                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $sf) | Out-Null
1262	                    'on' | Set-Content $sf
1263	                    if (Test-CopilotAlive) { if (Start-CopilotShim) { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON -> $(Get-CopilotShimBase) (-> $(Get-CopilotBase))" } }
1264	                    else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim enabled; will start with the proxy." }
1265	                    Write-Host "  NOTE: restart Claude Code so it picks up ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
1266	                }
1267	                'off' {
1268	                    'off' | Set-Content $sf; Stop-CopilotShim
1269	                    Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim OFF (clients use $(Get-CopilotBase) directly)"
1270	                }
1271	                default {
1272	                    if (Get-CopilotShimEnabled) {
1273	                        $st = if (Test-CopilotShimAlive) { 'up' } else { 'down' }
1274	                        Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim ON ($st) on $(Get-CopilotShimBase)"
1275	                    } else { Write-Host "copilot-proxy: shim off" }
1276	                }
1277	            }
1278	        }
1279	        { $_ -in '-h', '--help', 'help' } {
1280	            Write-Host "Usage: copilot-proxy [start|stop|restart|status|doctor [--live]|logs [shim|N [gen]]|shim [on|off|status]|whoami|auth|reinstall]"
1281	            Write-Host "  doctor (alias: test)  diagnose prereqs, package, auth, proxy, Claude catalog, Codex Apps"
1282	            Write-Host "                        (direct vs via proxy), upstream. --live costs 1 quota unit."
1283	            Write-Host "  COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY    auto|always|never|http://127.0.0.1:PORT  (default auto)"
1284	            Write-Host "                        auto attaches --proxy-env when a System/env proxy is found."
1285	            Write-Host "  reinstall             wipe + re-install the pinned package (a version bump"
1286	            Write-Host "                        re-installs on its own; this is for a corrupted prefix)."
1287	        }
1288	        default { Write-Error "copilot-proxy: unknown action '$action' (try --help)" }
1289	    }
1290	}
1291	
1292	# ------------------------------------------------------------------ doctor ----
1293	function script:Invoke-CopilotDoctor {
1294	    param([switch] $Live)
1295	    $port = Get-CopilotPort; $pkg = Get-CopilotPkg
1296	    $fail = 0; $warn = 0
1297	    function OK   ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2713 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Green }
1298	    function BAD  ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x2717 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Red; $script:fail++ }
1299	    function NOTE ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  ! {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) -ForegroundColor Yellow; $script:warn++ }
1300	    function SKIP ($n, $m) { Write-Host ("  " + [char]0x00B7 + " {0,-16} {1}" -f $n, $m) }
1301	    function HINT ($m)     { Write-Host ("    {0,-16} -> {1}" -f '', $m) }
1302	    $script:fail = 0; $script:warn = 0
1303	
1304	    Write-Host "`ncopilot-proxy doctor   port $port   pkg $pkg`n"
1305	
1306	    # This is the doctor's only /v1/models fetch. The same snapshot determines
1307	    # liveness, raw ids, aliases, role checks and the optional live target.
1308	    $catalog = Get-CopilotModelCatalog
1309	    $proxyAlive = $null -ne $catalog
1310	
1311	    Write-Host 'Prerequisites'
1312	    foreach ($t in 'bun', 'node', 'uv') {
1313	        $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
1314	        if ($c) { OK $t $c.Source } elseif ($t -eq 'uv') { NOTE $t 'not found — semsearch needs it' } else { BAD $t 'not found' }
1315	    }
1316	
1317	    Write-Host "`nPackage"
1318	    # The proxy runs an INSTALLED binary, not `bunx <pkg>` — so a warm start does no
1319	    # network at all. Report live metadata even when it disagrees with the selector.
1320	    $installedMetadata = Get-CopilotPkgMetadata
1321	    $installedStamp = Get-CopilotPkgStampMetadata
1322	    $launch = Get-CopilotPkgLaunch
1323	    if (Test-CopilotPkgReady) {
1324	        OK 'installed' "$($installedMetadata.Name)@$($installedMetadata.Version) (requested $pkg)"
1325	        $how = "$($launch.Exe) $($launch.Pre -join ' ')".Trim()
1326	        if ($launch.Cwd) { $how += "   (cwd: $($launch.Cwd))" }
1327	        SKIP 'runs via' $how
1328	    } elseif ($installedMetadata) {
1329	        NOTE 'installed' "$($installedMetadata.Name)@$($installedMetadata.Version) does not verify requested $pkg"
1330	        $exactVersion = Get-CopilotPkgExactVersion
1331	        if ($installedMetadata.Name -cne (Get-CopilotPkgName)) {
1332	            HINT "metadata name mismatch: wanted $(Get-CopilotPkgName), found $($installedMetadata.Name)"
1333	        } elseif ($exactVersion -and $installedMetadata.Version -cne $exactVersion) {
1334	            HINT "metadata version mismatch: wanted $exactVersion, found $($installedMetadata.Version)"
1335	        } elseif (-not $launch) {
1336	            HINT 'metadata exists but no runnable launch path is available'
1337	        } elseif (-not $installedStamp) {
1338	            HINT 'verified JSON stamp is absent or corrupt'
1339	        } else {

212	## Package registries
213	
214	One shared policy is applied both at install time and in interactive shells
215	(`profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`):
216	
217	- **Managed machines** route pip/uv through the company PyPI pull-through
218	  registry and npm through the company npm pull-through registry. The PyPI path
219	  ultimately serves artifacts from the corporate Azure Artifacts backend. IT
220	  provisions NuGet separately, so the dotfiles do not rewrite it.
221	- **China mirrors** apply only on non-managed machines: pip/uv use Tsinghua,
222	  npm uses npmmirror, RubyGems uses Ruby China, Go uses goproxy.cn, and rustup
223	  uses rsproxy. Scoop runtime downloads are unaffected.
224	- No company Go, Rust, or Ruby registry was discovered, so managed machines
225	  leave those ecosystems at their existing defaults.
226	
227	Managed policy wins when both machine toggles are true. A separate
228	`allowPublicPackageFallback` prompt is **off by default**. When enabled on a
229	managed machine, repo-owned npm agent installs/updates and uv dependency
230	resolution (Apprise, LiteLLM, Herdr tomlkit, and docs commands) try the corporate
231	source first. A timeout, temporary network failure, or explicit HTTP 5xx may
232	trigger exactly one source-isolated retry against public PyPI/npm. Authentication
233	or policy errors (401/403), TLS/certificate failures, 404/package absence, rate
234	limits, solver/build errors, and local permission failures never fall back.
235	
236	Corporate and public indexes are never configured together. Each attempt clears
237	extra index/registry inputs in its child process, preserves the parent shell and
238	cache, and reports the retry explicitly. Switching source modes also removes only
239	endpoint values previously written by this repo, preserving unrelated user/IT
240	overrides loaded later from `local.ps1`.
