50	        $probe = Invoke-DocsCommand -Command version
51	        if (-not $probe.Succeeded) { exit $probe.ExitCode }
52	
53	        $uvExecutable = (Get-Command uv -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1).Source
54	        $serveArguments = @(
55	            'run', '--no-project', '--with', 'mkdocs-material', '--with', 'mkdocs-static-i18n',
56	            'mkdocs', 'serve'
57	        )
58	        $finalSource = $probe.Attempts[-1].Source
59	        $environment = @{}
60	        if ($finalSource -ne 'ambient') {
61	            $sourceUrl = if ($finalSource -eq 'corporate') { $script:CorporatePyPiIndex } else { $script:PublicPyPiIndex }
62	            $serveArguments = Add-UvSourceArguments -Arguments $serveArguments -SourceUrl $sourceUrl
63	            $environment = New-PackageAttemptEnvironment -Manager uv
64	        }
65	        $serve = Invoke-InteractivePackageProcess -Executable $uvExecutable -Arguments $serveArguments `
66	            -Environment $environment -WorkingDirectory $repoRoot
67	        if ($serve.ExitCode -ne 0) { exit $serve.ExitCode }
68	    }
69	}

107	
108	def emit(text):

115	except ModuleNotFoundError:

134	# Tables the template owns outright.

137	FORCED = {("update", "channel"): "preview"}

139	with open(live_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
140	    live_text = fh.read().strip()
141	
142	doc = tomlkit.parse(template_text)  # base, with comments intact
143	try:
144	    live = tomllib.loads(live_text) if live_text else {}
145	except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError:
146	    # A corrupt live file must not block the apply — enforce the template.
147	    print("modify_config.toml: live config is not valid TOML; enforcing template", file=sys.stderr)
148	    live = {}

151	    if key in MANAGED:

153	    if key in doc:
154	        # The template also declares this table. Keep herdr's runtime keys and
155	        # let the template win only on the keys it actually sets.
156	        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(doc[key], dict):
157	            for sub_key, sub_value in value.items():
158	                if sub_key not in doc[key]:
159	                    doc[key][sub_key] = sub_value
160	        continue
161	    doc[key] = value

163	for (table, sub_key), forced_value in FORCED.items():
164	    if table not in doc:
165	        doc[table] = tomlkit.table()
166	    doc[table][sub_key] = forced_value

201	        Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($templateText)

397	# from the OpenPeon registry). Installed regardless of the `agentSounds` tier so

401	#
402	# `--openpeon` reroots the whole install at the tool-agnostic ~/.openpeon so the
403	# installer never touches ~/.claude/settings.json — hook wiring is ours to
404	# declare (same rule the parent repo applies to workmux's `wm setup`).
405	# NB: the PowerShell installer's param block is
406	#   param([string[]]$Packs, [switch]$All, [string]$Lang, [switch]$Local,
407	#         [switch]$Global, [switch]$OpenPeon, [switch]$InitLocalConfig)

411	$peonRoot = Join-Path $HOME '.openpeon'
412	$peonHook = Join-Path $peonRoot 'hooks\peon-ping\peon.ps1'
413	if (-not (Test-Path $peonHook)) {
414	    Info 'peon-ping (agent completion sounds, ~/.openpeon root)'
415	    try {
416	        # Upstream install.ps1 dot-sources scripts/install-utils.ps1 relative to
417	        # $PSScriptRoot when run via -File; it only self-downloads that helper
418	        # when $PSScriptRoot is empty (irm|iex). So stage BOTH files preserving

420	        $peonStage = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'peon-ping-install'
421	        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $peonStage 'scripts') | Out-Null
422	        $peonInstaller = Join-Path $peonStage 'install.ps1'

424	            -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PeonPing/peon-ping/main/install.ps1' `
425	            -OutFile $peonInstaller
426	        Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop `
427	            -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PeonPing/peon-ping/main/scripts/install-utils.ps1' `
428	            -OutFile (Join-Path $peonStage 'scripts\install-utils.ps1')
429	        & powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $peonInstaller `
430	            -OpenPeon -Packs 'league_of_legends'
431	        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Register-Failure 'peon-ping' }
432	        # The installer downloads the pack but leaves default_pack="peon" — a pack
433	        # that ships NO sounds — so a fresh install is silent ("No sound files
434	        # found for pack 'peon'"). Activate the pack we just seeded. Runs only on
435	        # first install (whole block is guarded on peon.ps1 absence), so a pack the
436	        # user later switches to via `peon packs use` is never clobbered.
437	        $peonCli = Join-Path $HOME '.local\bin\peon.cmd'
438	        if (Test-Path $peonCli) {
439	            & $peonCli packs use league_of_legends
440	            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Register-Failure 'peon-ping:activate-pack' }
441	        } else {
442	            Register-Failure 'peon-ping:activate-pack (peon CLI shim missing)'
443	        }
444	    } catch {
445	        Register-Failure 'peon-ping'
446	    }

449	}

643	# Linux (dot_ansible/roles/go_tools); macOS there uses the Homebrew tap.
644	# GOBIN/GOPATH mirror that unix convention: the binary lands in ~/.local/bin
645	# (already on PATH via profile.d/00_env.ps1) and the module cache in
646	# ~/.local/share/go rather than recreating ~/go.
647	#
648	# It is pure Go (modernc.org/sqlite -- no cgo) and cross-compiles cleanly for
649	# windows/amd64 and windows/arm64. The FIRST build is slow (several minutes: the
650	# embedded swagger-ui bundle + sqlite); later applies no-op via the version check
651	# below. Bump $translateVersion to upgrade -- editing it re-renders this script,
652	# which is what re-fires the run_onchange. go.mod needs go >= 1.26.4; the default
653	# GOTOOLCHAIN=auto fetches a newer toolchain if scoop's go is older.
654	$translateVersion = 'v0.5.2'
655	Scoop-Install @('go')   # self-contained: installExtraRuntimes may well be off
656	if (Have go) {

658	    $trHave = ''
659	    # `translate --version` prints "translate version v0.5.2 ..."; a module-proxy
660	    # build carries no VCS metadata, so token 3 is exactly the module version. An
661	    # absent/unparseable answer just falls through to a reinstall, which is cheap
662	    # once the module cache is warm.
663	    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $trBin) {
664	        try { $trHave = ((& $trBin --version 2>$null) -split '\s+')[2] } catch { $trHave = '' }
665	    }
666	    if ($trHave -eq $translateVersion) {
667	        Info "translate $translateVersion already installed"
668	    } else {
669	        Info "go install translate@$translateVersion (first build takes several minutes)"
670	        $env:GOBIN  = Join-Path $HOME '.local\bin'
671	        $env:GOPATH = Join-Path $HOME '.local\share\go'
672	        go install "github.com/daviddwlee84/translate@$translateVersion" 2>&1 | Out-Host
673	        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $trBin)) {
674	            Register-Failure "go:translate@$translateVersion"
675	        }
676	    }

<tool-use data-tool-type="read" data-tool-name="Read"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Read**</summary>
 `C:\Users\hanruzhou\.local\share\chezmoi\pitfalls\packagefeedproxy-pypi-503-azure-artifacts-backend.md`

```text
1	# uv fails with HTTP 503 while downloading from the company PyPI feed
2	
3	**Symptoms**: `Request failed after 3 retries`, `HTTP status server error (503 Service Unavailable)`, final URL under `ms-feed-*.pkgs.visualstudio.com`, `just docs-build` fails although the configured index is `packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/pypi/simple`
4	
5	**First seen**: 2026-08  
6	**Affects**: managed Windows machines using uv through the company PyPI pull-through feed  
7	**Status**: source-isolated opt-in fallback implemented
8	
9	## Symptom
10	
11	A managed shell configures:
12	
13	```text
14	UV_DEFAULT_INDEX=https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/pypi/simple/
15	```
16	
17	but uv reports the failure against a different-looking host:
18	
19	```text
20	error: Request failed after 3 retries
21	Caused by: Failed to fetch: https://ms-feed-*.pkgs.visualstudio.com/.../pypi/download/...
22	Caused by: HTTP status server error (503 Service Unavailable)
23	```
24	
25	A successful feed-root or package-metadata probe does not disprove the problem;
26	the redirected artifact download can fail independently.
27	
28	## Root cause
29	
30	`packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io` is the configured company pull-through endpoint.
31	It resolves package artifacts through an Azure Artifacts backend, so uv displays
32	the final `*.pkgs.visualstudio.com` download URL when that backend returns 503.
33	This is not a malformed PyPI URL and does not show that `pypi.org` itself failed.
34	
35	## Workaround
36	
37	The default remains corporate-only. On a machine where public fallback is
38	explicitly permitted, enable the `Allow one public PyPI/npm retry after eligible
39	corporate feed failures` init prompt and re-apply/reload the profile.
40	
41	Repo-owned npm/uv commands then:
42	
43	1. try only the corporate source;
44	2. classify the captured failure;
45	3. retry exactly once against only the public source for timeout, temporary
46	   network errors, or explicit HTTP 5xx.
47	
48	For a one-off manual docs build without changing the prompt:
49	
50	```powershell
51	uv run --no-project --no-config `
52	  --default-index https://pypi.org/simple --index-strategy first-index `
53	  --with mkdocs-material --with mkdocs-static-i18n mkdocs build --strict
54	```
55	
56	## Prevention
57	
58	- Never configure public PyPI as an `extra-index` beside the company feed.
59	- Never fall back on 401/403, TLS/certificate, policy, 404/package-absence,
60	  rate-limit, solver/build, or local permission failures.
61	- Keep fallback command-scoped; do not rewrite the parent shell or npmrc.
62	- Test artifact resolution, not only the index root.
63	- Keep `scripts/package-source-runner.ps1` covered by deterministic fake-command
64	  tests so classification does not broaden accidentally.
65	
66	## Related
67	
68	- [`packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path`](packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path.md)
69	- [`docs/tools.md`](../docs/tools.md#package-registries)
70	- `AGENTS.md` hard invariant 8
71
```
</details></tool-use>

 #!/usr/bin/env pwsh
 # chezmoi modify_ script: overlay a managed herdr config onto ~/.config/herdr/config.toml.
 #
 # Runs under pwsh via [interpreters.ps1] in .chezmoi.toml.tmpl. chezmoi pipes the
 # CURRENT target file into stdin and takes the new contents from stdout.
 #
 # WHY AN OVERLAY (this replaced a plain managed dot_config/herdr/config.toml):
 # herdr rewrites this file at runtime — the onboarding flag, in-app settings
 # popups, [session] / [remote] / [experimental] / [update] state. A plain managed
 # file clobbers all of that on every `chezmoi apply`, which can re-trigger
 # onboarding. The parent (unix) repo hit this and moved create_ -> modify_ on
 # 2026-07-06; this repo's config was added five days later and still used the
 # plain form. Same fix, ported.
 #
 # MERGE MODEL — template-as-base, pull-through unmanaged keys:
 #   - Base = the managed template (.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml), which
 #     carries the comments + the tmux-parity rationale.
 #   - Every TOP-LEVEL key in the live file that is NOT managed and NOT already in
 #     the template is copied across (preserves onboarding, [session], [remote],
 #     [experimental], and any future herdr writeback).
 #   - Managed tables are enforced wholesale (template wins).
 #   - FORCED single keys are re-asserted INTO a pulled-through table, so the table
 #     keeps herdr's own bookkeeping. Windows needs exactly one: update.channel
 #     must stay "preview" (the installer rejects "stable" on Windows builds), but
 #     [update] also holds herdr's last-check state, which we do not want to wipe.
 #     This sub-key merge is the one deliberate divergence from the unix overlay.
 #
 # WHY tomlkit (not a hand-rolled emitter): herdr's config has an array-of-tables
 # ([[keys.command]]) and comments worth keeping; stdlib tomllib is read-only.
 # Python runtime: prefer `uv` (guarantees >=3.11 -> stdlib tomllib), fall back to
 # system python, then to emitting the raw template (a fresh host with neither
 # still gets a full config — note we emit the TEMPLATE, not stdin, because on a
 # fresh host stdin is empty).
 #
 # To manage an additional key: edit .chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml.
 # Validate the result with `herdr server reload-config` (empty diagnostics).
 
 $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
 
 # modify_ scripts run under `pwsh -NoProfile`, so the deployed 05_mirrors.ps1
 # fragment is not loaded here. Apply the same source policy inline before uv
 # resolves tomlkit: managed machines must use the IT-approved pull-through feed.
 {{ template "package-sources.ps1" . }}
+$managedMachine = {{ if .managedMachine }}$true{{ else }}$false{{ end }}
+$allowPublicPackageFallback = {{ if (get . "allowPublicPackageFallback") }}$true{{ else }}$false{{ end }}
+{{ include "scripts/package-source-runner.ps1" }}
 
 # Emit bytes verbatim so nothing re-encodes the config's ⭐ / box-drawing glyphs
 # and no BOM or trailing CRLF churn creeps into chezmoi's diff.
 function Write-StdoutBytes {
     param([byte[]] $Bytes)
     $out = [Console]::OpenStandardOutput()
     $out.Write($Bytes, 0, $Bytes.Length)
     $out.Flush()

 $utf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)   # no BOM
 
 $templateText = @'
 {{ template "herdr/config.toml" . }}
 '@
 
 $liveText = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
 
 $tmpDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()
 $stamp = [System.IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName()
 $tmplFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "herdr-tmpl-$stamp.toml"
 $liveFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "herdr-live-$stamp.toml"
 $pyFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "herdr-merge-$stamp.py"
 $outFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "herdr-out-$stamp.toml"
 
 try {
     [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($tmplFile, $templateText, $utf8)
     [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($liveFile, $liveText, $utf8)
 
     # Pick a Python. uv is in this repo's scoop package set; `python` is the
     # uv-managed default install (--default --preview creates the unversioned shim).
     $py = $null
-    if (Get-Command uv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {

-    } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
-        $py = @('python')
-    } elseif (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {

+    $pyUsesPackageRunner = $false

+    if ($uvCommand) {

     $pySource = @'
 import os
 import sys
 
 tmpl_path = os.environ["HERDR_TEMPLATE_FILE"]
 live_path = os.environ["HERDR_LIVE_FILE"]
 out_path = os.environ["HERDR_OUT_FILE"]
 
 with open(tmpl_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
     template_text = fh.read()
 
 
 def emit(text):
     with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
         fh.write(text)
 
 
 try:
     import tomllib  # Python 3.11+
 except ModuleNotFoundError:
     try:
         import tomli as tomllib
     except ModuleNotFoundError:

 except ModuleNotFoundError:

120	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [AllowEmptyCollection()] [string[]] $Arguments,
121	        [hashtable] $Environment = @{},
122	        [string] $WorkingDirectory,
123	        [ValidateRange(1, 86400)] [int] $TimeoutSeconds = 600,
124	        [ValidateSet('Host', 'StandardError', 'Capture')] [string] $OutputMode = 'Host'
125	    )
126	
127	    $startInfo = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
128	    $startInfo.FileName = $Executable
129	    $startInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
130	    $startInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
131	    $startInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
132	    $startInfo.RedirectStandardError = $true
133	    if ($WorkingDirectory) { $startInfo.WorkingDirectory = $WorkingDirectory }
134	    foreach ($argument in $Arguments) { $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add([string] $argument) }
135	    foreach ($name in $Environment.Keys) {
136	        if ($null -eq $Environment[$name]) { $startInfo.Environment.Remove([string] $name) }
137	        else { $startInfo.Environment[[string] $name] = [string] $Environment[$name] }
138	    }
139	
140	    $process = [Diagnostics.Process]::new()
141	    $process.StartInfo = $startInfo
142	    $timedOut = $false
143	    $launchFailed = $false
144	    $exitCode = -1
145	    $stdout = ''
146	    $stderr = ''
147	    try {
148	        try {
149	            if (-not $process.Start()) { throw 'process did not start' }
150	        } catch {
151	            $launchFailed = $true
152	            $stderr = "failed to start $Executable`: $($_.Exception.Message)"
153	            return [pscustomobject]@{
154	                ExitCode = -1; TimedOut = $false; LaunchFailed = $true
155	                Stdout = ''; Stderr = (Protect-PackageSourceOutput $stderr)
156	            }
157	        }
158	
159	        $stdoutTask = $process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
160	        $stderrTask = $process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
161	        $terminated = $true
162	        if (-not $process.WaitForExit($TimeoutSeconds * 1000)) {
163	            $timedOut = $true
164	            $terminated = $false
165	            try {
166	                $process.Kill($true)
167	                $terminated = $process.WaitForExit(5000)
168	            } catch {
169	                $terminated = $false
170	            }
171	        }
172	        if ($terminated) {
173	            $stdout = $stdoutTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
174	            $stderr = $stderrTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
175	        } else {
176	            $stderr = "process timed out and could not be terminated: $Executable"
177	        }
178	        $exitCode = if ($timedOut) { -1 } else { $process.ExitCode }
179	    } finally {
180	        $process.Dispose()
181	    }
182	
183	    $stdout = Protect-PackageSourceOutput $stdout
184	    $stderr = Protect-PackageSourceOutput $stderr
185	    if ($OutputMode -eq 'Host') {
186	        if ($stdout) { Write-Host $stdout.TrimEnd() }
187	        if ($stderr) { [Console]::Error.Write($stderr) }
188	    } elseif ($OutputMode -eq 'StandardError') {
189	        if ($stdout) { [Console]::Error.Write($stdout) }
190	        if ($stderr) { [Console]::Error.Write($stderr) }
191	    }
192	
193	    [pscustomobject]@{
194	        ExitCode = $exitCode
195	        TimedOut = $timedOut
196	        LaunchFailed = $launchFailed
197	        Stdout = $stdout
198	        Stderr = $stderr
199	    }
200	}

262	function Add-UvSourceArguments {
263	    param(
264	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string[]] $Arguments,
265	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $SourceUrl
266	    )
267	
268	    $sourceArguments = @('--default-index', $SourceUrl, '--index-strategy', 'first-index')
269	    if ($Arguments.Count -ge 2 -and $Arguments[0] -eq 'tool' -and $Arguments[1] -eq 'install') {
270	        $remaining = if ($Arguments.Count -gt 2) { @($Arguments[2..($Arguments.Count - 1)]) } else { @() }
271	        return @('--no-config', 'tool', 'install') + $sourceArguments + $remaining
272	    }

274	        $remaining = if ($Arguments.Count -gt 1) { @($Arguments[1..($Arguments.Count - 1)]) } else { @() }
275	        return @('--no-config', 'run') + $sourceArguments + $remaining
276	    }
277	    throw "unsupported isolated uv command: $($Arguments -join ' ')"

280	function Invoke-PackageSourceCommand {
281	    [CmdletBinding()]
282	    param(
283	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [ValidateSet('uv', 'npm')] [string] $Manager,
284	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Executable,
285	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [AllowEmptyCollection()] [string[]] $Arguments,
286	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Operation,
287	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [bool] $ManagedMachine,
288	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [bool] $AllowPublicFallback,
289	        [string] $PackageSpec,
290	        [string] $NpmPrefix,
291	        [string] $NpmCache,
292	        [hashtable] $AdditionalEnvironment = @{},
293	        [ValidateSet('Host', 'StandardError', 'Capture')] [string] $OutputMode = 'Host',
294	        [ValidateRange(1, 86400)] [int] $TimeoutSeconds = 600,
295	        [string] $CorporatePyPiIndex = $script:CorporatePyPiIndex,
296	        [string] $PublicPyPiIndex = $script:PublicPyPiIndex,
297	        [string] $CorporateNpmRegistry = $script:CorporateNpmRegistry,
298	        [string] $PublicNpmRegistry = $script:PublicNpmRegistry
299	    )
300	
301	    $attempts = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
302	    $tempRoot = $null
303	    try {
304	        $workingDirectory = $null
305	        $baseEnvironment = @{}
306	        foreach ($key in $AdditionalEnvironment.Keys) { $baseEnvironment[$key] = $AdditionalEnvironment[$key] }
307	        if ($ManagedMachine) {
308	            $baseEnvironment = New-PackageAttemptEnvironment -Manager $Manager -AdditionalEnvironment $AdditionalEnvironment
309	            if ($Manager -eq 'npm') {
310	                if (-not $NpmPrefix) { throw 'NpmPrefix is required for npm source isolation' }
311	                $tempRoot = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('package-source-npm-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
312	                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tempRoot | Out-Null
313	                $userConfig = Join-Path $tempRoot 'user.npmrc'
314	                $globalConfig = Join-Path $tempRoot 'global.npmrc'
315	                [IO.File]::WriteAllText($userConfig, '', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
316	                [IO.File]::WriteAllText($globalConfig, '', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
317	                $baseEnvironment['NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG'] = $userConfig
318	                $baseEnvironment['NPM_CONFIG_GLOBALCONFIG'] = $globalConfig
319	                $workingDirectory = $tempRoot
320	            }
321	        }
322	
323	        $sourceQueue = [Collections.Generic.Queue[string]]::new()
324	        $sourceQueue.Enqueue($(if ($ManagedMachine) { 'corporate' } else { 'ambient' }))
325	        while ($sourceQueue.Count -gt 0) {
326	            $sourceKind = $sourceQueue.Dequeue()
327	            $attemptNumber = $attempts.Count + 1
328	            $sourceLabel = if ($sourceKind -eq 'ambient') { 'ambient package policy' } elseif ($Manager -eq 'uv') { "$sourceKind PyPI" } else { "$sourceKind npm" }
329	            Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: attempt $attemptNumber using $sourceLabel"
330	
331	            $attemptArguments = @($Arguments)
332	            $attemptEnvironment = @{} + $baseEnvironment
333	            if ($sourceKind -ne 'ambient') {
334	                $sourceUrl = if ($Manager -eq 'uv') {
335	                    if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') { $CorporatePyPiIndex } else { $PublicPyPiIndex }
336	                } else {
337	                    if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') { $CorporateNpmRegistry } else { $PublicNpmRegistry }
338	                }
339	                if ($Manager -eq 'uv') {
340	                    $attemptArguments = Add-UvSourceArguments -Arguments $attemptArguments -SourceUrl $sourceUrl
341	                } else {
342	                    $attemptArguments += "--registry=$sourceUrl"
343	                    $scope = Get-NpmPackageScope -PackageSpec $PackageSpec
344	                    if ($scope) { $attemptArguments += "--$scope`:registry=$sourceUrl" }
345	                    $attemptArguments += "--prefix=$NpmPrefix"
346	                    if ($NpmCache) { $attemptArguments += "--cache=$NpmCache" }
347	                }
348	            }
349	
350	            $processResult = Invoke-CapturedPackageProcess -Executable $Executable -Arguments $attemptArguments `
351	                -Environment $attemptEnvironment -WorkingDirectory $workingDirectory `
352	                -TimeoutSeconds $TimeoutSeconds -OutputMode $OutputMode
353	            $combinedOutput = "$($processResult.Stdout)`n$($processResult.Stderr)"
354	            $failureClass = if ($processResult.ExitCode -eq 0) { 'none' } else {
355	                Get-PackageFailureClass -Output $combinedOutput -TimedOut $processResult.TimedOut -LaunchFailed $processResult.LaunchFailed
356	            }
357	            $attempts.Add([pscustomobject]@{
358	                Source = $sourceKind
359	                ExitCode = $processResult.ExitCode
360	                TimedOut = $processResult.TimedOut
361	                FailureClass = $failureClass
362	                Stdout = $processResult.Stdout
363	                Stderr = $processResult.Stderr
364	            })
365	
366	            if ($processResult.ExitCode -eq 0) { break }
367	            Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: $sourceKind attempt failed: $failureClass"
368	
369	            if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate' -and $AllowPublicFallback -and (Test-PackageFallbackEligible $failureClass)) {
370	                Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: public fallback enabled; retrying once"
371	                $sourceQueue.Enqueue('public')
372	            } elseif ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') {
373	                $reason = if (-not $AllowPublicFallback) { 'fallback is disabled' } else { "$failureClass is not eligible" }
374	                Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: $reason; not retrying"
375	            }
376	        }
377	
378	        $final = $attempts[$attempts.Count - 1]
379	        [pscustomobject]@{
380	            Succeeded = $final.ExitCode -eq 0
381	            ExitCode = $final.ExitCode
382	            TimedOut = $final.TimedOut
383	            FallbackUsed = $attempts.Count -gt 1 -and $attempts[1].Source -eq 'public'
384	            FailureClass = $final.FailureClass
385	            Attempts = @($attempts)
386	            Stdout = $final.Stdout
387	            Stderr = $final.Stderr
388	        }
389	    } finally {
390	        if ($tempRoot) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tempRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
391	    }
392	}

394	function Get-ChezmoiPackageSourcePolicy {

400	        AllowPublicFallback = [bool] $data.allowPublicPackageFallback
401	    }

117	function Invoke-CapturedPackageProcess {
118	    param(
119	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Executable,
120	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [AllowEmptyCollection()] [string[]] $Arguments,
121	        [hashtable] $Environment = @{},
122	        [string] $WorkingDirectory,
123	        [ValidateRange(1, 86400)] [int] $TimeoutSeconds = 600,
124	        [ValidateSet('Host', 'StandardError', 'Capture')] [string] $OutputMode = 'Host'
125	    )
126	
127	    $startInfo = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
128	    $startInfo.FileName = $Executable
129	    $startInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
130	    $startInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
131	    $startInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
132	    $startInfo.RedirectStandardError = $true
133	    if ($WorkingDirectory) { $startInfo.WorkingDirectory = $WorkingDirectory }
134	    foreach ($argument in $Arguments) { $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add([string] $argument) }
135	    foreach ($name in $Environment.Keys) {
136	        if ($null -eq $Environment[$name]) { $startInfo.Environment.Remove([string] $name) }
137	        else { $startInfo.Environment[[string] $name] = [string] $Environment[$name] }
138	    }
139	
140	    $process = [Diagnostics.Process]::new()
141	    $process.StartInfo = $startInfo
142	    $timedOut = $false
143	    $launchFailed = $false
144	    $exitCode = -1
145	    $stdout = ''
146	    $stderr = ''
147	    try {
148	        try {
149	            if (-not $process.Start()) { throw 'process did not start' }
150	        } catch {
151	            $launchFailed = $true
152	            $stderr = "failed to start $Executable`: $($_.Exception.Message)"
153	            return [pscustomobject]@{
154	                ExitCode = -1; TimedOut = $false; LaunchFailed = $true
155	                Stdout = ''; Stderr = (Protect-PackageSourceOutput $stderr)
156	            }
157	        }
158	
159	        $stdoutTask = $process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
160	        $stderrTask = $process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
161	        $terminated = $true
162	        if (-not $process.WaitForExit($TimeoutSeconds * 1000)) {
163	            $timedOut = $true
164	            $terminated = $false
165	            try {
166	                $process.Kill($true)
167	                $terminated = $process.WaitForExit(5000)
168	            } catch {
169	                $terminated = $false
170	            }
171	        }
172	        if ($terminated) {
173	            $stdout = $stdoutTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
174	            $stderr = $stderrTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
175	        } else {
176	            $stderr = "process timed out and could not be terminated: $Executable"
177	        }
178	        $exitCode = if ($timedOut) { -1 } else { $process.ExitCode }
179	    } finally {
180	        $process.Dispose()
181	    }
182	
183	    $stdout = Protect-PackageSourceOutput $stdout
184	    $stderr = Protect-PackageSourceOutput $stderr
185	    if ($OutputMode -eq 'Host') {
186	        if ($stdout) { Write-Host $stdout.TrimEnd() }
187	        if ($stderr) { [Console]::Error.Write($stderr) }
188	    } elseif ($OutputMode -eq 'StandardError') {
189	        if ($stdout) { [Console]::Error.Write($stdout) }
190	        if ($stderr) { [Console]::Error.Write($stderr) }
191	    }
192	
193	    [pscustomobject]@{
194	        ExitCode = $exitCode
195	        TimedOut = $timedOut
196	        LaunchFailed = $launchFailed
197	        Stdout = $stdout
198	        Stderr = $stderr
199	    }
200	}

280	function Invoke-PackageSourceCommand {
281	    [CmdletBinding()]
282	    param(
283	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [ValidateSet('uv', 'npm')] [string] $Manager,
284	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Executable,
285	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [AllowEmptyCollection()] [string[]] $Arguments,
286	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Operation,
287	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [bool] $ManagedMachine,
288	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [bool] $AllowPublicFallback,
289	        [string] $PackageSpec,
290	        [string] $NpmPrefix,
291	        [string] $NpmCache,
292	        [hashtable] $AdditionalEnvironment = @{},
293	        [ValidateSet('Host', 'StandardError', 'Capture')] [string] $OutputMode = 'Host',
294	        [ValidateRange(1, 86400)] [int] $TimeoutSeconds = 600,
295	        [string] $CorporatePyPiIndex = $script:CorporatePyPiIndex,
296	        [string] $PublicPyPiIndex = $script:PublicPyPiIndex,
297	        [string] $CorporateNpmRegistry = $script:CorporateNpmRegistry,
298	        [string] $PublicNpmRegistry = $script:PublicNpmRegistry
299	    )
300	
301	    $attempts = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
302	    $tempRoot = $null
303	    try {
304	        $workingDirectory = $null
305	        $baseEnvironment = @{}
306	        foreach ($key in $AdditionalEnvironment.Keys) { $baseEnvironment[$key] = $AdditionalEnvironment[$key] }
307	        if ($ManagedMachine) {
308	            $baseEnvironment = New-PackageAttemptEnvironment -Manager $Manager -AdditionalEnvironment $AdditionalEnvironment
309	            if ($Manager -eq 'npm') {
310	                if (-not $NpmPrefix) { throw 'NpmPrefix is required for npm source isolation' }
311	                $tempRoot = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('package-source-npm-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
312	                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tempRoot | Out-Null
313	                $userConfig = Join-Path $tempRoot 'user.npmrc'
314	                $globalConfig = Join-Path $tempRoot 'global.npmrc'
315	                [IO.File]::WriteAllText($userConfig, '', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
316	                [IO.File]::WriteAllText($globalConfig, '', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
317	                $baseEnvironment['NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG'] = $userConfig
318	                $baseEnvironment['NPM_CONFIG_GLOBALCONFIG'] = $globalConfig
319	                $workingDirectory = $tempRoot
320	            }
321	        }
322	
323	        $sourceQueue = [Collections.Generic.Queue[string]]::new()
324	        $sourceQueue.Enqueue($(if ($ManagedMachine) { 'corporate' } else { 'ambient' }))
325	        while ($sourceQueue.Count -gt 0) {
326	            $sourceKind = $sourceQueue.Dequeue()
327	            $attemptNumber = $attempts.Count + 1
328	            $sourceLabel = if ($sourceKind -eq 'ambient') { 'ambient package policy' } elseif ($Manager -eq 'uv') { "$sourceKind PyPI" } else { "$sourceKind npm" }
329	            Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: attempt $attemptNumber using $sourceLabel"
330	
331	            $attemptArguments = @($Arguments)
332	            $attemptEnvironment = @{} + $baseEnvironment
333	            if ($sourceKind -ne 'ambient') {
334	                $sourceUrl = if ($Manager -eq 'uv') {
335	                    if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') { $CorporatePyPiIndex } else { $PublicPyPiIndex }
336	                } else {
337	                    if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') { $CorporateNpmRegistry } else { $PublicNpmRegistry }
338	                }
339	                if ($Manager -eq 'uv') {
340	                    $attemptArguments = Add-UvSourceArguments -Arguments $attemptArguments -SourceUrl $sourceUrl
341	                } else {
342	                    $attemptArguments += "--registry=$sourceUrl"
343	                    $scope = Get-NpmPackageScope -PackageSpec $PackageSpec
344	                    if ($scope) { $attemptArguments += "--$scope`:registry=$sourceUrl" }
345	                    $attemptArguments += "--prefix=$NpmPrefix"
346	                    if ($NpmCache) { $attemptArguments += "--cache=$NpmCache" }
347	                }
348	            }
349	
350	            $processResult = Invoke-CapturedPackageProcess -Executable $Executable -Arguments $attemptArguments `
351	                -Environment $attemptEnvironment -WorkingDirectory $workingDirectory `
352	                -TimeoutSeconds $TimeoutSeconds -OutputMode $OutputMode
353	            $combinedOutput = "$($processResult.Stdout)`n$($processResult.Stderr)"
354	            $failureClass = if ($processResult.ExitCode -eq 0) { 'none' } else {
355	                Get-PackageFailureClass -Output $combinedOutput -TimedOut $processResult.TimedOut -LaunchFailed $processResult.LaunchFailed
356	            }
357	            $attempts.Add([pscustomobject]@{
358	                Source = $sourceKind
359	                ExitCode = $processResult.ExitCode
360	                TimedOut = $processResult.TimedOut
361	                FailureClass = $failureClass
362	                Stdout = $processResult.Stdout
363	                Stderr = $processResult.Stderr
364	            })
365	
366	            if ($processResult.ExitCode -eq 0) { break }
367	            Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: $sourceKind attempt failed: $failureClass"
368	
369	            if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate' -and $AllowPublicFallback -and (Test-PackageFallbackEligible $failureClass)) {
370	                Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: public fallback enabled; retrying once"
371	                $sourceQueue.Enqueue('public')
372	            } elseif ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') {
373	                $reason = if (-not $AllowPublicFallback) { 'fallback is disabled' } else { "$failureClass is not eligible" }
374	                Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: $reason; not retrying"
375	            }
376	        }
377	
378	        $final = $attempts[$attempts.Count - 1]
379	        [pscustomobject]@{
380	            Succeeded = $final.ExitCode -eq 0
381	            ExitCode = $final.ExitCode
382	            TimedOut = $final.TimedOut
383	            FallbackUsed = $attempts.Count -gt 1 -and $attempts[1].Source -eq 'public'
384	            FailureClass = $final.FailureClass
385	            Attempts = @($attempts)
386	            Stdout = $final.Stdout
387	            Stderr = $final.Stderr
388	        }
389	    } finally {
390	        if ($tempRoot) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tempRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
391	    }
392	}

4	function Resolve-PueueCommand {
5	    param(

63	function Wait-PueuedReady {
64	    param(
65	        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ClientPath,
66	        [int]$TimeoutMilliseconds = 3000
67	    )
68	
69	    $timeout = [Math]::Max(1, $TimeoutMilliseconds)
70	    $clock = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
71	    while ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -lt $timeout) {
72	        $remaining = $timeout - [int]$clock.ElapsedMilliseconds
73	        if (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $ClientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds ([Math]::Min(500, $remaining))) {
74	            return $true
75	        }
76	        $remaining = $timeout - [int]$clock.ElapsedMilliseconds
77	        if ($remaining -le 0) { break }
78	        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds ([Math]::Min(100, $remaining))
79	    }
80	    return (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $ClientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds 1)

8	# herdr rewrites this file at runtime — the onboarding flag, in-app settings
9	# popups, [session] / [remote] / [experimental] / [update] state. A plain managed
10	# file clobbers all of that on every `chezmoi apply`, which can re-trigger
11	# onboarding. The parent (unix) repo hit this and moved create_ -> modify_ on
12	# 2026-07-06; this repo's config was added five days later and still used the
13	# plain form. Same fix, ported.
14	#
15	# MERGE MODEL — template-as-base, pull-through unmanaged keys:
16	#   - Base = the managed template (.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml), which
17	#     carries the comments + the tmux-parity rationale.
18	#   - Every TOP-LEVEL key in the live file that is NOT managed and NOT already in
19	#     the template is copied across (preserves onboarding, [session], [remote],
20	#     [experimental], and any future herdr writeback).
21	#   - Managed tables are enforced wholesale (template wins).
22	#   - FORCED single keys are re-asserted INTO a pulled-through table, so the table
23	#     keeps herdr's own bookkeeping. Windows needs exactly one: update.channel
24	#     must stay "preview" (the installer rejects "stable" on Windows builds), but
25	#     [update] also holds herdr's last-check state, which we do not want to wipe.
26	#     This sub-key merge is the one deliberate divergence from the unix overlay.
27	#
28	# WHY tomlkit (not a hand-rolled emitter): herdr's config has an array-of-tables
29	# ([[keys.command]]) and comments worth keeping; stdlib tomllib is read-only.
30	# Python runtime: prefer `uv` (guarantees >=3.11 -> stdlib tomllib), fall back to
31	# system python, then to emitting the raw template (a fresh host with neither
32	# still gets a full config — note we emit the TEMPLATE, not stdin, because on a
33	# fresh host stdin is empty).
34	#
35	# To manage an additional key: edit .chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml.

275	        return @('--no-config', 'run') + $sourceArguments + $remaining
276	    }
277	    throw "unsupported isolated uv command: $($Arguments -join ' ')"
278	}

280	function Invoke-PackageSourceCommand {
281	    [CmdletBinding()]
282	    param(
283	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [ValidateSet('uv', 'npm')] [string] $Manager,
284	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Executable,
285	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [AllowEmptyCollection()] [string[]] $Arguments,
286	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Operation,
287	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [bool] $ManagedMachine,
288	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [bool] $AllowPublicFallback,
289	        [string] $PackageSpec,
290	        [string] $NpmPrefix,
291	        [string] $NpmCache,
292	        [hashtable] $AdditionalEnvironment = @{},
293	        [ValidateSet('Host', 'StandardError', 'Capture')] [string] $OutputMode = 'Host',
294	        [ValidateRange(1, 86400)] [int] $TimeoutSeconds = 600,
295	        [string] $CorporatePyPiIndex = $script:CorporatePyPiIndex,
296	        [string] $PublicPyPiIndex = $script:PublicPyPiIndex,
297	        [string] $CorporateNpmRegistry = $script:CorporateNpmRegistry,
298	        [string] $PublicNpmRegistry = $script:PublicNpmRegistry
299	    )
300	
301	    $attempts = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
302	    $tempRoot = $null
303	    try {
304	        $workingDirectory = $null
305	        $baseEnvironment = @{}
306	        foreach ($key in $AdditionalEnvironment.Keys) { $baseEnvironment[$key] = $AdditionalEnvironment[$key] }
307	        if ($ManagedMachine) {
308	            $baseEnvironment = New-PackageAttemptEnvironment -Manager $Manager -AdditionalEnvironment $AdditionalEnvironment
309	            if ($Manager -eq 'npm') {
310	                if (-not $NpmPrefix) { throw 'NpmPrefix is required for npm source isolation' }
311	                $tempRoot = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('package-source-npm-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
312	                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tempRoot | Out-Null
313	                $userConfig = Join-Path $tempRoot 'user.npmrc'
314	                $globalConfig = Join-Path $tempRoot 'global.npmrc'
315	                [IO.File]::WriteAllText($userConfig, '', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
316	                [IO.File]::WriteAllText($globalConfig, '', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
317	                $baseEnvironment['NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG'] = $userConfig
318	                $baseEnvironment['NPM_CONFIG_GLOBALCONFIG'] = $globalConfig
319	                $workingDirectory = $tempRoot
320	            }
321	        }
322	
323	        $sourceQueue = [Collections.Generic.Queue[string]]::new()
324	        $sourceQueue.Enqueue($(if ($ManagedMachine) { 'corporate' } else { 'ambient' }))
325	        while ($sourceQueue.Count -gt 0) {
326	            $sourceKind = $sourceQueue.Dequeue()
327	            $attemptNumber = $attempts.Count + 1
328	            $sourceLabel = if ($sourceKind -eq 'ambient') { 'ambient package policy' } elseif ($Manager -eq 'uv') { "$sourceKind PyPI" } else { "$sourceKind npm" }
329	            Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: attempt $attemptNumber using $sourceLabel"
330	
331	            $attemptArguments = @($Arguments)
332	            $attemptEnvironment = @{} + $baseEnvironment
333	            if ($sourceKind -ne 'ambient') {
334	                $sourceUrl = if ($Manager -eq 'uv') {
335	                    if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') { $CorporatePyPiIndex } else { $PublicPyPiIndex }
336	                } else {
337	                    if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') { $CorporateNpmRegistry } else { $PublicNpmRegistry }
338	                }
339	                if ($Manager -eq 'uv') {
340	                    $attemptArguments = Add-UvSourceArguments -Arguments $attemptArguments -SourceUrl $sourceUrl
341	                } else {
342	                    $attemptArguments += "--registry=$sourceUrl"
343	                    $scope = Get-NpmPackageScope -PackageSpec $PackageSpec
344	                    if ($scope) { $attemptArguments += "--$scope`:registry=$sourceUrl" }
345	                    $attemptArguments += "--prefix=$NpmPrefix"
346	                    if ($NpmCache) { $attemptArguments += "--cache=$NpmCache" }
347	                }
348	            }
349	
350	            $processResult = Invoke-CapturedPackageProcess -Executable $Executable -Arguments $attemptArguments `
351	                -Environment $attemptEnvironment -WorkingDirectory $workingDirectory `
352	                -TimeoutSeconds $TimeoutSeconds -OutputMode $OutputMode
353	            $combinedOutput = "$($processResult.Stdout)`n$($processResult.Stderr)"
354	            $failureClass = if ($processResult.ExitCode -eq 0) { 'none' } else {
355	                Get-PackageFailureClass -Output $combinedOutput -TimedOut $processResult.TimedOut -LaunchFailed $processResult.LaunchFailed
356	            }
357	            $attempts.Add([pscustomobject]@{
358	                Source = $sourceKind
359	                ExitCode = $processResult.ExitCode
360	                TimedOut = $processResult.TimedOut
361	                FailureClass = $failureClass
362	                Stdout = $processResult.Stdout
363	                Stderr = $processResult.Stderr
364	            })
365	
366	            if ($processResult.ExitCode -eq 0) { break }
367	            Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: $sourceKind attempt failed: $failureClass"
368	
369	            if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate' -and $AllowPublicFallback -and (Test-PackageFallbackEligible $failureClass)) {
370	                Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: public fallback enabled; retrying once"
371	                $sourceQueue.Enqueue('public')
372	            } elseif ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') {
373	                $reason = if (-not $AllowPublicFallback) { 'fallback is disabled' } else { "$failureClass is not eligible" }
374	                Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: $reason; not retrying"
375	            }
376	        }
377	
378	        $final = $attempts[$attempts.Count - 1]
379	        [pscustomobject]@{
380	            Succeeded = $final.ExitCode -eq 0
381	            ExitCode = $final.ExitCode
382	            TimedOut = $final.TimedOut
383	            FallbackUsed = $attempts.Count -gt 1 -and $attempts[1].Source -eq 'public'
384	            FailureClass = $final.FailureClass
385	            Attempts = @($attempts)
386	            Stdout = $final.Stdout
387	            Stderr = $final.Stderr
388	        }
389	    } finally {
390	        if ($tempRoot) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tempRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
391	    }
392	}
393	
394	function Get-ChezmoiPackageSourcePolicy {
395	    $raw = @(& chezmoi data --format json 2>$null)
396	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $raw) { throw 'could not read chezmoi package-source policy' }
397	    $data = ($raw -join "`n") | ConvertFrom-Json
398	    [pscustomobject]@{
399	        ManagedMachine = [bool] $data.managedMachine
400	        AllowPublicFallback = [bool] $data.allowPublicPackageFallback
401	    }
402	}

47	function Invoke-HerdrUpgrade {
48	    [CmdletBinding()]
49	    param([ValidateSet('preview')][string]$Channel = 'preview')
50	
51	    $herdr = Resolve-HerdrExecutable
52	    if (-not $herdr) {
53	        Write-Warning 'herdr is not installed; skipping'
54	        return 0
55	    }
56	    if ($env:HERDR_ENV -or $env:HERDR_PANE_ID) {
57	        Write-Warning 'Run this outside Herdr after detaching; the installer cannot replace the server that owns this pane.'
58	        return 0
59	    }
60	
61	    Write-Host '==> Upgrading Herdr with verified official installer'
62	    try {
63	        Invoke-HerdrOfficialInstaller -Channel $Channel
64	        $herdr = Resolve-HerdrExecutable
65	        if (-not $herdr -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $herdr -PathType Leaf)) {
66	            throw 'Installed Herdr executable is missing after the installer completed'
67	        }
68	        $version = Get-HerdrVersion -HerdrPath $herdr
69	        Write-Host $version
70	        if (-not (Sync-HerdrSkill -HerdrPath $herdr)) {
71	            throw 'Herdr installed, but its global agent skill could not be synchronized; prior copies were preserved.'
72	        }
73	    } catch {
74	        Write-Error $_
75	        return 1
76	    }
77	
78	    Write-Host '==> Herdr binary and global agent skill updated'
79	    Write-Warning 'Restart Herdr deliberately to load the new binary; check `herdr integration status` for integrations that need reinstalling.'
80	    return 0
81	}

47	
48	## Architecture (big picture)
49	
50	- **Init** — `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` `[data]` prompts once (`role` → coarse defaults, then `installX` toggles) and sets `[interpreters.ps1] = pwsh` so chezmoi runs `.ps1` scripts under pwsh. Prompts are hand-authored here (the parent repo generates them; this repo does not).
51	- **Shell** — `Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1` is a thin `$PROFILE` loader that dot-sources `dot_config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in numeric order (env → tool activation → aliases → apps/audio/clipboard → copilot import → yazi → tv cache → psreadline). Add a shell feature = a new numbered fragment. User overrides go in the untracked `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1`.
52	- **Packages** — `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the single source of truth for installs: scoop (CLI), winget (GUI), npm (AI agents), PSGallery (PSFzf / AudioDeviceCmdlets), all gated by init toggles. `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` owns persistent registry environment variables; `scripts/package-source-runner.ps1` owns command-scoped corporate-first fallback for the enumerated npm/uv operations. Managed machines use company PyPI/npm feeds; otherwise the China toggle selects GFW mirrors. Fault-tolerant (see invariants).
53	- **copilot-proxy** — `dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/` is a native PowerShell port of the parent's `43_copilot_proxy.sh` / `44_copilot_embed.sh` (runs the copilot-api fork so GitHub Copilot can back Claude Code and Codex). Reuses the Bun `copilot-throttle-shim.js` verbatim.
54	- **Config surfaces** — Alacritty (`AppData/Roaming/alacritty/`), Windows Terminal (a run_onchange that merges `profiles.defaults` non-destructively), WezTerm (`dot_config/wezterm/wezterm.lua` — sets pwsh as `default_prog`), editors (a run_onchange that deep-merges `editors/*.json` into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`), Claude Code (one `installCodingAgents`-gated, fail-closed run_onchange deep-merges settings and claude-hud Full config while preserving live/user-owned keys; see `docs/rationale.md`), Codex (`dot_codex/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl` fail-closed-merges only the native `tui.status_line` into `~/.codex/config.toml`, preserving providers/projects/plugins and gated on `installCodingAgents`), apprise desktop notifications (`dot_config/apprise/apprise.yaml` → `~/.config/apprise/`; the `windows://` toast backend behind the Claude notify hook `dot_claude/hooks/notify.ps1`, `installCodingAgents`-gated — the notify hook and peon-ping's voice-line hooks are both gated on the `agentSounds` tier (none|notify|peon|both) and built in the run_onchange, NOT in `claude/settings-overlay.json`; see docs/agent-sounds.md), television channels (`AppData/Roaming/television/`), starship + yazi (`~/.config`, yazi via `YAZI_CONFIG_HOME`), Rime/Weasel (see below), herdr (see below).
55	- **Rime input method** — `installInputMethod`-gated, and the one config surface **shared with the parent repo**. The engine-level YAML lives in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` (`default.custom.yaml`, `luna_pinyin.custom.yaml`) and is kept **byte-identical** to `daviddwlee84/dotfiles`'s copy of the same path — `diff -r` between the two dirs is the drift check, so edit one and copy to the other in the same session. Each platform is a one-line `{{ template "rime/…" . }}` renderer: `AppData/Roaming/Rime/` here, `private_Library/Rime/` (Squirrel) and `dot_config/ibus/rime/` (ibus-rime) there. Only `weasel.custom.yaml` is Windows-specific (`style/` is Weasel's own, `app_options` keys on the EXE name vs. Squirrel's bundle ids, and `global_ascii` doesn't exist on Squirrel). Plain managed files, **not** a `modify_` overlay: Rime persists runtime state to `user.yaml`, never back into `*.custom.yaml`. Two gotchas: a bare silent winget install registers **简体** (hence `--custom '/T'` in `Install-Weasel` — see `pitfalls/weasel-silent-install-registers-simplified-chinese.md`), and config edits need a redeploy, which `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.
56	- **herdr** — `dot_config/herdr/` is deployed via `HERDR_CONFIG_PATH` and gated on `installHerdr`. `config.toml` is a **`modify_` overlay** (`modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl` + `.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml`), never a plain managed file: herdr rewrites that file at runtime (onboarding flag, `[session]`, `[remote]`, `[update]` bookkeeping) and a plain file clobbers it. The overlay enforces `[theme]`/`[ui]`/`[terminal]`/`[keys]` wholesale, pulls every other top-level key through, and re-asserts the single key `update.channel = "preview"` (the Windows installer rejects `stable`). `run_after_15_sync_herdr_skill.ps1.tmpl` exports the exact installed binary's `herdr --skill` output to real copies under both `~/.agents/skills/herdr/` and `~/.claude/skills/herdr/`; no symlink/junction is used. Helper-script paths in the keymap are baked **absolute at render time** — `pwsh -File` does not expand `~`. Six pwsh helpers (`_common.ps1` + run-command / new-tab-at-space-root / url-pick / path-pick / pane-copy / review-mark) back the `[[keys.command]]` bindings; three `herdr-*` tv channels and the herdr-plus quick-actions are gated by the same toggle. Ported from the parent repo 2026-07-27; the behaviours that still need a real Windows box are listed in [`backlog/herdr-windows-port-verification.md`](backlog/herdr-windows-port-verification.md).
57	- **git config** — `~/.gitconfig` is a **`modify_` overlay** (`modify_dot_gitconfig.ps1.tmpl`), never a plain managed file: Git Credential Manager writes `[credential "azrepos:*"]` blocks into it out of band and a plain file would clobber them every apply. The baseline body is `.chezmoitemplates/git/gitconfig` (identity from the existing `.name`/`.email` init prompts); the merge engine is `scripts/gitconfig-merge.ps1`, inlined via `{{ include }}` (the `editors/` idiom) and dot-sourced by `tests/GitConfig.Tests.ps1`. The model is **key-level pull-through**: the baseline owns a fixed set of `section.key` pairs and every other live key is carried over untouched — the inverse of the parent repo's allowlist, which would silently drop `[otel]` and future corp sections. Two hard rules: `core.hooksPath` is **never** emitted (git honours it *instead of* `.git/hooks/`, silently disarming `pre-commit`), and the carry dictionary is **case-sensitive** (`[ordered]@{}` collapses `azrepos:org/O365Exchange` into `azrepos:org/o365exchange`, merging two credential contexts).
58	- **Docs** — bilingual mkdocs-material (`docs/X.md` + `docs/X.zh-TW.md`), deployed to GitHub Pages by `.github/workflows/docs.yml`. `docs/rationale.md` records the design choices (scoop > Chocolatey, starship > oh-my-posh, pwsh > cmd, native pwsh tree > ported shell layer).
59	- **CI** — `.github/workflows/windows.yml` on `windows-latest` is the real gate: PSScriptAnalyzer, non-interactive `chezmoi init --apply`, render+parse of every `.ps1.tmpl`, and Pester.
60	
61	## Conventions & hard invariants
62	
63	1. **A new/renamed init prompt must update the CI flags in the same commit.** `chezmoi init --promptBool/--promptChoice "<text>=value"` matches the prompt's exact TEXT (3rd arg to `promptXOnce` in `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`), used non-interactively by `.github/workflows/windows.yml`. Forget it → CI's init hangs/EOFs (`error calling promptChoiceOnce: EOF`; this broke three consecutive pushes when `agentSounds` was added). Corollary: **never put `=` in a prompt's text** — the `name=value` parser splits on the first `=` (this broke the `role` prompt once). Enforced by `tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` (missing flag, stale flag, wrong flag kind, `=` in text), which CI runs *before* `chezmoi init` so the failure names the missing flag instead of EOF-ing — run `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` locally after touching either file.
64	2. **Run-scripts must never abort the apply.** The installer + editor/terminal/backup/skill scripts use `$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'` (+ `PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference=$false`), collect failures via `Register-Failure`, print a summary, and exit 0. One bad scoop/winget manifest (e.g. btop's stale `.conf`) must not stop the rest.
65	3. **Preserve raw escapes when authoring config with control chars.** Alacritty CSI-u (`[…u`), VSCode `sendSequence`, tv `\t` — hand-typing tends to drop them. Generate via a throwaway Python script and re-parse (`tomllib` / `json`) to confirm the escape landed.
66	4. **tv channel commands are `pwsh -NoProfile -Command "…"` inside TOML literal (`'''…'''`) strings** — runs regardless of tv's shell, sidesteps nested-quote escaping; placeholders `{split: :0}` (space) / `{split:\t:0}` (tab). tv reads config from `%APPDATA%\television\` on Windows.
67	5. **Editors use a run_onchange pwsh merger, not `modify_`** (`modify_` interpreter selection is unreliable on Windows). Overlay sources live in `editors/` (chezmoi-ignored, embedded via `{{ include }}`).
68	6. **The agent skill body lives once** in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`; both `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` and `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` render it via `{{ "{{" }} template … {{ "}}" }}` → real files at `~/.agents/skills/` and `~/.claude/skills/`. Edit the shared template, not the two one-line renderers (no symlink/junction — those need elevation/Developer Mode on Windows).
69	7. **PSScriptAnalyzer exclusions are intentional** (`PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1`): hyphenated command names, `Write-Host`, `Invoke-Expression` for tool init, no-BOM UTF-8. Don't "fix" these; do fix real Errors.
70	8. **Public package fallback is opt-in, deny-first, and single-source.** Only repo-owned npm agent operations and uv dependency resolution may use `scripts/package-source-runner.ps1`; corporate is always attempted first and public at most once. Never add public as an extra index, broaden fallback beyond timeout/transient-network/HTTP-5xx, or bypass 401/403, TLS/certificate, package-absence, policy, solver/build, or local-state failures. Go/Rust/Ruby/Scoop/winget/Git/CDN operations have no corporate source and must not use this fallback.
71	
72	### Cross-file mirrors (same commit)
73	
74	- New installer tool → `docs/tools.md` **and** `docs/tools.zh-TW.md`.
75	- New init prompt → `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` + `windows.yml` flags + `docs/setup.md`/`setup.zh-TW.md` tables + the "What's enabled" block in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.
76	- New `docs/**/*.md` → its `.zh-TW.md` twin + `nav` + `nav_translations` in `mkdocs.yml`; `just docs-build` must stay green.
77	- Any edit under `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` → copy the file verbatim into the parent repo's `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` (`chezmoi source-path` there, usually `~/.local/share/chezmoi`). They must stay byte-identical; verify with `diff -r`. Frontend-only changes (`weasel.custom.yaml`) do **not** cross over.

The central risk is now clear: the nominal 5-second post-kill bound does not bound the subsequent output-reader waits, and a timeout/kill race can misreport a process that exited during cleanup as “could not be terminated.” I’m checking the exact call sites and running isolated timing probes to distinguish reproducible behavior from theoretical edge cases, including whether live descendants keep the redirected pipes and temporary npm directory open.

1	#!/usr/bin/env pwsh
2	# chezmoi modify_ script: overlay a managed herdr config onto ~/.config/herdr/config.toml.
3	#
4	# Runs under pwsh via [interpreters.ps1] in .chezmoi.toml.tmpl. chezmoi pipes the
5	# CURRENT target file into stdin and takes the new contents from stdout.
6	#
7	# WHY AN OVERLAY (this replaced a plain managed dot_config/herdr/config.toml):
8	# herdr rewrites this file at runtime — the onboarding flag, in-app settings
9	# popups, [session] / [remote] / [experimental] / [update] state. A plain managed
10	# file clobbers all of that on every `chezmoi apply`, which can re-trigger
11	# onboarding. The parent (unix) repo hit this and moved create_ -> modify_ on
12	# 2026-07-06; this repo's config was added five days later and still used the
13	# plain form. Same fix, ported.
14	#
15	# MERGE MODEL — template-as-base, pull-through unmanaged keys:
16	#   - Base = the managed template (.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml), which
17	#     carries the comments + the tmux-parity rationale.
18	#   - Every TOP-LEVEL key in the live file that is NOT managed and NOT already in
19	#     the template is copied across (preserves onboarding, [session], [remote],
20	#     [experimental], and any future herdr writeback).
21	#   - Managed tables are enforced wholesale (template wins).
22	#   - FORCED single keys are re-asserted INTO a pulled-through table, so the table
23	#     keeps herdr's own bookkeeping. Windows needs exactly one: update.channel
24	#     must stay "preview" (the installer rejects "stable" on Windows builds), but
25	#     [update] also holds herdr's last-check state, which we do not want to wipe.
26	#     This sub-key merge is the one deliberate divergence from the unix overlay.
27	#
28	# WHY tomlkit (not a hand-rolled emitter): herdr's config has an array-of-tables
29	# ([[keys.command]]) and comments worth keeping; stdlib tomllib is read-only.
30	# Python runtime: prefer `uv` (guarantees >=3.11 -> stdlib tomllib), fall back to
31	# system python, then to emitting the raw template (a fresh host with neither
32	# still gets a full config — note we emit the TEMPLATE, not stdin, because on a
33	# fresh host stdin is empty).
34	#
35	# To manage an additional key: edit .chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml.
36	# Validate the result with `herdr server reload-config` (empty diagnostics).
37	
38	$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
39	
40	# modify_ scripts run under `pwsh -NoProfile`, so the deployed 05_mirrors.ps1
41	# fragment is not loaded here. Apply the same source policy inline before uv
42	# resolves tomlkit: managed machines must use the IT-approved pull-through feed.

49	# and no BOM or trailing CRLF churn creeps into chezmoi's diff.
50	function Write-StdoutBytes {
51	    param([byte[]] $Bytes)
52	    $out = [Console]::OpenStandardOutput()
53	    $out.Write($Bytes, 0, $Bytes.Length)
54	    $out.Flush()
55	}
56	
57	$utf8 = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)   # no BOM
58	
59	$templateText = @'
60	{{ template "herdr/config.toml" . }}
61	'@
62	
63	$liveText = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()
64	
65	$tmpDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetTempPath()
66	$stamp = [System.IO.Path]::GetRandomFileName()

68	$liveFile = Join-Path $tmpDir "herdr-live-$stamp.toml"

90	    if (-not $py) {

92	        Write-StdoutBytes $utf8.GetBytes($templateText)
93	        return
94	    }

97	import os
98	import sys
99	
100	tmpl_path = os.environ["HERDR_TEMPLATE_FILE"]
101	live_path = os.environ["HERDR_LIVE_FILE"]
102	out_path = os.environ["HERDR_OUT_FILE"]
103	
104	with open(tmpl_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
105	    template_text = fh.read()
106	
107	
108	def emit(text):
109	    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
110	        fh.write(text)
111	
112	
113	try:
114	    import tomllib  # Python 3.11+
115	except ModuleNotFoundError:
116	    try:
117	        import tomli as tomllib
118	    except ModuleNotFoundError:
119	        # No TOML reader -> can't safely merge; ship the managed template as-is.
120	        emit(template_text)
121	        sys.exit(0)
122	
123	try:
124	    import tomlkit
125	except ModuleNotFoundError:
126	    print(
127	        "modify_config.toml: tomlkit unavailable; emitting managed template "
128	        "(runtime keys not preserved this run)",
129	        file=sys.stderr,
130	    )
131	    emit(template_text)
132	    sys.exit(0)
133	
134	# Tables the template owns outright.
135	MANAGED = {"theme", "ui", "terminal", "keys"}
136	# Single keys re-asserted into an otherwise pulled-through table.
137	FORCED = {("update", "channel"): "preview"}
138	
139	with open(live_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
140	    live_text = fh.read().strip()
141	
142	doc = tomlkit.parse(template_text)  # base, with comments intact
143	try:
144	    live = tomllib.loads(live_text) if live_text else {}
145	except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError:
146	    # A corrupt live file must not block the apply — enforce the template.
147	    print("modify_config.toml: live config is not valid TOML; enforcing template", file=sys.stderr)
148	    live = {}
149	
150	for key, value in live.items():
151	    if key in MANAGED:
152	        continue
153	    if key in doc:
154	        # The template also declares this table. Keep herdr's runtime keys and
155	        # let the template win only on the keys it actually sets.
156	        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(doc[key], dict):
157	            for sub_key, sub_value in value.items():
158	                if sub_key not in doc[key]:
159	                    doc[key][sub_key] = sub_value
160	        continue
161	    doc[key] = value
162	
163	for (table, sub_key), forced_value in FORCED.items():
164	    if table not in doc:
165	        doc[table] = tomlkit.table()
166	    doc[table][sub_key] = forced_value
167	
168	emit(tomlkit.dumps(doc))
169	'@

171	    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($pyFile, $pySource, $utf8)
172	
173	    $childEnvironment = @{

175	        HERDR_LIVE_FILE = $liveFile
176	        HERDR_OUT_FILE = $outFile
177	    }

179	    $rest = if ($py.Count -gt 1) { @($py[1..($py.Count - 1)]) + @($pyFile) } else { @($pyFile) }
180	    if ($pyUsesPackageRunner) {

182	            -Operation herdr-tomlkit -ManagedMachine $managedMachine `
183	            -AllowPublicFallback $allowPublicPackageFallback -AdditionalEnvironment $childEnvironment `
184	            -OutputMode StandardError

188	            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $outFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
189	            $result = Invoke-CapturedPackageProcess -Executable $systemPythonCommand.Source -Arguments @($pyFile) `
190	                -Environment $childEnvironment -OutputMode StandardError
191	            $rc = $result.ExitCode

193	    } else {

195	            -Environment $childEnvironment -OutputMode StandardError
196	        $rc = $result.ExitCode
197	    }
198	
199	    if ($rc -ne 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outFile)) {
200	        [Console]::Error.WriteLine("modify_config.toml: merge failed (exit $rc); emitting managed template")

1	# pueue-bootstrap.ps1 — make the pueue client usable without a manual daemon
2	# terminal. Included into both the package installer and the PowerShell profile.
3	
4	function Resolve-PueueCommand {
5	    param(
6	        [Parameter(Mandatory)]
7	        [ValidateSet('pueue', 'pueued')]
8	        [string]$Name
9	    )
10	
11	    $command = Get-Command $Name -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
12	        Select-Object -First 1
13	    if ($command) { return $command.Source }
14	
15	    # A first-time Scoop install can create the shim after this pwsh process
16	    # captured PATH. Resolve the stable `current` junction as a fallback.
17	    $scoop = Get-Command scoop -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
18	        Select-Object -First 1
19	    if (-not $scoop) { return $null }
20	
21	    $prefixOutput = @(& $scoop.Source prefix pueue 2>$null)
22	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $prefixOutput) { return $null }
23	    $prefix = ([string]$prefixOutput[-1]).Trim()
24	    $candidate = Join-Path $prefix "$Name.exe"
25	    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $candidate) { return $candidate }
26	    return $null
27	}
28	
29	function Test-PueueAdministrator {
30	    if (-not $IsWindows) { return $false }
31	    try {
32	        $identity = [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
33	        $principal = [Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal]$identity
34	        return $principal.IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
35	    } catch {
36	        return $false
37	    }
38	}
39	
40	function Test-PueuedReady {
41	    param(
42	        [AllowNull()][string]$ClientPath,
43	        [int]$TimeoutMilliseconds = 500
44	    )
45	
46	    if (-not $ClientPath) { $ClientPath = Resolve-PueueCommand -Name pueue }
47	    if (-not $ClientPath) { return $false }
48	    $process = $null
49	    try {
50	        $process = Start-Process -FilePath $ClientPath -ArgumentList 'status' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
51	        if (-not $process.WaitForExit([Math]::Max(1, $TimeoutMilliseconds))) {
52	            try { $process.Kill($true) } catch { $null = $_ }
53	            return $false
54	        }
55	        return ($process.ExitCode -eq 0)
56	    } catch {
57	        return $false
58	    } finally {
59	        if ($process) { $process.Dispose() }
60	    }
61	}
62	
63	function Wait-PueuedReady {
64	    param(
65	        [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$ClientPath,
66	        [int]$TimeoutMilliseconds = 3000
67	    )
68	
69	    $timeout = [Math]::Max(1, $TimeoutMilliseconds)
70	    $clock = [System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
71	    while ($clock.ElapsedMilliseconds -lt $timeout) {
72	        $remaining = $timeout - [int]$clock.ElapsedMilliseconds
73	        if (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $ClientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds ([Math]::Min(500, $remaining))) {
74	            return $true
75	        }
76	        $remaining = $timeout - [int]$clock.ElapsedMilliseconds
77	        if ($remaining -le 0) { break }
78	        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds ([Math]::Min(100, $remaining))
79	    }
80	    return (Test-PueuedReady -ClientPath $ClientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds 1)
81	}

83	function Start-PueuedIfNeeded {

86	        # The package installer opts into Pueue 4's built-in Windows service.
87	        # A normal shell never changes service state; it only uses daemon mode.

91	    )

97	        return $false

111	                else { & $daemonPath service install 2>&1 | Out-Host }

121	                else { & $daemonPath service start 2>&1 | Out-Host }
122	                $serviceStartExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

125	                } elseif (Wait-PueuedReady -ClientPath $clientPath -TimeoutMilliseconds $ReadyTimeoutMilliseconds) {

130	                }

134	        }

138	    try {

140	        # therefore waits forever for pipe EOF even after the launcher exits.
141	        Start-Process -FilePath $daemonPath -ArgumentList '--daemonize' -WindowStyle Hidden
142	    } catch {

144	        return $false
145	    }
146

148	    if (-not $ready -and -not $Quiet) { Write-Warning 'pueued started but did not become ready' }

The engine-level YAML lives in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` (`default.custom.yaml`, `luna_pinyin.custom.yaml`) and is kept **byte-identical** to `daviddwlee84/dotfiles`'s copy of the same path — `diff -r` between the two dirs is the drift check, so edit one and copy to the other in the same session. Each platform is a one-line `{{ template "rime/…" . }}` renderer: `AppData/Roaming/Rime/` here, `private_Library/Rime/` (Squirrel) and `dot_config/ibus/rime/` (ibus-rime) there. Only `weasel.custom.yaml` is Windows-specific (`style/` is Weasel's own, `app_options` keys on the EXE name vs. Squirrel's bundle ids, and `global_ascii` doesn't exist on Squirrel). Plain managed files, **not** a `modify_` overlay: Rime persists runtime state to `user.yaml`, never back into `*.custom.yaml`. Two gotchas: a bare silent winget install registers **简体** (hence `--custom '/T'` in `Install-Weasel` — see `pitfalls/weasel-silent-install-registers-simplified-chinese.md`), and config edits need a redeploy, which `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.

Edit the shared template, not the two one-line renderers (no symlink/junction — those need elevation/Developer Mode on Windows).
 7. **PSScriptAnalyzer exclusions are intentional** (`PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1`): hyphenated command names, `Write-Host`, `Invoke-Expression` for tool init, no-BOM UTF-8. Don't "fix" these; do fix real Errors.
+8. **Public package fallback is opt-in, deny-first, and single-source.** Only repo-owned npm agent operations and uv dependency resolution may use `scripts/package-source-runner.ps1`; corporate is always attempted first and public at most once. Never add public as an extra index, broaden fallback beyond timeout/transient-network/HTTP-5xx, or bypass 401/403, TLS/certificate, package-absence, policy, solver/build, or local-state failures. Go/Rust/Ruby/Scoop/winget/Git/CDN operations have no corporate source and must not use this fallback.

-  and disables nuget.org, so the dotfiles do not rewrite NuGet configuration.

+  ultimately serves artifacts from the corporate Azure Artifacts backend. IT
+  provisions NuGet separately, so the dotfiles do not rewrite it.
+- **China mirrors** apply only on non-managed machines: pip/uv use Tsinghua,
+  npm uses npmmirror, RubyGems uses Ruby China, Go uses goproxy.cn, and rustup
+  uses rsproxy. Scoop runtime downloads are unaffected.

+
+Managed policy wins when both machine toggles are true. A separate
+`allowPublicPackageFallback` prompt is **off by default**. When enabled on a
+managed machine, repo-owned npm agent installs/updates and uv dependency
+resolution (Apprise, LiteLLM, Herdr tomlkit, and docs commands) try the corporate
+source first. A timeout, temporary network failure, or explicit HTTP 5xx may
+trigger exactly one source-isolated retry against public PyPI/npm. Authentication
+or policy errors (401/403), TLS/certificate failures, 404/package absence, rate
+limits, solver/build errors, and local permission failures never fall back.
+
+Corporate and public indexes are never configured together. Each attempt clears
+extra index/registry inputs in its child process, preserves the parent shell and
+cache, and reports the retry explicitly. Switching source modes also removes only
+known endpoint values emitted by earlier repo versions; every other user/IT
+value survives, and `local.ps1` remains the final interactive override.

12	        param([bool] $ManagedMachine, [bool] $UseChineseMirror)
13	        $data = @{
14	            managedMachine   = $ManagedMachine
15	            useChineseMirror = $UseChineseMirror
16	        } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
17	        $rendered = & chezmoi execute-template --source $RepoRoot --override-data $data --file $TemplatePath
18	        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'failed to render package-source policy' }
19	        $rendered -join "`n"

22	    function Invoke-PackageSources {
23	        param(
24	            [bool] $ManagedMachine,
25	            [bool] $UseChineseMirror,
26	            [hashtable] $InitialValues = @{}
27	        )
28	        $previous = @{}
29	        foreach ($name in $SourceVariables) {
30	            $previous[$name] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name, 'Process')
31	            Remove-Item -LiteralPath "Env:$name" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
32	        }
33	        try {
34	            foreach ($name in $InitialValues.Keys) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $InitialValues[$name], 'Process') }
35	            & ([scriptblock]::Create((Render-PackageSources -ManagedMachine $ManagedMachine -UseChineseMirror $UseChineseMirror)))
36	            $result = [ordered]@{}
37	            foreach ($name in $SourceVariables) { $result[$name] = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name, 'Process') }
38	            $result
39	        } finally {
40	            foreach ($name in $SourceVariables) {
41	                if ($null -eq $previous[$name]) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath "Env:$name" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
42	                else { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $previous[$name], 'Process') }
43	            }
44	        }
45	    }
46	
47	    function Render-PackageInstaller {
48	        param([bool] $ManagedMachine, [bool] $UseChineseMirror, [bool] $AllowFallback)
49	        $data = @{
50	            installCodingAgents = $true; installSpecstoryBuild = $false
51	            installWindowsApps = $false; installUtilityApps = $false; installGamingApps = $false
52	            installExtraRuntimes = $false; installMediaTools = $false; installLlmTools = $true
53	            installTunnelTools = $false; installIacTools = $false; installHerdr = $false
54	            installClink = $false; installTry = $true; installTranslate = $true
55	            installInputMethod = $false; useChineseMirror = $UseChineseMirror
56	            managedMachine = $ManagedMachine; allowPublicPackageFallback = $AllowFallback
57	            chezmoi = @{ username = 'ci' }
58	        } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
59	        $path = Join-Path $RepoRoot '.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl'
60	        $rendered = & chezmoi execute-template --source $RepoRoot --override-data $data --file $path
61	        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'failed to render package installer' }
62	        $rendered -join "`n"
63	    }
64	}
