1	#Requires -Version 7
2	# Guards hard invariant #1 (AGENTS.md): every init prompt in .chezmoi.toml.tmpl
3	# must have a matching non-interactive flag in .github/workflows/windows.yml.
4	#
5	# Why this exists: adding a prompt without the flag does not fail loudly at
6	# authoring time — it fails much later, on the Windows runner, as an opaque
7	#   error calling promptChoiceOnce: EOF
8	# because `chezmoi init --no-tty` has no answer for the new question and hits
9	# end-of-input. That broke CI for three consecutive pushes when `agentSounds`
10	# was added. This test turns that into a local `Invoke-Pester` failure with the
11	# exact missing flag line to paste in.
12	#
13	# Matching is on the prompt's TEXT (3rd arg to promptXOnce), because that is
14	# what chezmoi's `--promptBool 'text=value'` parser keys on — not the variable
15	# name.
16	
17	BeforeAll {
18	    $repo = Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent
19	    $tomlTmpl = Join-Path $repo '.chezmoi.toml.tmpl'
20	    $workflow = Join-Path $repo '.github/workflows/windows.yml'
21	
22	    # promptBoolOnce . "varName" "Prompt text" <default>
23	    $script:Prompts = [regex]::Matches(
24	        (Get-Content -Raw $tomlTmpl),
25	        'prompt(?<kind>Bool|String|Choice)Once\s+\.\s+"(?<var>[^"]+)"\s+"(?<text>[^"]+)"'
26	    ) | ForEach-Object {
27	        [pscustomobject]@{
28	            Kind = $_.Groups['kind'].Value
29	            Var  = $_.Groups['var'].Value
30	            Text = $_.Groups['text'].Value
31	        }
32	    }
33	
34	    # '--promptBool','Prompt text=value'
35	    $script:Flags = [regex]::Matches(
36	        (Get-Content -Raw $workflow),
37	        "'--prompt(?<kind>Bool|String|Choice)'\s*,\s*'(?<text>[^=']+)="
38	    ) | ForEach-Object {
39	        [pscustomobject]@{
40	            Kind = $_.Groups['kind'].Value
41	            Text = $_.Groups['text'].Value
42	        }
43	    }
44	}
45	
46	# NB: no angle brackets in Describe/It names — Pester expands `<...>` in test
47	# names as a data placeholder, so a name like "prompts <-> flags" is rewritten
48	# to `$-` and the whole file dies with a bogus CommandNotFoundException.
49	Describe 'init prompts vs CI flags (invariant #1)' {
50	    It 'finds prompts in .chezmoi.toml.tmpl' {
51	        $script:Prompts.Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 10
52	    }
53	
54	    It 'finds prompt flags in windows.yml' {
55	        $script:Flags.Count | Should -BeGreaterThan 10
56	    }
57	
58	    It 'has a CI flag for every init prompt' {
59	        $flagText = @($script:Flags.Text)
60	        $missing = @($script:Prompts | Where-Object { $flagText -notcontains $_.Text })
61	        $hint = ($missing | ForEach-Object {
62	            "            '--prompt$($_.Kind)','$($_.Text)=<value>',   # $($_.Var)"
63	        }) -join "`n"
64	        $missing.Count | Should -Be 0 -Because "windows.yml is missing these flags; add to the `$flags array:`n$hint"
65	    }
66	
67	    It 'has no stale CI flag without a matching prompt' {
68	        # Catches the other half of a rename: the prompt text changed but the
69	        # flag did not. chezmoi silently ignores an unmatched flag and then
70	        # blocks on the real prompt, so this would otherwise be invisible.
71	        $promptText = @($script:Prompts.Text)
72	        $stale = @($script:Flags | Where-Object { $promptText -notcontains $_.Text })
73	        $stale.Count | Should -Be 0 -Because "these windows.yml flags match no prompt: $($stale.Text -join '; ')"
74	    }
75	
76	    It 'uses the right flag kind for each prompt' {
77	        $byText = @{}
78	        foreach ($f in $script:Flags) { $byText[$f.Text] = $f.Kind }
79	        $wrong = @($script:Prompts | Where-Object {
80	            $byText.ContainsKey($_.Text) -and $byText[$_.Text] -ne $_.Kind
81	        })
82	        $wrong.Count | Should -Be 0 -Because "flag kind mismatch for: $($wrong.Var -join '; ')"
83	    }
84	
85	    It 'has no "=" in any prompt text' {
86	        # Invariant #1 corollary: chezmoi's `name=value` parser splits on the
87	        # FIRST "=", so a prompt whose text contains one can never be answered
88	        # non-interactively. This already broke the `role` prompt once.
89	        $bad = @($script:Prompts | Where-Object { $_.Text -match '=' })
90	        $bad.Count | Should -Be 0 -Because "prompt text may not contain '=': $($bad.Var -join '; ')"
91	    }
92	
93	    It 'keeps public package fallback explicit and default-off' {
94	        $template = Get-Content -Raw $tomlTmpl
95	        $template | Should -Match 'allowPublicPackageFallback"\s+"Allow one public PyPI/npm retry after eligible corporate feed failures"\s+false'
96	        @($script:Prompts | Where-Object Var -eq 'allowPublicPackageFallback').Count | Should -Be 1
97	    }
98	
99	    It 'describes only package ecosystems with configured China mirrors' {
100	        $prompt = $script:Prompts | Where-Object Var -eq 'useChineseMirror'
101	        $prompt.Text | Should -Match 'pip/uv, npm, RubyGems, Go, and rustup'
102	        $prompt.Text | Should -Not -Match 'Cargo|Node'
103	    }
104	}

+            ExitCode = $final.ExitCode

+            FallbackUsed = $attempts.Count -gt 1 -and $attempts[1].Source -eq 'public'

```text
1	# Context
2	
3	Managed Windows machines currently force the company PyPI/uv and npm pull-through feeds. A redirected Azure Artifacts download returned HTTP 503 during `just docs-build`; there is no fallback, and changing `managedMachine=false` would also alter unrelated app-policy behavior (Grammarly/Tailscale). The package-source template also fails to clear repo-owned values when switching policies, so additive profile reloads can retain stale corporate/China endpoints.
4	
5	The goal is to keep `managedMachine` semantics intact, add a separate default-off authorization for narrowly scoped public fallback, and make package-source transitions convergent. Corporate remains the only first attempt; public is one explicit, isolated retry for approved transient failures. No global `uv`/`npm` shim, mixed indexes, or fallback for auth/TLS/policy/package-resolution failures.
6	
7	# Implementation
8	
9	## 1. Separate policy and add the opt-in
10	
11	- Add `allowPublicPackageFallback` (default `false`) beside `managedMachine` in `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`; wording must say it applies only to eligible corporate PyPI/npm failures.
12	- Keep `managedMachine` responsible for corporate-source selection and Grammarly/Tailscale suppression. `useChineseMirror` remains the unmanaged China preference.
13	- Correct the China prompt wording to the ecosystems actually configured (pip/uv, npm, RubyGems, Go, rustup; not Cargo or Node/mise).
14	- Add the new noninteractive prompt answer to `.github/workflows/windows.yml` and extend `tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` invariants.
15	- Add the value to `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md` so future sessions see the active policy.
16	
17	## 2. Make persistent source selection converge
18	
19	Update `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` before applying a selected branch:
20	
21	- Remove a source variable only when its current value exactly matches a known endpoint previously written by this repo. This migrates corporate/China → official and China → managed while preserving unrelated user/IT values.
22	- Reapply the selected policy: managed sets corporate pip/uv/npm; unmanaged China sets TUNA/npmmirror/Go/rustup; official sets nothing after cleanup.
23	- Stop setting dead `MISE_NODE_MIRROR_URL`, but recognize its old exact value during cleanup.
24	- Keep `local.ps1` loaded last as the supported explicit machine-local override.
25	- Fix the `try-cli` template condition so Ruby China is used only for unmanaged + China; leave WSL’s separate mirror choice unchanged.
26	
27	## 3. Add one testable command-scoped runner
28	
29	Create `scripts/package-source-runner.ps1` and reuse it by template inclusion and direct dot-sourcing. Its public entry point should accept manager (`uv`/`npm`), arguments, operation label, managed/fallback booleans, output mode, timeout, and npm prefix where needed, and return a structured result containing success, exit code, timeout, fallback use, failure class, captured streams, and per-attempt metadata.
30	
31	Behavior:
32	
33	1. Run exactly one corporate-only attempt on managed machines.
34	2. Classify failure deny-first.
35	3. If and only if fallback is enabled and the failure is eligible, run exactly one public-only attempt.
36	4. Capture stdout/stderr asynchronously with `ProcessStartInfo`, enforce a bounded timeout, kill the process tree on timeout, and replay diagnostics to host or stderr as requested.
37	5. Build the child environment without mutating the parent; cleanup temporary files/directories in `finally`.
38	6. Print explicit source/failure/retry decisions without printing environment dumps, npmrc content, tokens, or credential-bearing URLs.
39	
40	Eligible classes are limited to:
41	
42	- runner/request timeout, HTTP 408, and recognized timeout codes;
43	- temporary corporate-host network failures (`ECONNRESET`, `ECONNREFUSED`, `EAI_AGAIN`, unreachable host, temporary DNS failure for the configured corporate host);
44	- explicit HTTP 500–599 / npm E5xx in HTTP error context.
45	
46	Never fallback for:
47	
48	- 401/403, authentication, authorization, administrator/organization policy;
49	- TLS/certificate/SSL failures;
50	- 404, ETARGET, package/version absence, generic uv/npm resolution errors;
51	- 429 rate limiting;
52	- build/postinstall/compiler errors, local permissions/locks/disk state, invalid commands, or missing executables.
53	
54	## 4. Isolate each source attempt
55	
56	For uv attempts:
57	
58	- Clear child-only uv/pip index/extra-index/config variables.
59	- Pass `--no-config`, a single `--default-index`, and `--index-strategy first-index`.
60	- Add `--no-project` to `uv run` surfaces so the repository lock/config cannot retain corporate artifact URLs during a public retry.
61	- Keep proxy, certificate-store, keyring, cache, and Python settings; do not clear caches.
62	
63	For npm attempts:
64	
65	- Run from an empty temporary working directory with temporary user/global npmrc files so repository/user/global registry and scoped-registry mappings cannot introduce a second source.
66	- Query and preserve only required source-neutral settings (notably prefix/cache and transport proxy/CA settings) without logging them; never copy or print auth entries.
67	- Force one `--registry` plus the requested package’s scope registry when scoped. Use the same explicit global prefix for both attempts.
68	- Clear registry-bearing `npm_config_*` child variables. Delete temporary configs in `finally`.
69	
70	Corporate endpoints remain `packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io`; public endpoints are `pypi.org/simple` and `registry.npmjs.org`.
71	
72	## 5. Wire only repo-owned corporate-backed operations
73	
74	- In `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl`, include the runner and route only:
75	  - each missing global npm coding-agent install;
76	  - uv tool installs for Apprise and LiteLLM.
77	- Preserve existing installed-artifact checks and nonfatal `Register-Failure` behavior.
78	- Do not wrap uv Python downloads, Scoop/winget, Go, Rust, Ruby, Git/CDN, PSGallery, or Azure CLI because no corporate source exists for them.
79	- In `dot_config/herdr/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl`, include the runner for `uv run --with tomlkit`; route all runner/uv diagnostics to stderr, keep stdout byte-pure TOML, pass `HERDR_*` paths child-only, and retain the managed-template fallback on final failure.
80	- In `justfile`, dot-source the runner and read `managedMachine`/`allowPublicPackageFallback` from `chezmoi data`:
81	  - split `upgrade-npm-agents` into one package per runner invocation;

39686	Design package fallback implementation
39687	
39688	```text
39689	## Recommended architecture
39690	
39691	Implement one reusable PowerShell library at:
39692	
39693	`C:\Users\hanruzhou\.local\share\chezmoi\scripts\package-source-runner.ps1`
39694	
39695	It should have two responsibilities:
39696	
39697	1. Run a native package-manager command in a child process with an isolated source configuration.
39698	2. Classify a failed corporate attempt and, only when explicitly allowed, run exactly one public-only attempt.
39699	
39700	Keep `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` responsible only for persistent interactive-shell policy and convergence. Do not put fallback logic or simultaneous corporate/public indexes into that template.
39701	
39702	### Policy model
39703	
39704	Add one init value:
39705	
39706	```text
39707	allowPublicPackageFallback = false
39708	```
39709	
39710	Semantics:
39711	
39712	- `managedMachine` continues to:
39713	  - select corporate PyPI/npm sources;
39714	  - suppress Grammarly and Tailscale;
39715	  - take precedence over `useChineseMirror`.
39716	- `useChineseMirror` remains an independent mirror preference for unmanaged machines.
39717	- `allowPublicPackageFallback` only permits eligible corporate-first uv/npm commands to make a second public attempt.
39718	- It has no effect when `managedMachine=false`.
39719	- Interactive environments always contain at most one source. Never configure public as an extra index beside corporate.
39720	
39721	## Helper API and behavior
39722	
39723	Expose a testable entry point shaped like:
39724	
39725	```powershell
39726	Invoke-PackageSourceCommand `
39727	    -Manager uv|npm `
39728	    -Executable <resolved executable> `
39729	    -Arguments <string[]> `
39730	    -Operation <diagnostic label> `
39731	    -PackageSpec <optional npm package or uv requirement> `
39732	    -ManagedMachine <bool> `
39733	    -AllowPublicFallback <bool> `
39734	    -OutputMode Host|StandardError|Capture `
39735	    -Environment <optional child-only variables> `
39736	    -TimeoutSeconds 600
39737	```
39738	
39739	Return a structured object rather than only `$LASTEXITCODE`:
39740	
39741	```text
39742	Succeeded
39743	ExitCode
39744	TimedOut
39745	FallbackUsed
39746	FailureClass
39747	Attempts[]
39748	Stdout
39749	Stderr
39750	```
39751	
39752	Each attempt record should contain its source kind, exit code, timeout state, captured output, and classification.
39753	
39754	Supporting internal functions should be:
39755	
39756	- `Invoke-CapturedPackageProcess`
39757	  - Uses `ProcessStartInfo`.
39758	  - Reads stdout and stderr asynchronously to avoid deadlocks.
39759	  - Retains output for classification.
39760	  - Streams text while running in `Host` mode.
39761	  - Routes both child streams and helper diagnostics to stderr in `StandardError` mode.
39762	  - Kills the process tree on timeout.
39763	- `Get-PackageSourceAttempt`
39764	  - Produces the exact corporate or public command/environment.
39765	- `Get-PackageFailureClass`
39766	  - Applies deny-first, manager-specific classification.
39767	- `Test-PackageFallbackEligible`
39768	  - Returns true only for the approved classes.
39769	- `Get-ChezmoiPackageSourceSettings`
39770	  - Used by `justfile`; reads `chezmoi data --format=json` and extracts only `managedMachine` and `allowPublicPackageFallback`.
39771	
39772	All source overrides must be placed in `ProcessStartInfo.Environment` or command arguments. Do not mutate the parent PowerShell environment, so success, failure, timeout, and exceptions inherently preserve it.
39773	
39774	For Herdr, pass `HERDR_TEMPLATE_FILE`, `HERDR_LIVE_FILE`, and `HERDR_OUT_FILE` through the child environment as well. This fixes the current remove-in-`finally` behavior, which loses pre-existing values rather than restoring them.
39775	
39776	### Diagnostics
39777	
39778	Print one explicit line for each decision:
39779	
39780	```text
39781	package-source[uv:apprise]: attempt 1/2 using corporate PyPI
39782	package-source[uv:apprise]: corporate attempt failed: http-5xx (HTTP 503)
39783	package-source[uv:apprise]: public fallback enabled; retrying with public PyPI only
39784	```
39785	
39786	For a denied retry:
39787	
39788	```text
39789	package-source[npm:@openai/codex]: corporate attempt failed: auth-policy (HTTP 403)
39790	package-source[npm:@openai/codex]: public fallback not permitted for auth-policy; not retrying
39791	```
39792	
39793	When the toggle is false, say so explicitly. Never print npmrc contents, environment dumps, auth tokens, or URLs containing user-info credentials.
39794	
39795	## Exact fallback classification
39796	
39797	Classification must be deny-first. If output matches both a deny class and an eligible class, the deny class wins.
39798	
39799	### Eligible
39800	
39801	1. **`timeout`**
39802	   - Runner-enforced timeout.
39803	   - Explicit request timeout, including HTTP 408.
39804	   - Codes/phrases such as:
39805	     - `ETIMEDOUT`
39806	     - `ESOCKETTIMEDOUT`
39807	     - `UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`
39808	     - `UND_ERR_HEADERS_TIMEOUT`
39809	     - `timed out`
39810	     - `request timeout`
39811	
39812	2. **`transient-network`**
39813	   - `ECONNRESET`
39814	   - `ECONNREFUSED`
39815	   - `EAI_AGAIN`
39816	   - `ENETUNREACH`
39817	   - `EHOSTUNREACH`
39818	   - `socket hang up`
39819	   - `connection reset`
39820	   - `connection refused`
39821	   - temporary DNS failure
39822	   - `ENOTFOUND` or “could not resolve host” only when the failed host is the configured corporate endpoint
39823	
39824	3. **`http-5xx`**
39825	   - Explicit HTTP status 500–599.
39826	   - npm `E500`–`E599`.
39827	   - Require HTTP/status/error context so an unrelated package version containing a three-digit number cannot trigger fallback.
39828	
39829	4. **`mirror-absence`**
39830	   - npm:
39831	     - `E404`/404 tied to a package metadata or tarball URL on `packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io` or its documented `*.pkgs.visualstudio.com` backend.
39832	     - `ETARGET`.
39833	     - `No matching version found`.
39834	     - `is not in this registry`.
39835	   - uv:
39836	     - `was not found in the package registry`.
39837	     - `Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement`.
39838	     - `No matching distribution found`.
39839	     - A 404 explicitly tied to the configured corporate package endpoint.
39840	   - A bare uv `No solution found` is not sufficient.
39841	
39842	### Never eligible
39843	
39844	- **Authentication or authorization**
39845	  - HTTP 401/403, `E401`, `E403`, unauthorized, forbidden, authentication required, invalid authentication.
39846	- **TLS/certificate**
39847	  - certificate verification failures, expired certificates, unknown issuer, self-signed chain, TLS/SSL handshake or peer-certificate errors.
39848	- **Policy**
39849	  - explicitly blocked/prohibited by administrator, organization, or policy.
39850	- **Rate limiting**
39851	  - HTTP 429 is a 4xx and must not be treated as a transient-network fallback.
39852	- **Generic resolution**
39853	  - npm `ERESOLVE`.
39854	  - uv `No solution found` without explicit registry absence.
39855	  - incompatible Python/platform/version constraints.
39856	- **Build/install**
39857	  - wheel or sdist build failure, compiler failure, postinstall failure, subprocess error.
39858	- **Local state**
39859	  - `EPERM`, `EACCES`, `EBUSY`, locked executable, disk-full, invalid arguments.
39860	- **Runner failures**
39861	  - executable missing, child launch error, malformed command.
39862	
39863	There is one corporate attempt and at most one public attempt. Do not loop across sources.
39864	
39865	## Source isolation
39866	
39867	### uv
39868	
39869	Corporate attempt:
39870	
39871	```powershell
39872	uv <subcommand> `
39873	  --no-config `
39874	  --default-index https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/pypi/simple/ `
39875	  --index-strategy first-index `
39876	  <remaining arguments>
39877	```
39878	
39879	Public attempt:
39880	
39881	```powershell
39882	uv <subcommand> `
39883	  --no-config `
39884	  --default-index https://pypi.org/simple `
39885	  --index-strategy first-index `
39886	  <remaining arguments>
39887	```
39888	
39889	Remove the following from the child environment for every isolated attempt:
39890	
39891	```text
39892	UV_INDEX
39893	UV_DEFAULT_INDEX
39894	UV_INDEX_URL
39895	UV_EXTRA_INDEX_URL
39896	UV_FIND_LINKS
39897	UV_NO_INDEX
39898	UV_CONFIG_FILE
39899	UV_INSECURE_HOST
39900	PIP_INDEX_URL
39901	PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL
39902	PIP_FIND_LINKS
39903	PIP_NO_INDEX
39904	PIP_CONFIG_FILE
39905	PIP_TRUSTED_HOST
39906	```
39907	
39908	Leave proxies, certificate-store selection, keyring settings, and cache settings intact. Do not add `--no-cache`, `--refresh`, or delete caches.
39909	
39910	Both `uv run` surfaces must also use `--no-project`, because the repository’s `uv.lock` contains corporate artifact URLs and would otherwise contaminate a public attempt.
39911	
39912	Exact eligible uv invocations become:
39913	
39914	```powershell
39915	uv tool install --no-config --default-index <one-url> --index-strategy first-index `
39916	    --with pywin32 apprise
39917	
39918	uv tool install --no-config --default-index <one-url> --index-strategy first-index `
39919	    'litellm[proxy]'
39920	
39921	uv run --no-project --no-config --default-index <one-url> --index-strategy first-index `
39922	    --quiet --with tomlkit --python '>=3.11' python <merge-script>
39923	
39924	uv run --no-project --no-config --default-index <one-url> --index-strategy first-index `
39925	    --with mkdocs-material --with mkdocs-static-i18n mkdocs serve
39926	```
39927	
39928	The build recipe uses the same shape with `mkdocs build --strict`.
39929	
39930	Do not wrap `uv python install`; Python runtime downloads have no corporate package index.
39931	
39932	### npm
39933	
39934	Each attempt should:
39935	
39936	1. Resolve npm’s current user/global npmrc paths without displaying their contents.
39937	2. Create attempt-specific temporary npmrc copies.
39938	3. Copy source-neutral configuration verbatim, including prefix, cache, proxy, certificate, and host-bound authentication entries.
39939	4. Remove every active `registry=` and `@scope:registry=` assignment from the temporary copies.

+managed machine, repo-owned npm agent installs/updates and uv dependency

+trigger exactly one source-isolated retry against public PyPI/npm. Authentication
+or policy errors (401/403), TLS/certificate failures, 404/package absence, rate
+limits, solver/build errors, and local permission failures never fall back.
+
+Corporate and public indexes are never configured together. Each attempt clears
+extra index/registry inputs in its child process, preserves the parent shell and
+cache, and reports the retry explicitly. Switching source modes also removes only
+known endpoint values emitted by earlier repo versions; every other user/IT
+value survives, and `local.ps1` remains the final interactive override.

88481	environments — they keep the entire enclosing scope alive for the object's

88484	alternative.

125	# source) — used for apps with no community winget manifest, e.g. Raycast and the
126	# official ChatGPT desktop app. msstore ignores --scope, so we don't pass it.
127	function Winget-InstallStore([string]$id) {
128	    if (-not (Have winget)) { Register-Failure "msstore:$id (winget unavailable)"; return }
129	    winget list --id $id -e --accept-source-agreements *> $null
130	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { return }   # already installed
131	    Info "winget (msstore) install $id"
132	    winget install --id $id -e --source msstore --silent `
133	        --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements 2>&1 | Out-Host
134	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Register-Failure "msstore:$id" }
135	}
136	
137	# --- npm CLI agents --------------------------------------------------------
138	function Npm-InstallGlobal([string[]]$pkgs) {
139	    if (-not (Have npm)) { foreach ($p in $pkgs) { Register-Failure "npm:$p (npm unavailable)" }; return }
140	    $npmExecutable = (Get-Command npm -CommandType Application | Select-Object -First 1).Source
141	    try { $npm = Get-NpmGlobalExecutionContext -NpmCommandPath $npmExecutable }
142	    catch {
143	        foreach ($p in $pkgs) { Register-Failure "npm:$p (cannot resolve npm execution context)" }
144	        return
145	    }
146	    $npmRoot = $npm.Root
147	    foreach ($p in $pkgs) {
148	        # Apply is install-only. Re-running `npm install -g` as an implicit
149	        # upgrade fails with EBUSY/EPERM whenever an agent executable is live on
150	        # Windows. A package.json is a cheap, registry-independent presence test.
151	        $packageManifest = Join-Path (Join-Path $npmRoot $p) 'package.json'
152	        if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $packageManifest) {
153	            Info "npm: $p already installed -- skipping (upgrade: just upgrade-npm-agents)"
154	            continue
155	        }
156	        Info "npm i -g $p"
157	        $result = Invoke-PackageSourceCommand -Manager npm -Executable $npm.NodeExecutable `
158	            -Arguments @($npm.NpmCli, 'install', '-g', $p) -Operation $p `
159	            -PackageSpec $p -NpmPrefix $npm.Prefix -NpmCache $npm.Cache `
160	            -ManagedMachine $managedMachine -AllowPublicFallback $allowPublicPackageFallback
161	        if (-not $result.Succeeded) { Register-Failure "npm:$p" }
162	    }
163	}
164	
165	# --- herdr (native Windows terminal multiplexer, preview beta) --------------
166	# No scoop/winget/npm manifest — installs via herdr.dev's irm|iex bootstrap
167	# (same shape as Ensure-Scoop). This repo selects the preview channel; the bin
168	# junction is %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Herdr\bin (added to PATH in profile.d/00_env.ps1).
169	function Install-Herdr {
170	    $herdrBin = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Herdr\bin\herdr.exe'
171	    if ((Have herdr) -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $herdrBin)) { Info 'herdr already installed'; return }
172	    Info 'installing herdr (preview) via herdr.dev/install.ps1'
173	    try {
174	        $env:HERDR_CHANNEL = 'preview'   # Windows builds are preview-only
175	        $installer = [scriptblock]::Create((Invoke-RestMethod https://herdr.dev/install.ps1))
176	        & $installer
177	        if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $herdrBin)) { Register-Failure 'herdr' }
178	    } catch {
179	        Write-Warning "herdr install error: $_"
180	        Register-Failure 'herdr'
181	    }
182	}
183	
184	# herdr-plus — third-party herdr plugin backing the prefix+y (Quick Actions) and
185	# prefix+O (Projects) keybinds, plus the copy-pane Quick Actions this repo deploys
186	# to ~/.config/herdr/plugins/config/cloudmanic.herdr-plus/. We ship that CONFIG and
187	# those KEYBINDS, so not installing the plugin leaves both keys silently dead —

 `C:/Users/hanruzhou/.local/share/chezmoi/pitfalls/packagefeedproxy-pypi-503-azure-artifacts-backend.md`

```text
1	# uv fails with HTTP 503 while downloading from the company PyPI feed
2	
3	**Symptoms**: `Request failed after 3 retries`, `HTTP status server error (503 Service Unavailable)`, final URL under `ms-feed-*.pkgs.visualstudio.com`, `just docs-build` fails although the configured index is `packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/pypi/simple`
4	
5	**First seen**: 2026-08  
6	**Affects**: managed Windows machines using uv through the company PyPI pull-through feed  
7	**Status**: source-isolated opt-in fallback implemented
8	
9	## Symptom
10	
11	A managed shell configures:
12	
13	```text
14	UV_DEFAULT_INDEX=https://packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io/pypi/simple/
15	```
16	
17	but uv reports the failure against a different-looking host:
18	
19	```text
20	error: Request failed after 3 retries
21	Caused by: Failed to fetch: https://ms-feed-*.pkgs.visualstudio.com/.../pypi/download/...
22	Caused by: HTTP status server error (503 Service Unavailable)
23	```
24	
25	A successful feed-root or package-metadata probe does not disprove the problem;
26	the redirected artifact download can fail independently.
27	
28	## Root cause
29	
30	`packagefeedproxy.microsoft.io` is the configured company pull-through endpoint.
31	It resolves package artifacts through an Azure Artifacts backend, so uv displays
32	the final `*.pkgs.visualstudio.com` download URL when that backend returns 503.
33	This is not a malformed PyPI URL and does not show that `pypi.org` itself failed.
34	
35	## Workaround
36	
37	The default remains corporate-only. On a machine where public fallback is
38	explicitly permitted, enable the `Allow one public PyPI/npm retry after eligible
39	corporate feed failures` init prompt and re-apply/reload the profile.
40	
41	Repo-owned npm/uv commands then:
42	
43	1. try only the corporate source;
44	2. classify the captured failure;
45	3. retry exactly once against only the public source for timeout, temporary
46	   network errors, or explicit HTTP 5xx.
47	
48	For a one-off manual docs build without changing the prompt:
49	
50	```powershell
51	uv run --no-project --no-config `
52	  --default-index https://pypi.org/simple --index-strategy first-index `
53	  --with mkdocs-material --with mkdocs-static-i18n mkdocs build --strict
54	```
55	
56	## Prevention
57	
58	- Never configure public PyPI as an `extra-index` beside the company feed.
59	- Never fall back on 401/403, TLS/certificate, policy, 404/package-absence,
60	  rate-limit, solver/build, or local permission failures.
61	- Keep fallback command-scoped; do not rewrite the parent shell or npmrc.
62	- Test artifact resolution, not only the index root.
63	- Keep `scripts/package-source-runner.ps1` covered by deterministic fake-command
64	  tests so classification does not broaden accidentally.
65	
66	## Related
67	
68	- [`packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path`](packagefeedproxy-npm-404-wrong-base-path.md)
69	- [`docs/tools.md`](../docs/tools.md#package-registries)
70	- `AGENTS.md` hard invariant 8
71
```

1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) and other coding

5	
6	## What this is
7	
8	Standalone, **Windows-only** dotfiles managed by [chezmoi](https://chezmoi.io),
9	targeting **PowerShell 7 (pwsh)**. It is a companion to the cross-platform
10	macOS/Linux repo `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` — the PowerShell layer is written
11	natively, **not** ported from that repo's POSIX shell config. No ansible;
12	packages install via **scoop** (CLI) + **winget** (GUI). Published at
13	`github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows`.
14	
15	**Dev box vs target:** the deploy target is Windows, but this checkout is usually
16	edited on macOS/Linux. You therefore **cannot execute the `.ps1` run-scripts
17	here** (they call winget / `%APPDATA%`). Validate with the isolated-apply +
18	render/parse pattern below; the `windows-latest` CI is the real gate.
19	
20	## Commands
21	
22	Real machine:
23	
24	- `chezmoi apply` / `chezmoi diff` (or `just apply` / `just diff`)
25	- `just upgrade-scoop` / `just upgrade-winget`
26	
27	Validate locally (needs a local pwsh, e.g. installed to `~/.local/bin/pwsh`):
28	
29	- Lint: `pwsh -NoProfile -c "Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path . -Recurse -Settings ./PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1"` (fails only on Error; the excludes are deliberate — see the settings file header)
30	- Tests: `pwsh -NoProfile -c "Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests"` (single file: `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/Copilot.Tests.ps1`)
31	- Docs: `just docs-build` (= `uv run --with mkdocs-material --with mkdocs-static-i18n mkdocs build --strict`)
32	
33	Isolated apply + template render (the core idiom for testing without a Windows
34	box — all chezmoi state is redirected to a temp dir, so it never touches your
35	real setup):
36	
37	```bash
38	TMPD=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$TMPD/home"
39	chezmoi init --source="$PWD" --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --persistent-state="$TMPD/s.db" \
40	  --destination="$TMPD/home" --no-tty \
41	  --promptChoice='Role: workstation (full desktop) or minimal (shell only)=minimal' \
42	  --promptString='Your full name (git)=T' --promptString='Your git email=t@e.com' ...  # EVERY prompt, exact text
43	chezmoi apply --source="$PWD" --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --persistent-state="$TMPD/s.db" \
44	  --destination="$TMPD/home" --exclude=scripts   # scripts can't run off-Windows
45	chezmoi execute-template --config="$TMPD/c.toml" --source="$PWD" < some.ps1.tmpl > r.ps1  # then parse r.ps1 with pwsh
46	```
47	
48	## Architecture (big picture)
49	
50	- **Init** — `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` `[data]` prompts once (`role` → coarse defaults, then `installX` toggles) and sets `[interpreters.ps1] = pwsh` so chezmoi runs `.ps1` scripts under pwsh. Prompts are hand-authored here (the parent repo generates them; this repo does not).
51	- **Shell** — `Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1` is a thin `$PROFILE` loader that dot-sources `dot_config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in numeric order (env → tool activation → aliases → apps/audio/clipboard → copilot import → yazi → tv cache → psreadline). Add a shell feature = a new numbered fragment. User overrides go in the untracked `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1`.
52	- **Packages** — `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the single source of truth for installs: scoop (CLI), winget (GUI), npm (AI agents), PSGallery (PSFzf / AudioDeviceCmdlets), all gated by init toggles. `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` owns persistent registry environment variables; `scripts/package-source-runner.ps1` owns command-scoped corporate-first fallback for the enumerated npm/uv operations. Managed machines use company PyPI/npm feeds; otherwise the China toggle selects GFW mirrors. Fault-tolerant (see invariants).
53	- **copilot-proxy** — `dot_config/powershell/modules/Copilot/` is a native PowerShell port of the parent's `43_copilot_proxy.sh` / `44_copilot_embed.sh` (runs the copilot-api fork so GitHub Copilot can back Claude Code and Codex). Reuses the Bun `copilot-throttle-shim.js` verbatim.
54	- **Config surfaces** — Alacritty (`AppData/Roaming/alacritty/`), Windows Terminal (a run_onchange that merges `profiles.defaults` non-destructively), WezTerm (`dot_config/wezterm/wezterm.lua` — sets pwsh as `default_prog`), editors (a run_onchange that deep-merges `editors/*.json` into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`), Claude Code (one `installCodingAgents`-gated, fail-closed run_onchange deep-merges settings and claude-hud Full config while preserving live/user-owned keys; see `docs/rationale.md`), Codex (`dot_codex/modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl` fail-closed-merges only the native `tui.status_line` into `~/.codex/config.toml`, preserving providers/projects/plugins and gated on `installCodingAgents`), apprise desktop notifications (`dot_config/apprise/apprise.yaml` → `~/.config/apprise/`; the `windows://` toast backend behind the Claude notify hook `dot_claude/hooks/notify.ps1`, `installCodingAgents`-gated — the notify hook and peon-ping's voice-line hooks are both gated on the `agentSounds` tier (none|notify|peon|both) and built in the run_onchange, NOT in `claude/settings-overlay.json`; see docs/agent-sounds.md), television channels (`AppData/Roaming/television/`), starship + yazi (`~/.config`, yazi via `YAZI_CONFIG_HOME`), Rime/Weasel (see below), herdr (see below).
55	- **Rime input method** — `installInputMethod`-gated, and the one config surface **shared with the parent repo**. The engine-level YAML lives in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` (`default.custom.yaml`, `luna_pinyin.custom.yaml`) and is kept **byte-identical** to `daviddwlee84/dotfiles`'s copy of the same path — `diff -r` between the two dirs is the drift check, so edit one and copy to the other in the same session. Each platform is a one-line `{{ template "rime/…" . }}` renderer: `AppData/Roaming/Rime/` here, `private_Library/Rime/` (Squirrel) and `dot_config/ibus/rime/` (ibus-rime) there. Only `weasel.custom.yaml` is Windows-specific (`style/` is Weasel's own, `app_options` keys on the EXE name vs. Squirrel's bundle ids, and `global_ascii` doesn't exist on Squirrel). Plain managed files, **not** a `modify_` overlay: Rime persists runtime state to `user.yaml`, never back into `*.custom.yaml`. Two gotchas: a bare silent winget install registers **简体** (hence `--custom '/T'` in `Install-Weasel` — see `pitfalls/weasel-silent-install-registers-simplified-chinese.md`), and config edits need a redeploy, which `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.
56	- **herdr** — `dot_config/herdr/` is deployed via `HERDR_CONFIG_PATH` and gated on `installHerdr`. `config.toml` is a **`modify_` overlay** (`modify_config.toml.ps1.tmpl` + `.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml`), never a plain managed file: herdr rewrites that file at runtime (onboarding flag, `[session]`, `[remote]`, `[update]` bookkeeping) and a plain file clobbers it. The overlay enforces `[theme]`/`[ui]`/`[terminal]`/`[keys]` wholesale, pulls every other top-level key through, and re-asserts the single key `update.channel = "preview"` (the Windows installer rejects `stable`). `run_after_15_sync_herdr_skill.ps1.tmpl` exports the exact installed binary's `herdr --skill` output to real copies under both `~/.agents/skills/herdr/` and `~/.claude/skills/herdr/`; no symlink/junction is used. Helper-script paths in the keymap are baked **absolute at render time** — `pwsh -File` does not expand `~`. Six pwsh helpers (`_common.ps1` + run-command / new-tab-at-space-root / url-pick / path-pick / pane-copy / review-mark) back the `[[keys.command]]` bindings; three `herdr-*` tv channels and the herdr-plus quick-actions are gated by the same toggle. Ported from the parent repo 2026-07-27; the behaviours that still need a real Windows box are listed in [`backlog/herdr-windows-port-verification.md`](backlog/herdr-windows-port-verification.md).
57	- **git config** — `~/.gitconfig` is a **`modify_` overlay** (`modify_dot_gitconfig.ps1.tmpl`), never a plain managed file: Git Credential Manager writes `[credential "azrepos:*"]` blocks into it out of band and a plain file would clobber them every apply. The baseline body is `.chezmoitemplates/git/gitconfig` (identity from the existing `.name`/`.email` init prompts); the merge engine is `scripts/gitconfig-merge.ps1`, inlined via `{{ include }}` (the `editors/` idiom) and dot-sourced by `tests/GitConfig.Tests.ps1`. The model is **key-level pull-through**: the baseline owns a fixed set of `section.key` pairs and every other live key is carried over untouched — the inverse of the parent repo's allowlist, which would silently drop `[otel]` and future corp sections. Two hard rules: `core.hooksPath` is **never** emitted (git honours it *instead of* `.git/hooks/`, silently disarming `pre-commit`), and the carry dictionary is **case-sensitive** (`[ordered]@{}` collapses `azrepos:org/O365Exchange` into `azrepos:org/o365exchange`, merging two credential contexts).
58	- **Docs** — bilingual mkdocs-material (`docs/X.md` + `docs/X.zh-TW.md`), deployed to GitHub Pages by `.github/workflows/docs.yml`. `docs/rationale.md` records the design choices (scoop > Chocolatey, starship > oh-my-posh, pwsh > cmd, native pwsh tree > ported shell layer).

60	
61	## Conventions & hard invariants
62	
63	1. **A new/renamed init prompt must update the CI flags in the same commit.** `chezmoi init --promptBool/--promptChoice "<text>=value"` matches the prompt's exact TEXT (3rd arg to `promptXOnce` in `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl`), used non-interactively by `.github/workflows/windows.yml`. Forget it → CI's init hangs/EOFs (`error calling promptChoiceOnce: EOF`; this broke three consecutive pushes when `agentSounds` was added). Corollary: **never put `=` in a prompt's text** — the `name=value` parser splits on the first `=` (this broke the `role` prompt once). Enforced by `tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` (missing flag, stale flag, wrong flag kind, `=` in text), which CI runs *before* `chezmoi init` so the failure names the missing flag instead of EOF-ing — run `Invoke-Pester -Path ./tests/InitPrompts.Tests.ps1` locally after touching either file.
64	2. **Run-scripts must never abort the apply.** The installer + editor/terminal/backup/skill scripts use `$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'` (+ `PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference=$false`), collect failures via `Register-Failure`, print a summary, and exit 0. One bad scoop/winget manifest (e.g. btop's stale `.conf`) must not stop the rest.
65	3. **Preserve raw escapes when authoring config with control chars.** Alacritty CSI-u (`[…u`), VSCode `sendSequence`, tv `\t` — hand-typing tends to drop them. Generate via a throwaway Python script and re-parse (`tomllib` / `json`) to confirm the escape landed.
66	4. **tv channel commands are `pwsh -NoProfile -Command "…"` inside TOML literal (`'''…'''`) strings** — runs regardless of tv's shell, sidesteps nested-quote escaping; placeholders `{split: :0}` (space) / `{split:\t:0}` (tab). tv reads config from `%APPDATA%\television\` on Windows.
67	5. **Editors use a run_onchange pwsh merger, not `modify_`** (`modify_` interpreter selection is unreliable on Windows). Overlay sources live in `editors/` (chezmoi-ignored, embedded via `{{ include }}`).
68	6. **The agent skill body lives once** in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`; both `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` and `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/SKILL.md.tmpl` render it via `{{ "{{" }} template … {{ "}}" }}` → real files at `~/.agents/skills/` and `~/.claude/skills/`. Edit the shared template, not the two one-line renderers (no symlink/junction — those need elevation/Developer Mode on Windows).
69	7. **PSScriptAnalyzer exclusions are intentional** (`PSScriptAnalyzerSettings.psd1`): hyphenated command names, `Write-Host`, `Invoke-Expression` for tool init, no-BOM UTF-8. Don't "fix" these; do fix real Errors.
70	8. **Public package fallback is opt-in, deny-first, and single-source.** Only repo-owned npm agent operations and uv dependency resolution may use `scripts/package-source-runner.ps1`; corporate is always attempted first and public at most once. Never add public as an extra index, broaden fallback beyond timeout/transient-network/HTTP-5xx, or bypass 401/403, TLS/certificate, package-absence, policy, solver/build, or local-state failures. Go/Rust/Ruby/Scoop/winget/Git/CDN operations have no corporate source and must not use this fallback.

73	
74	- New installer tool → `docs/tools.md` **and** `docs/tools.zh-TW.md`.
75	- New init prompt → `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` + `windows.yml` flags + `docs/setup.md`/`setup.zh-TW.md` tables + the "What's enabled" block in `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.

82	
83	`scripts/{add-todo,todo-kanban,promote-todo,sweep-inbox}.sh` are byte-identical

+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $rootOutput) { throw 'cannot resolve global npm root' }
+    $npmRoot = ([string] $rootOutput[-1]).Trim()
+    $cacheOutput = @(& $NpmCommandPath config get cache 2>$null)
+    $npmCache = if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $cacheOutput) { ([string] $cacheOutput[-1]).Trim() } else { '' }
+
+    [pscustomobject]@{
+        NodeExecutable = $nodeExecutable
+        NpmCli = $npmCli
+        Root = $npmRoot
+        Prefix = Split-Path -Parent $npmRoot
+        Cache = $npmCache
+    }
+}
+
+function Add-UvSourceArguments {
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string[]] $Arguments,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $SourceUrl
+    )
+
+    $sourceArguments = @('--default-index', $SourceUrl, '--index-strategy', 'first-index')
+    if ($Arguments.Count -ge 2 -and $Arguments[0] -eq 'tool' -and $Arguments[1] -eq 'install') {
+        $remaining = if ($Arguments.Count -gt 2) { @($Arguments[2..($Arguments.Count - 1)]) } else { @() }
+        return @('--no-config', 'tool', 'install') + $sourceArguments + $remaining
+    }
+    if ($Arguments.Count -ge 1 -and $Arguments[0] -eq 'run') {
+        $remaining = if ($Arguments.Count -gt 1) { @($Arguments[1..($Arguments.Count - 1)]) } else { @() }
+        return @('--no-config', 'run') + $sourceArguments + $remaining
+    }
+    throw "unsupported isolated uv command: $($Arguments -join ' ')"
+}
+
+function Invoke-PackageSourceCommand {
+    [CmdletBinding()]
+    param(
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [ValidateSet('uv', 'npm')] [string] $Manager,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Executable,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [AllowEmptyCollection()] [string[]] $Arguments,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Operation,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [bool] $ManagedMachine,
+        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [bool] $AllowPublicFallback,
+        [string] $PackageSpec,
+        [string] $NpmPrefix,
+        [string] $NpmCache,
+        [hashtable] $AdditionalEnvironment = @{},
+        [ValidateSet('Host', 'StandardError', 'Capture')] [string] $OutputMode = 'Host',
+        [ValidateRange(1, 86400)] [int] $TimeoutSeconds = 600,
+        [string] $CorporatePyPiIndex = $script:CorporatePyPiIndex,
+        [string] $PublicPyPiIndex = $script:PublicPyPiIndex,
+        [string] $CorporateNpmRegistry = $script:CorporateNpmRegistry,
+        [string] $PublicNpmRegistry = $script:PublicNpmRegistry
+    )
+
+    $attempts = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
+    $tempRoot = $null
+    try {
+        $workingDirectory = $null
+        $baseEnvironment = @{}
+        foreach ($key in $AdditionalEnvironment.Keys) { $baseEnvironment[$key] = $AdditionalEnvironment[$key] }
+        if ($ManagedMachine) {
+            $baseEnvironment = New-PackageAttemptEnvironment -Manager $Manager -AdditionalEnvironment $AdditionalEnvironment
+            if ($Manager -eq 'npm') {
+                if (-not $NpmPrefix) { throw 'NpmPrefix is required for npm source isolation' }
+                $tempRoot = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('package-source-npm-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
+                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tempRoot | Out-Null
+                $userConfig = Join-Path $tempRoot 'user.npmrc'
+                $globalConfig = Join-Path $tempRoot 'global.npmrc'
+                [IO.File]::WriteAllText($userConfig, '', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+                [IO.File]::WriteAllText($globalConfig, '', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
+                $baseEnvironment['NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG'] = $userConfig
+                $baseEnvironment['NPM_CONFIG_GLOBALCONFIG'] = $globalConfig
+                $workingDirectory = $tempRoot
+            }
+        }
+
+        $sourceQueue = [Collections.Generic.Queue[string]]::new()
+        $sourceQueue.Enqueue($(if ($ManagedMachine) { 'corporate' } else { 'ambient' }))
+        while ($sourceQueue.Count -gt 0) {
+            $sourceKind = $sourceQueue.Dequeue()
+            $attemptNumber = $attempts.Count + 1
+            $sourceLabel = if ($sourceKind -eq 'ambient') { 'ambient package policy' } elseif ($Manager -eq 'uv') { "$sourceKind PyPI" } else { "$sourceKind npm" }
+            Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: attempt $attemptNumber using $sourceLabel"
+
+            $attemptArguments = @($Arguments)
+            $attemptEnvironment = @{} + $baseEnvironment
+            if ($sourceKind -ne 'ambient') {
+                $sourceUrl = if ($Manager -eq 'uv') {
+                    if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') { $CorporatePyPiIndex } else { $PublicPyPiIndex }
+                } else {
+                    if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') { $CorporateNpmRegistry } else { $PublicNpmRegistry }
+                }
+                if ($Manager -eq 'uv') {
+                    $attemptArguments = Add-UvSourceArguments -Arguments $attemptArguments -SourceUrl $sourceUrl
+                } else {
+                    $attemptArguments += "--registry=$sourceUrl"
+                    $scope = Get-NpmPackageScope -PackageSpec $PackageSpec
+                    if ($scope) { $attemptArguments += "--$scope`:registry=$sourceUrl" }
+                    $attemptArguments += "--prefix=$NpmPrefix"
+                    if ($NpmCache) { $attemptArguments += "--cache=$NpmCache" }
+                }
+            }
+
+            $processResult = Invoke-CapturedPackageProcess -Executable $Executable -Arguments $attemptArguments `
+                -Environment $attemptEnvironment -WorkingDirectory $workingDirectory `
+                -TimeoutSeconds $TimeoutSeconds -OutputMode $OutputMode
+            $combinedOutput = "$($processResult.Stdout)`n$($processResult.Stderr)"
+            $failureClass = if ($processResult.ExitCode -eq 0) { 'none' } else {
+                Get-PackageFailureClass -Output $combinedOutput -TimedOut $processResult.TimedOut -LaunchFailed $processResult.LaunchFailed
+            }
+            $attempts.Add([pscustomobject]@{
+                Source = $sourceKind
+                ExitCode = $processResult.ExitCode
+                TimedOut = $processResult.TimedOut
+                FailureClass = $failureClass
+                Stdout = $processResult.Stdout
+                Stderr = $processResult.Stderr
+            })
+
+            if ($processResult.ExitCode -eq 0) { break }
+            Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: $sourceKind attempt failed: $failureClass"
+
+            if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate' -and $AllowPublicFallback -and (Test-PackageFallbackEligible $failureClass)) {
+                Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: public fallback enabled; retrying once"
+                $sourceQueue.Enqueue('public')
+            } elseif ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') {
+                $reason = if (-not $AllowPublicFallback) { 'fallback is disabled' } else { "$failureClass is not eligible" }
+                Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: $reason; not retrying"
+            }
+        }
+
+        $final = $attempts[$attempts.Count - 1]
+        [pscustomobject]@{
+            Succeeded = $final.ExitCode -eq 0
+            ExitCode = $final.ExitCode
+            TimedOut = $final.TimedOut
+            FallbackUsed = $attempts.Count -gt 1 -and $attempts[1].Source -eq 'public'
+            FailureClass = $final.FailureClass
+            Attempts = @($attempts)
+            Stdout = $final.Stdout
+            Stderr = $final.Stderr
+        }
+    } finally {
+        if ($tempRoot) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tempRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
+    }
+}
+
+function Get-ChezmoiPackageSourcePolicy {
+    $raw = @(& chezmoi data --format json 2>$null)
+    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $raw) { throw 'could not read chezmoi package-source policy' }
+    $data = ($raw -join "`n") | ConvertFrom-Json
+    [pscustomobject]@{
+        ManagedMachine = [bool] $data.managedMachine
+        AllowPublicFallback = [bool] $data.allowPublicPackageFallback
+    }
+}

# dotfiles-windows

This machine's `$HOME` is managed by a **chezmoi** dotfiles repo targeting **native
Windows + PowerShell 7**. Packages install via **scoop** (CLI) + **winget** (GUI) —
there is no ansible here. Repo: <https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows>.
(macOS/Linux/WSL are handled by the separate `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` repo.)

## Orientation
- Source dir: `chezmoi source-path` — edit there (`cd "$(chezmoi source-path)"`).
- Preview / apply: `chezmoi diff` / `chezmoi apply` (or `just diff` / `just apply`).
- Source of a target: `chezmoi source-path <path>`; render without applying: `chezmoi cat <path>`.
- Re-run init prompts: `chezmoi init` (answers persist in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`).
- `docs/**`, `editors/**`, `scripts/**` are chezmoi-ignored (not deployed).

## Shell layout (pwsh)
- `$PROFILE` (`~/Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1`) is a loader
  that dot-sources `~/.config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in sorted order, then
  `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1` (untracked user override, loaded last).
- Fragments: `00_env` (PATH/XDG/env), `10_tools` (starship, zoxide, atuin,
  fzf, direnv, tv), `20_aliases` (`ll`/`gs`/`reload`/`cas`/`cau`/`chezmoi-cd`/`run-for`),
  `25_herdr` (`hvibe`/`hcode`/`hhere`/`hroot`/`hmark` workspace helpers, gated on herdr),
  `30_apps` (`applaunch`/`appquit`/`apprestart`/`sysvol`/`sysmute`/`x`), `35_yazi` (`y`),
  `40_copilot` (imports the Copilot module), `90_psreadline` (vi-mode gated on `enableVimMode`).

## Packages
- `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the **single source of
  truth** for installs, gated by the init toggles. scoop = CLI tools, winget = GUI
  apps, npm = AI agents, PSGallery = PSFzf/AudioDeviceCmdlets. Fault-tolerant: one
  failed package is collected + reported, never aborts the apply.
- Package sources are defined once in `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` and
  reused by the installer and `profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`: managed machines
  use company PyPI/npm pull-through registries; otherwise the China-mirror toggle
  selects GFW mirrors. Managed-machine policy wins if both toggles are true.
- Install ≠ upgrade: `chezmoi apply` only installs what's missing; upgrade via
  `just upgrade-scoop` / `just upgrade-winget`.

## copilot-proxy
- Module at `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot`. Commands: `copilot-proxy`
  (`start`/`stop`/`restart`/`status`/`doctor`/`logs`/`shim`/`whoami`/`auth`/`reinstall`),
  `copilot-run`, `claude-copilot`, `claude-copilot-once`, `codex-copilot`,
  `codex-copilot-once`, `copilot-here`, `copilot-model` (incl. `--auto`),
  `copilot-embed`, `semsearch`.
- Needs `bun`. Token: `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`. Ports 4141 (proxy) /
  4142 (throttle shim). Default main model `gpt-5.6-sol[1m]`; the OpenAI role
  profile maps Fable/Opus to Sol, Sonnet to Terra, and Haiku/background to Luna.
  Automatic selection excludes policy-disabled, picker-hidden and embedding-only
  entries. Claude `--auto` is Claude-first; Codex is OpenAI-first; both share the
  named OpenAI order Sol > Terra > 5.5 > 5.4 > 5.3 Codex > Luna > mini.
- The shim retries only the same buffered request/model, emits SSE keepalives for
  silent streams, and has a stall watchdog; it never performs request-time
  cross-model failover. Timing knobs: `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS`,
  `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_MS`, `COPILOT_SHIM_STALL_MS`.
- `copilot-here` writes only the gitignored `./.claude/settings.local.json`. The
  pinned copilot-api is installed ONCE into `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`
  (never `bunx` at launch); `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY` (auto|always|never|URL) controls
  whether Node fetches the GitHub model catalog through the local proxy. Full guide:
  `docs/copilot-proxy.md`.

## Editors / terminal / tv
- VSCode & Cursor settings + keybindings are deep-merged into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`
  by `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_20_editor_overlays.ps1.tmpl` (sources under `editors/`).
- Windows Terminal `profiles.defaults`, Alacritty (`%APPDATA%\alacritty\alacritty.toml`),
  and WezTerm (`~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua`, pwsh as default shell) are managed too.
  Television channels live under `%APPDATA%\television\cable\` (`tv <name>`).

## What's enabled on THIS machine
- role: **workstation**
- Coding agents: true · Agent sounds: peon · SpecStory build (PR #191): true · GUI apps: true · WSL2 (Docker backend): true · WSL Ubuntu: true · Utility apps: true · Gaming: true
- Extra runtimes: true · Media: true · LLM: true · Tunnel: true · IaC: true · OpenSSH: true · herdr: true · Clink(cmd): true · try: true · translate: true · Rime/Weasel: true
- China mirrors: true · Backup mode: smart · Vim mode: true · Managed machine: true

## just recipes
`just --list`: `apply`/`diff`/`update`, `upgrade-scoop`/`upgrade-winget`/`upgrade-translate`, `lint`/`test`,
`docs-serve`/`docs-build`, `enable-sshd` (opt-in OpenSSH server, elevated),
`enable-wsl` (WSL2 for Docker Desktop; self-elevating UAC prompt, reboot after),
`enable-wsl-ubuntu` (WSL2 Ubuntu distro + cross-platform dotfiles; needs enable-wsl first),
`wsl-dotfiles` (bootstrap the cross-platform dotfiles into an existing WSL distro; VPN if behind GFW),
`install-fonts-machine-wide` (Alacritty Nerd Font fix, elevated), and
`docker-up`/`docker-down`/`docker-clean`/`docker-logs`
(the x86-Linux+KVM Windows-in-Docker test harness — see `docker/windows/`).

## Gotchas
- Windows-only repo — no `{{ if eq .chezmoi.os }}` branching needed.
- Editor settings use a `run_onchange` pwsh merger (not `modify_`) on Windows.
- tmux / zellij are Unix-only and intentionally absent; **WezTerm** (installed) is
  the stable native tmux-like multiplexer, or use Windows Terminal panes. **herdr**
  is an opt-in (`installHerdr`) native-Windows multiplexer in preview beta —
  installed via herdr.dev's `irm|iex` script, config at `~/.config/herdr/config.toml`,
  with its official global skill exported from the installed binary on each apply.
  Runtimes are native via scoop (node/bun/go/rust/ruby) + uv for Python — no mise on Windows.
- **Rime input method** (opt-in `installInputMethod`): Weasel/小狼毫 via winget
  `Rime.Weasel`. Machine-scope NSIS, so applying raises UAC; and a bare silent
  install registers **简体** — `Install-Weasel` passes `--custom '/T'` for 繁體.
  The engine-level YAML in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` is **byte-identical to the
  parent repo's** copy (Squirrel/ibus-rime); only `weasel.custom.yaml` is
  Windows-specific. Edits need a redeploy, which
  `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.
  See `docs/input-method.md`.
- **cmd.exe** is opt-in via `installClink`: Clink + starship/zoxide/fzf give the DOS
  prompt parity for **prompt + navigation only** (no pwsh funcs/aliases/modules).
  `starship.lua` is chezmoi-managed at `%LocalAppData%\clink`; the zoxide/fzf Clink
  bridges are fetched from upstream at apply. pwsh stays the default shell.
- **`translate`** (`installTranslate`, on for workstation) is the one tool built from
  source: no scoop/winget manifest, so the packages script runs a version-pinned
  `go install` into `~\.local\bin` (it installs `go` itself). First build takes
  minutes; re-applies no-op via a `--version` check. Upgrade with
  `just upgrade-translate`, not `upgrade-scoop`.
- This skill body is shared: `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/` and
  `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/` both render `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.

# dotfiles-windows

This machine's `$HOME` is managed by a **chezmoi** dotfiles repo targeting **native
Windows + PowerShell 7**. Packages install via **scoop** (CLI) + **winget** (GUI) —
there is no ansible here. Repo: <https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles-windows>.
(macOS/Linux/WSL are handled by the separate `daviddwlee84/dotfiles` repo.)

## Orientation
- Source dir: `chezmoi source-path` — edit there (`cd "$(chezmoi source-path)"`).
- Preview / apply: `chezmoi diff` / `chezmoi apply` (or `just diff` / `just apply`).
- Source of a target: `chezmoi source-path <path>`; render without applying: `chezmoi cat <path>`.
- Re-run init prompts: `chezmoi init` (answers persist in `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`).
- `docs/**`, `editors/**`, `scripts/**` are chezmoi-ignored (not deployed).

## Shell layout (pwsh)
- `$PROFILE` (`~/Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1`) is a loader
  that dot-sources `~/.config/powershell/profile.d/*.ps1` in sorted order, then
  `~/.config/powershell/local.ps1` (untracked user override, loaded last).
- Fragments: `00_env` (PATH/XDG/env), `10_tools` (starship, zoxide, atuin,
  fzf, direnv, tv), `20_aliases` (`ll`/`gs`/`reload`/`cas`/`cau`/`chezmoi-cd`/`run-for`),
  `25_herdr` (`hvibe`/`hcode`/`hhere`/`hroot`/`hmark` workspace helpers, gated on herdr),
  `30_apps` (`applaunch`/`appquit`/`apprestart`/`sysvol`/`sysmute`/`x`), `35_yazi` (`y`),
  `40_copilot` (imports the Copilot module), `90_psreadline` (vi-mode gated on `enableVimMode`).

## Packages
- `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_10_packages.ps1.tmpl` is the **single source of
  truth** for installs, gated by the init toggles. scoop = CLI tools, winget = GUI
  apps, npm = AI agents, PSGallery = PSFzf/AudioDeviceCmdlets. Fault-tolerant: one
  failed package is collected + reported, never aborts the apply.
- Package sources are defined once in `.chezmoitemplates/package-sources.ps1` and
  reused by the installer and `profile.d/05_mirrors.ps1`: managed machines
  use company PyPI/npm pull-through registries; otherwise the China-mirror toggle
  selects GFW mirrors. Managed-machine policy wins if both toggles are true.
- Install ≠ upgrade: `chezmoi apply` only installs what's missing; upgrade via
  `just upgrade-scoop` / `just upgrade-winget`.

## copilot-proxy
- Module at `~/.config/powershell/modules/Copilot`. Commands: `copilot-proxy`
  (`start`/`stop`/`restart`/`status`/`doctor`/`logs`/`shim`/`whoami`/`auth`/`reinstall`),
  `copilot-run`, `claude-copilot`, `claude-copilot-once`, `codex-copilot`,
  `codex-copilot-once`, `copilot-here`, `copilot-model` (incl. `--auto`),
  `copilot-embed`, `semsearch`.
- Needs `bun`. Token: `~/.local/share/copilot-api/github_token`. Ports 4141 (proxy) /
  4142 (throttle shim). Default main model `gpt-5.6-sol[1m]`; the OpenAI role
  profile maps Fable/Opus to Sol, Sonnet to Terra, and Haiku/background to Luna.
  Automatic selection excludes policy-disabled, picker-hidden and embedding-only
  entries. Claude `--auto` is Claude-first; Codex is OpenAI-first; both share the
  named OpenAI order Sol > Terra > 5.5 > 5.4 > 5.3 Codex > Luna > mini.
- The shim retries only the same buffered request/model, emits SSE keepalives for
  silent streams, and has a stall watchdog; it never performs request-time
  cross-model failover. Timing knobs: `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_AFTER_MS`,
  `COPILOT_SHIM_PING_MS`, `COPILOT_SHIM_STALL_MS`.
- `copilot-here` writes only the gitignored `./.claude/settings.local.json`. The
  pinned copilot-api is installed ONCE into `~/.local/share/copilot-api/pkg`
  (never `bunx` at launch); `COPILOT_HTTP_PROXY` (auto|always|never|URL) controls
  whether Node fetches the GitHub model catalog through the local proxy. Full guide:
  `docs/copilot-proxy.md`.

## Editors / terminal / tv
- VSCode & Cursor settings + keybindings are deep-merged into `%APPDATA%\{Code,Cursor}\User`
  by `.chezmoiscripts/run_onchange_after_20_editor_overlays.ps1.tmpl` (sources under `editors/`).
- Windows Terminal `profiles.defaults`, Alacritty (`%APPDATA%\alacritty\alacritty.toml`),
  and WezTerm (`~/.config/wezterm/wezterm.lua`, pwsh as default shell) are managed too.
  Television channels live under `%APPDATA%\television\cable\` (`tv <name>`).

## What's enabled on THIS machine
- role: **workstation**
- Coding agents: true · Agent sounds: peon · SpecStory build (PR #191): true · GUI apps: true · WSL2 (Docker backend): true · WSL Ubuntu: true · Utility apps: true · Gaming: true
- Extra runtimes: true · Media: true · LLM: true · Tunnel: true · IaC: true · OpenSSH: true · herdr: true · Clink(cmd): true · try: true · translate: true · Rime/Weasel: true
- China mirrors: true · Backup mode: smart · Vim mode: true · Managed machine: true

## just recipes
`just --list`: `apply`/`diff`/`update`, `upgrade-scoop`/`upgrade-winget`/`upgrade-translate`, `lint`/`test`,
`docs-serve`/`docs-build`, `enable-sshd` (opt-in OpenSSH server, elevated),
`enable-wsl` (WSL2 for Docker Desktop; self-elevating UAC prompt, reboot after),
`enable-wsl-ubuntu` (WSL2 Ubuntu distro + cross-platform dotfiles; needs enable-wsl first),
`wsl-dotfiles` (bootstrap the cross-platform dotfiles into an existing WSL distro; VPN if behind GFW),
`install-fonts-machine-wide` (Alacritty Nerd Font fix, elevated), and
`docker-up`/`docker-down`/`docker-clean`/`docker-logs`
(the x86-Linux+KVM Windows-in-Docker test harness — see `docker/windows/`).

## Gotchas
- Windows-only repo — no `{{ if eq .chezmoi.os }}` branching needed.
- Editor settings use a `run_onchange` pwsh merger (not `modify_`) on Windows.
- tmux / zellij are Unix-only and intentionally absent; **WezTerm** (installed) is
  the stable native tmux-like multiplexer, or use Windows Terminal panes. **herdr**
  is an opt-in (`installHerdr`) native-Windows multiplexer in preview beta —
  installed via herdr.dev's `irm|iex` script, config at `~/.config/herdr/config.toml`,
  with its official global skill exported from the installed binary on each apply.
  Runtimes are native via scoop (node/bun/go/rust/ruby) + uv for Python — no mise on Windows.
- **Rime input method** (opt-in `installInputMethod`): Weasel/小狼毫 via winget
  `Rime.Weasel`. Machine-scope NSIS, so applying raises UAC; and a bare silent
  install registers **简体** — `Install-Weasel` passes `--custom '/T'` for 繁體.
  The engine-level YAML in `.chezmoitemplates/rime/` is **byte-identical to the
  parent repo's** copy (Squirrel/ibus-rime); only `weasel.custom.yaml` is
  Windows-specific. Edits need a redeploy, which
  `run_onchange_after_50_rime_deploy.ps1` does via `WeaselDeployer.exe /deploy`.
  See `docs/input-method.md`.
- **cmd.exe** is opt-in via `installClink`: Clink + starship/zoxide/fzf give the DOS
  prompt parity for **prompt + navigation only** (no pwsh funcs/aliases/modules).
  `starship.lua` is chezmoi-managed at `%LocalAppData%\clink`; the zoxide/fzf Clink
  bridges are fetched from upstream at apply. pwsh stays the default shell.
- **`translate`** (`installTranslate`, on for workstation) is the one tool built from
  source: no scoop/winget manifest, so the packages script runs a version-pinned
  `go install` into `~\.local\bin` (it installs `go` itself). First build takes
  minutes; re-applies no-op via a `--version` check. Upgrade with
  `just upgrade-translate`, not `upgrade-scoop`.
- This skill body is shared: `dot_agents/skills/dotfiles-windows/` and
  `dot_claude/skills/dotfiles-windows/` both render `.chezmoitemplates/dotfiles-windows-skill.md`.

289	        [string] $PackageSpec,

291	        [string] $NpmCache,
292	        [hashtable] $AdditionalEnvironment = @{},
293	        [ValidateSet('Host', 'StandardError', 'Capture')] [string] $OutputMode = 'Host',

295	        [string] $CorporatePyPiIndex = $script:CorporatePyPiIndex,
296	        [string] $PublicPyPiIndex = $script:PublicPyPiIndex,
297	        [string] $CorporateNpmRegistry = $script:CorporateNpmRegistry,
298	        [string] $PublicNpmRegistry = $script:PublicNpmRegistry
299	    )
300	
301	    $attempts = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
302	    $tempRoot = $null
303	    try {
304	        $workingDirectory = $null
305	        $baseEnvironment = @{}
306	        foreach ($key in $AdditionalEnvironment.Keys) { $baseEnvironment[$key] = $AdditionalEnvironment[$key] }
307	        if ($ManagedMachine) {
308	            $baseEnvironment = New-PackageAttemptEnvironment -Manager $Manager -AdditionalEnvironment $AdditionalEnvironment
309	            if ($Manager -eq 'npm') {
310	                if (-not $NpmPrefix) { throw 'NpmPrefix is required for npm source isolation' }
311	                $tempRoot = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('package-source-npm-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
312	                New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $tempRoot | Out-Null
313	                $userConfig = Join-Path $tempRoot 'user.npmrc'
314	                $globalConfig = Join-Path $tempRoot 'global.npmrc'
315	                [IO.File]::WriteAllText($userConfig, '', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
316	                [IO.File]::WriteAllText($globalConfig, '', [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
317	                $baseEnvironment['NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG'] = $userConfig
318	                $baseEnvironment['NPM_CONFIG_GLOBALCONFIG'] = $globalConfig
319	                $workingDirectory = $tempRoot
320	            }
321	        }
322	
323	        $sourceQueue = [Collections.Generic.Queue[string]]::new()
324	        $sourceQueue.Enqueue($(if ($ManagedMachine) { 'corporate' } else { 'ambient' }))
325	        while ($sourceQueue.Count -gt 0) {
326	            $sourceKind = $sourceQueue.Dequeue()
327	            $attemptNumber = $attempts.Count + 1
328	            $sourceLabel = if ($sourceKind -eq 'ambient') { 'ambient package policy' } elseif ($Manager -eq 'uv') { "$sourceKind PyPI" } else { "$sourceKind npm" }
329	            Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: attempt $attemptNumber using $sourceLabel"
330	
331	            $attemptArguments = @($Arguments)
332	            $attemptEnvironment = @{} + $baseEnvironment
333	            if ($sourceKind -ne 'ambient') {
334	                $sourceUrl = if ($Manager -eq 'uv') {
335	                    if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') { $CorporatePyPiIndex } else { $PublicPyPiIndex }
336	                } else {
337	                    if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') { $CorporateNpmRegistry } else { $PublicNpmRegistry }
338	                }
339	                if ($Manager -eq 'uv') {
340	                    $attemptArguments = Add-UvSourceArguments -Arguments $attemptArguments -SourceUrl $sourceUrl
341	                } else {
342	                    $attemptArguments += "--registry=$sourceUrl"
343	                    $scope = Get-NpmPackageScope -PackageSpec $PackageSpec
344	                    if ($scope) { $attemptArguments += "--$scope`:registry=$sourceUrl" }
345	                    $attemptArguments += "--prefix=$NpmPrefix"
346	                    if ($NpmCache) { $attemptArguments += "--cache=$NpmCache" }
347	                }
348	            }
349	
350	            $processResult = Invoke-CapturedPackageProcess -Executable $Executable -Arguments $attemptArguments `
351	                -Environment $attemptEnvironment -WorkingDirectory $workingDirectory `
352	                -TimeoutSeconds $TimeoutSeconds -OutputMode $OutputMode
353	            $combinedOutput = "$($processResult.Stdout)`n$($processResult.Stderr)"
354	            $failureClass = if ($processResult.ExitCode -eq 0) { 'none' } else {
355	                Get-PackageFailureClass -Output $combinedOutput -TimedOut $processResult.TimedOut -LaunchFailed $processResult.LaunchFailed
356	            }
357	            $attempts.Add([pscustomobject]@{
358	                Source = $sourceKind
359	                ExitCode = $processResult.ExitCode
360	                TimedOut = $processResult.TimedOut
361	                FailureClass = $failureClass
362	                Stdout = $processResult.Stdout
363	                Stderr = $processResult.Stderr
364	            })
365	
366	            if ($processResult.ExitCode -eq 0) { break }
367	            Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: $sourceKind attempt failed: $failureClass"
368	
369	            if ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate' -and $AllowPublicFallback -and (Test-PackageFallbackEligible $failureClass)) {
370	                Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: public fallback enabled; retrying once"
371	                $sourceQueue.Enqueue('public')
372	            } elseif ($sourceKind -eq 'corporate') {
373	                $reason = if (-not $AllowPublicFallback) { 'fallback is disabled' } else { "$failureClass is not eligible" }
374	                Write-PackageSourceDiagnostic -OutputMode $OutputMode -Message "package-source[$Manager`:$Operation]: $reason; not retrying"
375	            }
376	        }
377	
378	        $final = $attempts[$attempts.Count - 1]
379	        [pscustomobject]@{
380	            Succeeded = $final.ExitCode -eq 0
381	            ExitCode = $final.ExitCode
382	            TimedOut = $final.TimedOut
383	            FallbackUsed = $attempts.Count -gt 1 -and $attempts[1].Source -eq 'public'
384	            FailureClass = $final.FailureClass
385	            Attempts = @($attempts)
386	            Stdout = $final.Stdout
387	            Stderr = $final.Stderr
388	        }
389	    } finally {
390	        if ($tempRoot) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tempRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
391	    }
392	}

395	    $raw = @(& chezmoi data --format json 2>$null)
396	    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or -not $raw) { throw 'could not read chezmoi package-source policy' }

398	    [pscustomobject]@{
399	        ManagedMachine = [bool] $data.managedMachine
400	        AllowPublicFallback = [bool] $data.allowPublicPackageFallback
401	    }

43	    if ($text -match '(?i)(?:HTTP[^\r\n]{0,48}\b40[13]\b|status[^\r\n]{0,32}\b40[13]\b|\bE40[13]\b)|unauthori[sz]ed|forbidden|authentication required|invalid auth|access denied|blocked by (?:your )?(?:administrator|organization|policy)|organization(?:al)? policy') {

47	        return 'tls-certificate'
48	    }
49	    if ($text -match '(?i)(?:HTTP[^\r\n]{0,48}\b429\b|status[^\r\n]{0,32}\b429\b|\bE429\b)|too many requests|rate limit') {
50	        return 'rate-limit'
51	    }
52	    if ($text -match '(?i)(?:HTTP[^\r\n]{0,48}\b404\b|status[^\r\n]{0,32}\b404\b|\bE404\b)|\bETARGET\b|no matching version|not in this registry|not found in the package registry|no matching distribution|could not find a version') {
53	        return 'package-absence'

55	    if ($text -match '(?i)\bERESOLVE\b|no solution found|incompatible (?:python|platform|version)|build failed|failed to build|postinstall|compiler|subprocess.+failed|\bE(?:PERM|ACCES|BUSY|NOSPC|INVAL)\b|disk full|no space left|resource busy|file is locked') {
56	        return 'package-or-local'
57	    }
58	
59	    if ($corporateContext -and ($TimedOut -or $text -match '(?i)HTTP[^\r\n]{0,48}\b408\b|\bETIMEDOUT\b|\bESOCKETTIMEDOUT\b|UND_ERR_(?:CONNECT|HEADERS)_TIMEOUT|timed out|request timeout')) {
60	        return 'timeout'

62	    if ($TimedOut) { return 'timeout-unknown' }
63	    if ($corporateContext -and $text -match '(?i)\b(?:ECONNRESET|ECONNREFUSED|EAI_AGAIN|ENETUNREACH|EHOSTUNREACH|ENOTFOUND)\b|socket hang up|connection reset|connection refused|could not resolve host|temporary (?:failure|error).+(?:DNS|name resolution)') {

67	        return 'http-5xx'
68	    }
69	    'other'

77	function Invoke-InteractivePackageProcess {
78	    param(
79	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Executable,
80	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [AllowEmptyCollection()] [string[]] $Arguments,
81	        [hashtable] $Environment = @{},
82	        [string] $WorkingDirectory,

85	
86	    $startInfo = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
87	    $startInfo.FileName = $Executable

89	    if ($WorkingDirectory) { $startInfo.WorkingDirectory = $WorkingDirectory }
90	    foreach ($argument in $Arguments) { $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add([string] $argument) }
91	    foreach ($name in $Environment.Keys) {
92	        if ($null -eq $Environment[$name]) { $startInfo.Environment.Remove([string] $name) }
93	        else { $startInfo.Environment[[string] $name] = [string] $Environment[$name] }
94	    }
95	
96	    $process = [Diagnostics.Process]::new()
97	    $process.StartInfo = $startInfo
98	    $timedOut = $false
99	    try {
100	        if (-not $process.Start()) { throw "failed to start $Executable" }
101	        if ($TimeoutSeconds -eq 0) {
102	            $process.WaitForExit()
103	        } elseif (-not $process.WaitForExit($TimeoutSeconds * 1000)) {
104	            $timedOut = $true
105	            try { $process.Kill($true) } catch { $null = $_ }
106	            $process.WaitForExit()
107	        }
108	        [pscustomobject]@{
109	            ExitCode = if ($timedOut) { -1 } else { $process.ExitCode }
110	            TimedOut = $timedOut
111	        }

117	function Invoke-CapturedPackageProcess {
118	    param(
119	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Executable,
120	        [Parameter(Mandatory)] [AllowEmptyCollection()] [string[]] $Arguments,
121	        [hashtable] $Environment = @{},
122	        [string] $WorkingDirectory,
123	        [ValidateRange(1, 86400)] [int] $TimeoutSeconds = 600,
124	        [ValidateSet('Host', 'StandardError', 'Capture')] [string] $OutputMode = 'Host'
125	    )
126	
127	    $startInfo = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new()
128	    $startInfo.FileName = $Executable
129	    $startInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
130	    $startInfo.CreateNoWindow = $true
131	    $startInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
132	    $startInfo.RedirectStandardError = $true
133	    if ($WorkingDirectory) { $startInfo.WorkingDirectory = $WorkingDirectory }
134	    foreach ($argument in $Arguments) { $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add([string] $argument) }
135	    foreach ($name in $Environment.Keys) {
136	        if ($null -eq $Environment[$name]) { $startInfo.Environment.Remove([string] $name) }
137	        else { $startInfo.Environment[[string] $name] = [string] $Environment[$name] }
138	    }
139	
140	    $process = [Diagnostics.Process]::new()
141	    $process.StartInfo = $startInfo
142	    $timedOut = $false
143	    $launchFailed = $false
144	    $exitCode = -1
145	    $stdout = ''
146	    $stderr = ''
147	    try {
148	        try {
149	            if (-not $process.Start()) { throw 'process did not start' }
150	        } catch {
151	            $launchFailed = $true
152	            $stderr = "failed to start $Executable`: $($_.Exception.Message)"
153	            return [pscustomobject]@{
154	                ExitCode = -1; TimedOut = $false; LaunchFailed = $true
155	                Stdout = ''; Stderr = (Protect-PackageSourceOutput $stderr)
156	            }
157	        }
158	
159	        $stdoutTask = $process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
160	        $stderrTask = $process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
161	        $terminated = $true
162	        if (-not $process.WaitForExit($TimeoutSeconds * 1000)) {
163	            $timedOut = $true
164	            $terminated = $false
165	            try {
166	                $process.Kill($true)
167	                $terminated = $process.WaitForExit(5000)
168	            } catch {
169	                $terminated = $false
170	            }
171	        }
172	        if ($terminated) {
173	            $stdout = $stdoutTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
174	            $stderr = $stderrTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
175	        } else {
176	            $stderr = "process timed out and could not be terminated: $Executable"
177	        }
178	        $exitCode = if ($timedOut) { -1 } else { $process.ExitCode }
179	    } finally {
180	        $process.Dispose()
181	    }
182	
183	    $stdout = Protect-PackageSourceOutput $stdout
184	    $stderr = Protect-PackageSourceOutput $stderr
185	    if ($OutputMode -eq 'Host') {
186	        if ($stdout) { Write-Host $stdout.TrimEnd() }
187	        if ($stderr) { [Console]::Error.Write($stderr) }
188	    } elseif ($OutputMode -eq 'StandardError') {
189	        if ($stdout) { [Console]::Error.Write($stdout) }
190	        if ($stderr) { [Console]::Error.Write($stderr) }
191	    }
192	
193	    [pscustomobject]@{
194	        ExitCode = $exitCode
195	        TimedOut = $timedOut
196	        LaunchFailed = $launchFailed
197	        Stdout = $stdout
198	        Stderr = $stderr
199	    }
200	}
